jobs.title: Senior People Partner - Content
jobs.description:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The opportunity

Our People Partners are the eyes and ears of the organisation, embedded within their functional areas to be a sounding board for leaders, support managers and enable teams to thrive. The People Partnering team operate on a strategic and tactical level, ensuring the people elements are in place for teams to effectively deliver their strategic objectives (think org design, upskilling, succession planning) whilst also offering one on one support, both structured and ad hoc, to those who need it most.

We're hiring an experienced, driven Senior People Partner to partner with our Chief Content Officer and the Content (Editorial, Legals, Credit, Distressed) team. Content is scaling fast across the UK and US, and we need a Senior People Partner who can move at pace, get to grips with what the team actually does, and hold their own with senior editorial and analytical leaders.

You'll be fully embedded in the Content team, with a real voice in leadership meetings, editorial rituals and off-sites. You'll know the leads, managers and rising talent well enough to catch the people issues long before they show up in engagement scores or exit interviews.

Every day is different, but here's an example of the kind of things you'll work on:

Strategic

  • Trusted advisor to your leaders: You'll be the first person Content leadership calls on anything people-related: the confidant, sounding board and thought partner they think alongside, not the person they update after the fact. That kind of trust is earned over time, through showing up and being willing to have the harder conversation when it matters.

  • Right hand person to the CCO: You know how he thinks about content and his organisation, and are confident acting as his proxy with his leaders to get them to where they need to be.

  • Locked in on what the team is trying to achieve: You know Content's goals, what its leaders and teams do. You bring solutions, not just observations, and follow them through to completion.

  • Fully embedded in your team: You're in the rituals, Slack channels and meetings that matter, so you've got a real read on how the team actually works. You cut through the noise to name the actual issue and get it resolved quickly and respectfully.

  • Catching things early: You join the dots across 1:1s, skips, engagement data and your own observations to surface people risks while they're still small and easy to fix. You coach leaders and managers to build the same instinct.

  • Org design: You advise on org shape, spot gaps and flag future risk areas. You make sure the right people are doing the right jobs at the right level as Content scales across regions and coverage.

  • Talent management: You know who the key talent is and you work with leaders to develop, stretch and reward them. You support leaders to identify their successors and build the development plans that get them ready. You work proactively with the Talent team on the pipelines for roles you can already see coming.

  • Learning & development: You spot where Content teams need to grow — editorial craft, analytical rigour, management skill, leadership development — and you lead the training that plugs the gap. A big part of that is upskilling managers to handle people issues themselves, early and well, rather than escalating them to the CCO. You diagnose early, source or build the right thing, and hold a bar for what impact should look like once it's landed.

  • Reward: You use solid data to inform our salary bands and keep compensation fair across the team, with D&I front of mind. You coach leaders and managers through promotion and salary reviews so decisions are thoughtful, equitable and defensible.

  • Performance: You help leaders and managers get the best out of their teams, surfacing blockers, coaching through them, and making sure feedback and training actually land. You hold a high bar yourself and help leaders hold one too.

  • Hands up for the bigger stuff: You take on projects that improve the People function as a whole, not just your patch. You scope them properly, influence stakeholders, manage the risks and dependencies, and ship on time.

Tactical

  • Employee Relations (ER): Following UK employment law, navigating all employee relations within your business area, including but not limited to: managing Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs), resolving claims and grievances in line with policy, probation management, maternity and paternity cases, flexible working requests, conflict management and mediation, and any other employee-to-employee issue that comes up, both formally and informally.

  • Embedding people products: Working with the wider Partnering team to embed our people products and systems, delivering training, championing adoption and being the go-to person for questions. Delivering product feedback to the wider team on a regular basis.

  • Data: Pulling and analysing the right data to help managers and leaders make good calls and adding the context that turns numbers into something your leaders can actually use.

  • Wellbeing support: 1:1 support to employees when they need it, and making sure they know what mental and physical health support is on offer. Supporting managers through those conversations too.

  • Cultural ambassador: Working with leaders and managers to reinforce the right behaviours in teams. Being a role model yourself for our values and ways of working, especially as the London office grows.

About You

This role will be a great fit if you:

  • Take real accountability for pushing back on leaders — not just flagging a concern and moving on, but staying with it until the right decision gets made.

  • Can confidently challenge executives and their most senior leaders when it matters, as a true partner rather than a service function.

  • Are properly curious about the business you support. You'll want to understand how Content produces its analysis, what makes a great desk, and what separates a good journalist from a world class one. You ask questions until you get to the real answer.

  • Are a strong influencer, able to help others look at things from different perspectives and understand the 'why' behind decisions. Comfortable pushing back on leaders and managers when needed, and know when to step back and let them make their own call.

  • Have significant experience partnering with content, editorial, research or analyst teams and can speak their language credibly.

  • Have a bias to action: you see what needs doing and pick it up, rather than waiting to be asked.

  • Use data to back your decisions and see what's coming, not just to describe what's already happened.

  • Care about data integrity and have solid experience with the day-to-day people processes and onboarding a high-trust team relies on.

  • Have a strong grasp of UK employment law and awareness of New York employment law to reach the right, compliant call in tricky ER situations autonomously. Sharp on policies and procedures.

  • Can context-switch frequently and comfortably hold strategic and tactical work in the same day.

  • Are a strong team player who partners closely with your fellow People Partners, Talent Partners and the wider People and Talent team so 9finners get the best experience of us collectively.

  • Can operate autonomously and at pace in a fast-moving scale-up.

Key Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in HR, preferably in fast-paced environments (tech, fintech, or start-ups)

  • Knowledge of UK employment laws and regulations

  • Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously

  • Familiarity with HRIS and ATS software (we use HiBob, Lattice and Ashby)

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; ability to interact with candidates, employees, and external stakeholders in a professional and approachable manner

  • A people-first mindset with the ability to build strong relationships and offer guidance to employees at all levels

  • Flexible and able to thrive in a fast-moving, dynamic start-up environment

  • Proactive and collaborative approach

  • A genuine interest in employee well-being and fostering a supportive, inclusive culture

Compensation & Benefits

Finance & Insurance

  • Competitive base salary

  • Equity options

  • Pension with 9fin contributing 3% (employee contributions are uncapped)

  • Private health insurance with dental and vision

Time Off

  • 25 vacation days per year

  • Local public holidays (with option to exchange for alternative days)

  • Work abroad for up to 3 months per year

  • 1-month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

  • Enhanced parental leave and flexible working arrangements

Growth & Culture

  • Professional learning and development budget

  • Bi-annual team socials

  • Summer and Winter company-wide events

Hybrid Policy

9fin is a hybrid company, and the office is a regular part of how we work. From January 2027, all employees will work from their designated 9fin office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Some teams may be asked to be in the office more often, where the nature of their work calls for it. For the rest of the week, you may work from wherever works best for you and your team. Your Talent Partner will share hybrid working details for this role.

9fin is an equal opportunities employer

At 9fin we are dedicated to building and promoting a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can reach their full potential and truly belong. We recognize that building diverse teams enables a more creative and productive environment. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be who we’re looking for — either for this role, or perhaps another.

You'll own the operational engine of the team: our contract lifecycle platform (Ironclad, which is deeply embedded across sales, procurement and RevOps), our commercial playbook (and developing non-commercial playbooks), our tech stack (including AI implementation), our front-door (right now, ticketing is done in Linear), our knowledge management (currently spread across multiple systems), our reporting and KPIs, and the tracking and governance around outside counsel spend.

What you’ll work on

Below is the shape of the role, laid out as prioritised by Now, Next and Later so you can see the broad strokes of the path ahead - but by no means is this set in stone. Priorities will move as we learn what's most useful in practice and you’ll have a big hand in shaping this further.

Now

Later

About you

jobs.title: Light Amplification Lead (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is an international deep-tech company based in Germany and the US, working to commercialize laser-driven nuclear fusion. Our mission is to provide clean, safe, and virtually unlimited energy to the world. We are rapidly scaling and looking for talented individuals who thrive in building clarity and structure within fast-growing environments.

Your Role

The laser amplification chain scales the beam energy needed by our fusion system. Developing it involves complex technical decisions, interdependent teams and requirements that evolve as the programme advances.

We are looking for a Light Amplification Lead (f/m/d) to give this function clear direction and accountability. Your mission is to lead the amplification team, critically evaluate technical information and turn stakeholder input into decisions, priorities and a credible development roadmap. You will guide the function towards delivery of a subsystem that meets agreed requirements and can integrate with the wider laser system.

You do not need to be an expert in every amplifier technology. You do need strong engineering judgement, extensive technical leadership experience and enough laser understanding to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions and work effectively with domain specialists.

What you’ll do

  • Lead and develop the function. Provide line management for technical teams, set clear expectations, give feedback and develop their capabilities. Build a view of the skills and capacity needed as the programme evolves, and contribute to hiring and team development.

  • Provide technical decisions and steering. Listen to different stakeholders, critically review their input and challenge assumptions. Work with specialists to assess options and make reasoned decisions, identifying where further evidence or expertise is needed.

  • Own the development roadmap. Translate system requirements and programme priorities into a function-level plan that goes beyond individual task lists. Establish milestones, identify dependencies and capability gaps, and adapt the plan as requirements and evidence change.

  • Guide complex project delivery. Lead larger technical projects through uncertainty. Keep priorities, resources, risks and trade-offs visible, coordinate with programme management and lab operations, and escalate issues early.

  • Connect amplification to the wider system. Take accountability for the amplification architecture, requirements and interfaces, drawing on the team's specialist expertise. Coordinate with adjacent laser functions and system integration so technical decisions support agreed performance and integration needs.

Who You Are

  • You have some laser exposure and a general understanding of amplification. You have enough relevant background to understand the function, engage with specialists and assess how its decisions affect the wider system. Direct hands-on amplifier development is an advantage, not a prerequisite.

  • Extensive technical leadership experience. You have led technical teams and larger, complex engineering projects, with responsibility for people, priorities and delivery. You can develop specialists and provide direction across disciplines.

  • Strong engineering judgement. You can evaluate technical arguments, distinguish assumptions from evidence, identify risks and challenge recommendations constructively. You do not need to know every answer yourself, but you know how to reach a sound decision with the right experts.

  • Experience leading through uncertainty. You have worked on development programmes with incomplete information, evolving requirements or changing technical priorities. You can maintain direction while adapting plans as new evidence emerges.

  • People and stakeholder leadership. You listen carefully, reconcile different perspectives, communicate decisions clearly and remain close to the team. Your leadership experience includes line management and developing technical colleagues, not only coordinating schedules.

  • Your background may be in laser systems, photonics, optical systems or a broader complex-engineering programme that includes relevant laser work. Your current title is less important than the scope of technical and people leadership you have exercised.

    Nice to have

  • Direct experience developing laser amplifiers or high-energy/high-power laser systems.

  • Familiarity with solid-state, fibre or diode-pumped amplification, CPA/OPCPA, or relevant pulsed and ultrafast systems.

  • Systems engineering, requirements traceability, technology-maturity planning and subsystem integration.

  • Industrialisation, supplier coordination, budget and resource planning, or design for cost and manufacture.

  • Experience in fusion, a high-power laser facility or a defence laser programme.

  • A PhD or equivalent depth of experience in physics, photonics or a related engineering discipline.


Why work with Us?

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

  • Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers, and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

  • Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges, and shaping the future of our company.

  • Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

  • Vacation Days: We support your work-life balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

  • Flexibility: Work should fit around your life, not the other way around. We offer the ability to work from our office, but some flexibility to work from home as well.

  • Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

  • Retirement Plan: If you decide on a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

  • Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

 


Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, benefits.

NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there.

jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager (all genders)
jobs.description:
Gestalte das perfekte Foodji-Erlebnis

Ein großartiges Produkt allein reicht nicht – echte Kundenzufriedenheit entsteht durch starke Beziehungen und einen klaren Blick auf die Entwicklung des Kundenportfolios. Du machst den konkreten Nutzen und Mehrwert von Foodji sichtbar und schaffst damit die Grundlage für langfristige Partnerschaften.

Deine Mission bei Foodji:

  • Vertragsverlängerungen bereitest du aktiv vor und erkennst Kündigungsrisiken frühzeitig – auch wenn sie zunächst nur an einem einzelnen Standort auftreten.

  • Steuerung von internen und crossfunktionalen Projekten zur Weiterentwicklung des Customer Success Bereichs.


DAS BRINGST DU MIT

  • Mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung im Customer Success Management sowie nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Retention-, Vertragsverlängerungs- und Churn-Kennzahlen über ein Kundenportfolio hinweg.

  • Strukturierte, datengetriebene und eigenständige Arbeitsweise mit einem guten Gespür für Kundenbeziehungen sowie der Fähigkeit, Risiken, Kundenpotenziale und nächste Schritte selbstständig zu priorisieren.

  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen, insbesondere Salesforce, sowie sehr gute Excel-Kenntnisse.

  • Kommunikationsstärke auf Entscheider:innenebene – auch in anspruchsvollen Gesprächen – sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe Multi-Standort-Accounts mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern strategisch zu betreuen.

  • Präsentations- und Argumentationsfähigkeit sowie ausgeprägte Networking-Kompetenzen.

  • Ein „Do-it“-Mindset, Teamfähigkeit, Selbstbewusstsein sowie eine lösungs- und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise.

NOCH FRAGEN?

Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht und helfen dir gerne weiter!

  • Food Tastings: Teste dich mit unserem Foodteam durch unsere Produkte und gestalte unser Sortiment von morgen

  • Development: Deine Weiterentwicklung liegt uns am Herzen und mit regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen und Trainings bieten wir dir spannende Entwicklungspfade – z. B. vom SDR zum Account Executive

ÜBER UNS

Hi, schön, dass du da bist! Wir sind Foodji - ein Team aus Food-Lovern & Tech-Nerds.

Unsere Mission ist es, frisches, gesundes und vor allem leckeres Essen überall dort anzubieten, wo Menschen den Großteil ihres Alltags verbringen – in Büros, ganz gleich, ob im Gewerbegebiet oder mitten in der Stadt, während langer Schichten im Krankenhaus oder in den Tiefen einer Produktionshalle, in der rund um die Uhr Menschen arbeiten. Mit unserer eigens entwickelten Technologieplattform optimieren wir die Mengenplanung und sagen Food Waste den Kampf an. Wir wollen einen positiven Effekt erzielen – auf die Umwelt, den Alltag unserer Kund:innen und unsere Communities. jobs.title: Norsklærer med spanskkunnskaper søkes til digital undervisning
jobs.description:
Norsklærer med spanskkunnskaper søkes til digital undervisning

Om jobben

Vi søker engasjerte norsklærere med gode spanskkunnskaper til digitale undervisningsoppdrag.

Vi ser etter deg som har pedagogisk kompetanse, interesse for norsk som andrespråk og et ønske om å hjelpe spansktalende deltakere med å utvikle norskferdighetene sine.

Undervisningen foregår digitalt, og du kan undervise hjemmefra. Oppdragene avtales ut fra din tilgjengelighet og våre kursbehov.

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter engasjerte og dyktige norsklærere som ønsker å bidra til å utvikle deltakernes norskferdigheter og gjøre dem tryggere i møte med det norske arbeids- og samfunnslivet.

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Har lærerutdanning, PPU eller annen relevant pedagogisk utdanning fra høyskole eller universitet. Annen relevant utdanning og pedagogisk erfaring fra skole, undervisning eller opplæringsvirksomhet kan også vurderes.

  • Har erfaring med å undervise norsk som andrespråk, gjerne for voksne.

  • Har gode spanskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig. Dette er et krav.

  • Er trygg, selvstendig og engasjert i lærerrollen.

  • Har gode digitale ferdigheter og er komfortabel med nettundervisning.

  • Er fleksibel og kan tilpasse undervisningen til deltakernes ulike nivåer og behov.

  • Har god forståelse for norsk arbeidsliv, kultur og samfunn.

  • Har en inkluderende og motiverende undervisningsstil.

Det er en fordel om du har erfaring med arbeidsrettet norsk, voksenopplæring eller undervisning av spansktalende deltakere.

Vi legger vekt på pedagogisk kompetanse, gode kommunikasjonsevner og evnen til å skape et trygt og motiverende digitalt læringsmiljø.

Søkere med annen relevant utdanningsbakgrunn og solid undervisningserfaring vil også bli vurdert.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Hos oss handler norskundervisningen om mer enn å lære et språk. Vi ønsker å hjelpe deltakerne med å utvikle praktiske og funksjonelle norskferdigheter som gjør dem tryggere i hverdagen, arbeidslivet og det norske samfunnet.

Undervisningen har særlig fokus på muntlig kommunikasjon, lesing, skriving og forståelse av norsk språk i ulike situasjoner. Vi legger også vekt på arbeidsrettet norsk, kulturforståelse og kjennskap til det norske arbeidslivet og det sosiokulturelle miljøet.

Som norsklærer vil du bidra til å styrke deltakernes språklige selvtillit, kommunikasjonsevner og muligheter for aktiv deltakelse i arbeids- og samfunnslivet.

Undervisningen gjennomføres digitalt, og du kan undervise hjemmefra. Vi tilbyr undervisningsmateriell og en pedagogisk metodikk som danner grunnlaget for kursene, samtidig som du har rom for å bruke din egen pedagogiske kompetanse og tilpasse undervisningen til deltakernes behov.

Undervisningstider

Vi søker lærere som har mulighet til å ta undervisningsoppdrag på ett eller flere av følgende tidspunkter:

  • Formiddag: kl. 10.00--12.00

  • Kveld: kl. 19.00--21.00

Du trenger ikke å være tilgjengelig på begge tidspunktene. Vi avtaler undervisningsoppdrag ut fra din tilgjengelighet og hvilke kurs du ønsker å påta deg.

Oppdragene kan variere i omfang og varighet.

Hva tilbyr vi?

  • Opplæring: Innføring i vår undervisningsmetodikk og bruk av undervisningsmateriell.

  • Veiledning og støtte: Faglig veiledning og oppfølging ved behov.

  • Fleksible undervisningsoppdrag: Mulighet til å påta deg oppdrag ut fra egen tilgjengelighet.

  • Mulighet for flere oppdrag: Mulighet for videre samarbeid og flere undervisningsoppdrag etter avtale.

  • Undervisning hjemmefra: All undervisning foregår digitalt.

  • Undervisningsmateriell: Vi stiller nødvendig undervisningsmateriell til disposisjon.

  • Honorar: 320 kr per undervisningstime.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Vi tilbyr digital norskopplæring med særlig fokus på spansktalende deltakere. Målet vårt er å gjøre norskopplæringen praktisk, tilgjengelig og relevant for hverdagslivet, arbeidslivet og det norske samfunnet.

Gjennom en tilpasset pedagogisk metodikk ønsker vi å styrke deltakernes språkferdigheter, selvtillit og muligheter for aktiv deltakelse i det norske samfunnet.

jobs.title: Vi trenger sjåfører deltid på liten og stor bil.
jobs.description:
LOKALTAXI MOLDE TAXI søker sjåfører. Deltid midtuke og deltid helg.

Du må være serviceinnstilt, like å omgås mennesker, like å kjøre bil, beherske norsk muntlig og skriftlig, og være fylt 20 år, og hatt førerkort i minst 2 år sammenhengende. Det kreves godkjent helseattest og vandelsattest.

Opplæring gjøres igjennom Statens Vegvesen, og Molde Taxi. Politiet utsteder kjøreseddel for persontransport når opplæring er gjennomgått.

Kvinner oppfordres til å søke.

Virker det interessant?

Er det deg vi er på jakt etter?

Ta kontakt epost post@moldetaxi.no

Vi kontakter deg for mer informasjon og eventuell veiledning om opplæring.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Lokaltaxi Molde Taxi har totalt 30 drosjeløyver. Molde Taxi AS har egen storbilavdeling med 8 og 16 seters biler. Totalt er rundt 70 personer engasjert i heltids -og deltidsstillinger. Lokaltaxi Molde Taxi kjører for det offentlige: fylkeskommune, kommune, pasientreiser, busselskaper som VY, Boreal og Veøy Buss, samt mange insitusjoner, og firma. I tillegg er vi åpen for vanlig persontransport i Molde området. Vi er endel av taxikjeden LOKALTAXI som er en kjede som strekker seg fra Bodø til Sogndal, vi er også inne i andre samarbeid både lokalt i Romsdal og i Møre og Romsdal.

jobs.title: Lead Software Developer, SCADA
jobs.description: Lead Software Developer. Siinä on energiaa - Tule meille näyttämään kykysi ja rakentamaan puhtaampaa energiajärjestelmää! Me Helenissä tarjoamme helpompaa ja mutkattomampaa arkea kaikkialla Suomessa. Lämmön, jäähdytyksen ja sähkön lisäksi tarjoamme ratkaisuja alueelliseen ja uusiutuvaan energiaan sekä sähköiseen liikenteeseen. Kehitämme fiksumpaa ja puhtaampaa energiajärjestelmää, jonka avulla pidämme huolta, että asiakkaamme voivat tuottaa, käyttää ja säästää energiaa ympäristöä kunnioittaen. Vähennämme suunnitelmallisesti päästöjämme ja tavoitteemme on irtautua polttamiseen perustuvasta energiantuotannosta vuoteen 2040 mennessä. Haluaisitko olla mukana kehittämässä Helenin energiantuotannon ohjauksen kannalta keskeisiä järjestelmiä ja rakentamassa SCADA-ohjelmistokehityskyvykkyyttämme? Tule meille Lead Software Developeriksi SCADA ja valvomo -ratkaisutiimiin. Työsuhde on vakituinen. Roolissa työskentelet osana SCADA ja valvomo -ratkaisutiimiä, joka vastaa energiantuotannon ohjaus- ja valvomojärjestelmien kehittämisestä sekä keskeytymättömästä tiedonkulusta tuotantolaitosten ja valvomon välillä. Tiimin ratkaisut mahdollistavat laitosten reaaliaikaisen automaattisen säädön ja muodostavat huoltovarmuuden kannalta kriittisen kokonaisuuden, jonka ympärivuorokautisesta toimintavarmuudesta huolehditaan yhdessä kumppaneiden kanssa. Lead Software Developerina otat vahvan teknisen roolin tämän järjestelmäkokonaisuuden kehittämisessä. Pääset tekemään käytännön ohjelmistokehitystä sekä vaikuttamaan siihen, miten Helenin omaa kehityskyvykkyyttä, teknisiä ratkaisuja ja toimintatapoja rakennetaan nyt ja tulevaisuudessa. Roolissasi Otat teknistä vetovastuuta Helenin SCADA-järjestelmien ohjelmistokehityksestä ja niiden pitkäjänteisestä kehittämisestä.Suunnittelet, kehität ja ylläpidät SCADA-järjestelmän ohjelmistokomponentteja, integraatioita ja käyttöliittymiä.Varmistat yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa ratkaisujen ylläpidettävyyden, toimintavarmuuden ja skaalautuvuuden. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä energiantuotannon, optimoinnin, automaation ja muiden ohjelmistokehittäjien kanssa ja viet tarpeita toimiviksi teknisiksi ratkaisuiksi. Osallistut järjestelmien teknisen arkkitehtuurin ja tulevaisuuden ratkaisujen suunnitteluun sekä yhteistyöhön järjestelmätoimittajien kanssa. Odotamme sinulta Vahvaa kokemusta ohjelmistokehityksestä sekä kykyä ottaa teknistä vastuuta laajoista ja liiketoimintakriittisistä järjestelmistä. Kokemusta SCADA- tai muista OT-ympäristöistä, kuten valvomokäyttöliittymistä ja teollisista integraatioista. Ymmärrystä teollisuuden tietoliikenneprotokollista, kuten OPC UA, IEC-104, ICCP ja Modbus. Kokemusta moderneista ohjelmistokehityksen käytännöistä, kuten automatisoidusta testauksesta, CI/CDä ja versionhallinnasta, sekä AI-avusteisten työkalujen hyödyntämisestä ohjelmistokehityksessä. Kykyä hahmottaa laajoja teknisiä kokonaisuuksia, tehdä perusteltuja ratkaisuja ja viedä niitä käytäntöön yhdessä muiden asiantuntijoiden kanssa. Hyvää suomen ja englannin kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa. Eduksi katsomme Kokemuksen WinCC OA -järjestelmästä ja sen ohjelmistokehityksestä. Kokemuksen automaatiojärjestelmien konfiguroinnista ja toimintaperiaatteista. Kokemuksen energiantuotannon tai muiden kriittisten teollisten järjestelmien parissa työskentelystä. Kokemuksen Databricks-ympäristöstä sekä data-alustan ja operatiivisten järjestelmien välisistä dataratkaisuista. Tarjoamme sinulle Tässä tehtävässä pääset vaikuttamaan konkreettisesti energiantuotannon ohjausjärjestelmien tulevaisuuteen. Roolissa yhdistyvät käytännön ohjelmistokehitys, tekninen vetovastuu ja mahdollisuus kehittää toimintatapoja sekä järjestelmien laatua ja toimintavarmuutta. Työskentelet monipuolisessa ympäristössä, jossa SCADA ja automaatio, moderni ohjelmistokehitys, data-alusta ja energiajärjestelmän optimointi kytkeytyvät yhä tiiviimmin yhteen. Pääset nauttimaan myös erilaisista henkilöstöeduistamme, kuten henkilöstösähköstä, hyväntekeväisyystyöpäivästä, etätyömahdollisuudesta ulkomailla ja hyvinvointiedusta. Toimistomme sijaitsee Ruoholahden We Landissa, ja työskentelemme joustavasti hybridimallilla. Tehtävän palkka määritellään tehtävän vaativuuden sekä osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi perusteella. Voit kysyä meillä työskentelystä tai tehtävästä tarkemmin tulevalta esihenkilöltäsi (Jouni Rantalankila / etunimi.sukunimi@helen.fi) sähköpostitse. Kiinnostuitko? Mahtavaa! Voit hakea rekryjärjestelmämme kautta viimeistään 22.11.2026. Huomioithan, että käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana. Toivottavasti kuulemme sinusta pian!

jobs.title: Morgenfrisk medarbejder til vores biludlejning.
jobs.description:
Hos Oscar Biludlejning søger vi en til en medarbejdere til vores afdelinger i Hørsholm og Birkerød, der trives med ansvar, kan arbejde selvstændigt og sætter en ære i, at tingene er i orden.

Du bliver den person, der sørger for, at vores biler står klar til kunderne – rene, velholdte og klar til afhentning fra morgenstunden. Vores kunder forventer en god oplevelse, og den starter med en bil, der lever op til en høj standard.

Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at:

  • Tjekke biler ind og ud

  • Registrere eventuelle skader, kilometerstand og brændstofniveau

  • Kontrollere bilernes generelle stand og være opmærksom på rengøring og eventuel røglugt

  • Rengøre og tanke bilerne efter behov

  • Klargøre bilerne til næste udlejning

  • Håndtere nøgler og den digitale nøgleboks

  • Holde øje med dæk, olie og øvrige væsker

  • Hjælpe med at få biler til og fra værksted, når der er behov for det

Hos Oscar Biludlejning udlejer vi primært brugte biler, men derfor skal standarden stadig være høj. Vi forventer, at vores biler er præsentable, driftssikre og klar til brug – hver eneste dag.

Et job med frihed og ansvar:

Du får ansvaret for den daglige drift i både Birkerød og Hørsolm, og planlægger i høj grad selv dit arbejde. Stillingen er på cirka 2–3 timer om dagen, mandag til fredag. Nogle dage tager det lidt kortere tid, andre dage lidt længere.

Arbejdet ligger primært om morgenen, og du skal være indstillet på at starte tidligt, så bilerne er klar til kunderne omkring kl. 08.00. Til gengæld har du tidligt fri.

En del af opgaverne kan følges og planlægges hjemmefra via app og e-mail, og bor du tæt på afdelingen, vil du ofte kunne forberede meget af arbejdet aftenen før.

Derudover vil du hver anden weekend have ansvaret for to afdelinger. Opgaverne vil fortsat ligge om morgenen, og tidsforbruget vil være nogenlunde det samme.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er selvstændig og tager ansvar for dine opgaver

  • Har øje for detaljer og høje kvalitetsstandarder

  • Er praktisk anlagt og kan lide at have orden omkring dig

  • Er fleksibel og hjælpsom over for kolleger

  • Har kørekort til almindelig personbil

  • Ikke er bange for store varevogne (alle biler er max 3.500 kg. til alm. kørekort)

Vi søger først og fremmest en medarbejder, der har lyst til at blive hos os i længere tid. Derfor vægter vi stabilitet og engagement højt.

Stillingen kan være særligt interessant for dig, der er førtidspensionist, efterlønner eller pensionist, og som ønsker et fleksibelt deltidsjob med faste rutiner, ansvar og kontakt til mennesker.

Du vil naturligvis få grundig oplæring, så du føler dig tryg i opgaverne og godt klædt på til rollen.

Kunne det være noget for dig?

Så send os en ansøgning og fortæl lidt om dig selv og din motivation for at blive en del af Oscar Biludlejning.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette person.

jobs.title: Älskar du massage och vill bli en del av vårt fina team?
jobs.description: Har du massage i händerna och värme i hjärtat? Älskar du ditt yrke, mötet med människor och känslan av att kunna göra verklig skillnad för någon annan? Då kanske du är den vi söker!Vi söker en erfaren och engagerad massageterapeut som vill bli en del av vårt härliga team på Kroppsbalans i Luleå. Vi hoppas hitta dig som är trygg i ditt hantverk, har ett genuint intresse för människor och vill arbeta på en plats där vi trivs, hjälps åt och utvecklas tillsammans.Tjänstens omfattning: 50–100 %, enligt överenskommelse.Om KroppsbalansKroppsbalans grundades av Anneli Selberg år 2000. Passionen för naturlig läkekraft väcktes redan under barndomen hos mormor i Armasjärvi i Tornedalen, där bärdoft, läkeväxter och berättelser om läkande händer lade grunden till en livslång kärlek till massage och välmående.Efter starten i Göteborg gick färden hem till Norrbotten. Sedan 2008 driver vi Kroppsbalans i Luleå och sedan 2022 även i Boden. I dag erbjuder vi massage, friskvård, träning och behandlingar med inspiration från den arktiska naturens lugn och kraft.Om rollenHos oss får du arbeta med ditt hantverk i en miljö där kvalitet, omtanke och personligt bemötande står i centrum. Du möter människor med olika behov och anpassar dina behandlingar för att ge varje kund en trygg och professionell upplevelse.Du blir en del av ett erfaret team där vi stöttar varandra, delar kunskap och tillsammans skapar en trivsam arbetsplats och fina kundupplevelser.Dina arbetsuppgifter:    Utföra avslappnande och behandlande massage utifrån kundens behov.    Ge personligt bemötande och skapa förtroende i varje kundmöte.    Ge råd om lämpliga behandlingar och produkter.    Bidra till ett gott samarbete och en välfungerande verksamhet. Arbetet följer schema och viss helgtjänstgöring förekommer.Vem söker vi?Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av massage, känner dig trygg i din yrkesroll och tycker om att göra ett riktigt bra jobb. Du är lyhörd, ansvarstagande och har en naturlig känsla för service.För oss är det viktigt att du både uppskattar ditt eget hantverk och vill bidra till gemenskapen. jobs.title: Vi søker engasjerte salgsmedarbeidere
jobs.description:
Om jobben

Er du sulten på salg og motiveres av egne prestasjoner? Så bra, da har vi en spennende mulighet til deg! Vi søker deg som skal hjelpe kundene våre med å skape deres drømmebadet. Som salgsmedarbeider i vår butikk får du en variert arbeidshverdag med alt fra salg og kundekommunikasjon, ordrehåndtering og pakking. Vi har en ambisjon om at Right Price Tiles skal være det foretrukne valget for kunden når det kommer til å få mest verdi for pengene. Med det betyr det at vi skal være best på pris, service og inspirasjon.

 

Hvordan ser en typisk arbeidsdag ut:

  • Hjelpe kunder med å velge riktige fliser, baderomsprodukter og gulv for deres prosjekt

  • Salg og håndtering av kundeordre

  • Pakke og forberede utlevering av varer til kunder

  • Gi enkle råd om oppussing og interiørløsninger

  • Samarbeide med teamet for å oppnå salgs- og kundetilfredshetsmål

  • Holde butikk og utstillinger ryddige og inspirerende

Vi tror at du:

  • Har salgsevner, eller ønsker å utvikle det

  • Har en positiv innstilling og ønsker å bidra til et godt arbeidsmiljø

  • Interesse for oppussing og interiør er en fordel

  • Har god fysikk. Det er en del løfting og pakking av varer

  • Trives med høyt tempo og et godt miljø

  • Har god språkkunnskap i norsk

Hvorfor jobbe i Right Price Tiles?

  • Full opplæring i salg og produkter

  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser

  • Godt arbeidsmiljø med faglig, dyktige og engasjerte kolleger

  • Mulighet for karriereutvikling i selskapet. Hos oss kan du stige i gradene 

  • Bygger lagfølelsen med sosiale sammenkomster gjennom året

Vi hjelper deg til å bli god

Kunnskapsrike og trygge ansatte er viktig for oss. Derfor vil du hos oss få den nødvendige opplæringen i både produkter, salgstrening og flis- og baderomsbransjen. Dette gjøres gjennom årlig felles samling for alle ansatte, leverandørbesøk og produktopplæring i butikk. Vi har stor tro på deg som ansatt. Om du etterhvert ønsker å utvikle deg i bedriften, så har vi vår egen RPT-skole med ytterligere opplæring for å bli assisterende butikkleder og butikkleder. I tillegg har vi ulike salgskonkurranser med premier om å være med på sosial reise. Her får du muligheten til å bli enda bedre kjent med flisbransjen og møte leverandører.

Vi har plass til alle

I Right Price Tiles møter du en engasjert lavpriskjede som tar både kunder og ansatte på alvor. I tillegg er vi en bedrift preget av felleskap og mangfold. Hos oss er det plass til alle – uavhengig av kjønn, hvor du kommer ifra, hva du tror på eller hvem du elsker.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Siden 2005 har Right Price Tiles jobbet for at alle skal få realisert oppussingdrømmen. Vi er spesialist på flis og baderom, med stort produktutvalg og varer på lager. I tillegg tilbyr vi laminat, utstyr og tilbehør. Kvalitet og design trenger ikke å koste skjorta, derfor forhandler vi fram de råeste prisene over hele verden og følger nøye med på interiørtrendene. Med sterk vekst teller vi i dag 14 butikker og nettbutikk, og har fornøyde kunder over hele Norge.

jobs.description: Kiinteistöhuoltomies / putkiasentajaHaemme Laten KH-Palvelut Oy tiimiin **ammattitaitoista kiinteistöhuoltomiestä / putkiasentajaa vakituiseen ja kokoaikaiseen työsuhteeseen** Tuusulan, Keravan ja Järvenpään alueelle.Työ on monipuolista kiinteistöjen päivittäistä huolto- ja kunnossapitotyötä. Etsimme henkilöä, joka pystyy työskentelemään itsenäisesti omissa vastuukohteissaan ja jolla on tavallisen kiinteistöhuollon lisäksi **hyvä käytännön osaaminen LVI- ja putkitöistä**.Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat esimerkiksi:- asuin- ja muiden kiinteistöjen päivittäiset huolto- ja korjaustyöt - vikailmoitusten hoitaminen ja vikojen selvittäminen - kiinteistöjen tekniset tarkastukset ja huoltokierrokset - hanojen, WC-istuinten, vesilukkojen ja muiden vesikalusteiden huolto ja vaihto - venttiilien ja muiden LVI-laitteiden huolto- ja vaihtotyöt - vuotojen ja muiden putkisto-ongelmien selvittäminen sekä pienet putkikorjaukset - lämmitys- ja käyttövesijärjestelmiin liittyvät huoltotyöt osaamisen ja pätevyyksien mukaisesti - muut kiinteistöhuoltoon kuuluvat pienet korjaus- ja kunnossapitotyöt - tehtyjen töiden ja havaintojen kirjaaminen huoltojärjestelmään Mitä odotamme sinulta?Etsimme ennen kaikkea **oma-aloitteista ja ammattitaitoista tekijää**, joka osaa ratkaista ongelmia myös itsenäisesti. Tässä työssä ei riitä pelkästään vikojen toteaminen, vaan toivomme, että pystyt selvittämään niiden syyn ja mahdollisuuksien mukaan myös korjaamaan ne.Toivomme sinulta:- aikaisempaa kokemusta kiinteistöhuollosta ja/tai LVI-alalta - käytännön osaamista putki- ja LVI-töistä - teknistä ymmärrystä kiinteistöjen järjestelmistä - kykyä itsenäiseen ja vastuulliseen työskentelyyn - asiakaspalveluhenkistä ja asiallista työotetta - suomen kielen taitoa - B-ajokorttia - valmiutta osallistua tarvittaessa päivystysvuoroihin LVI-alan koulutus ja aikaisempi kokemus putkiasentajan tehtävistä katsotaan vahvaksi eduksi.Mitä tarjoamme?Tarjoamme **vakituista ja monipuolista työtä kasvavassa kiinteistöhuoltoalan yrityksessä**, jossa työpäivät eivät ole samanlaisia. Saat vastuullesi omia kohteita, mutta ympärilläsi on myös muu huolto-organisaatio ja työnjohto.Tarjoamme perehdytyksen tehtävään, työssä tarvittavat välineet ja auton sekä osaamistasi ja kokemustasi vastaavan kilpailukykyisen palkan.**Työpaikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.**Lähetä hakemuksesi, CV ja palkkatoiveesi sähköpostitse osoitteeseen **huolto@latenpalvelut.fi**.

jobs.title: Vi søker tannhelseassistent i 50% vikariat

Tannlege Angelus AS i Namsos søker tannhelseassistent i 50 % vikariat!

Er du blid, serviceinnstilt og liker å jobbe med mennesker? Da kan du være den vi leter etter!

Vi tilbyr en variert og spennende arbeidshverdag i et hyggelig arbeidsmiljø, hvor pasientene står i sentrum.

Hva vi ser etter 🦷 Hvem ser vi etter?

Er du en positiv lagspiller med et smil på lur og hjertet på rett sted? Da kan du være vår nye kollega!

Vi ser etter deg som:

✅ Er blid, omsorgsfull og liker å jobbe med mennesker.

✅ Er serviceinnstilt og får pasientene til å føle seg trygge og velkomne.

✅ Er strukturert, nøyaktig og har øye for detaljer.

✅ Trives med en variert og til tider hektisk arbeidshverdag.

✅ Er fleksibel, løsningsorientert og tar initiativ.

✅ Har gode samarbeidsevner, men også kan arbeide selvstendig.

✅ Har gode norskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig.

Erfaring fra tannhelsetjenesten er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Vi legger stor vekt på personlig egnethet, engasjement og vilje til å lære.

Det viktigste for oss er ikke bare hva du kan fra før, men hvem du er, og hva du kan bidra med!

Hos oss skal både pasienter og medarbeidere føle seg sett, verdsatt og godt ivaretatt.

Arbeidsoppgaver 🦷 En variert arbeidsdag der du gjør en forskjell!

Hos Tannlege Angelus AS i Namsos blir du en viktig del av et engasjert team som brenner for god tannhelse og fornøyde pasienter!

Ingen arbeidsdager er helt like, og du får en spennende kombinasjon av pasientkontakt, klinisk arbeid og administrative oppgaver.

Dine arbeidsoppgaver vil blant annet være:

  • Assistere tannlegen ved ulike typer tannbehandling.

  • Ta imot pasienter og bidra til at de føler seg trygge og godt ivaretatt.

  • Klargjøre behandlingsrom, instrumenter og utstyr.

  • Sørge for gode rutiner innen hygiene, sterilisering og smittevern.

  • Håndtere timebestillinger, telefonhenvendelser og resepsjonsarbeid.

  • Bidra til god pasientflyt og en effektiv klinikkhverdag.

Hos oss er du mer enn en assistent -- du er en viktig del av pasientopplevelsen!

Vi ser etter deg som har godt humør, tar initiativ og liker å kombinere faglig nøyaktighet med omsorg for mennesker.

Vil du ha en jobb der både faglighet, samarbeid og arbeidsglede står i sentrum? Da vil vi gjerne høre fra deg!

Vi tilbyr 🦷 Hva kan Tannlege Angelus AS tilby deg?

Hos oss får du mer enn bare en jobb -- du blir en viktig del av et hyggelig og engasjert team!

Vi tilbyr:

✅ Et godt arbeidsmiljø med hyggelige kolleger og fokus på samarbeid og trivsel.

✅ En variert og meningsfull arbeidshverdag med spennende oppgaver og tett pasientkontakt.

✅ Faglig utvikling med mulighet til å lære nye ferdigheter og utvikle deg innen tannhelsefaget.

✅ Moderne arbeidsforhold i en veletablert privat tannklinikk.

✅ En miljøbevisst arbeidsplass -- vi er stolte av å være Miljøfyrtårnsertifisert!

✅ En 50 % stilling som gir mulighet for god balanse mellom jobb og fritid.

Hos Tannlege Angelus AS verdsetter vi arbeidsglede, faglig kvalitet og omsorg for både pasienter og medarbeidere.

Bli en del av laget vårt -- vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

🦷 Om Tannlege Angelus AS

Tannlege Angelus AS er en veletablert, moderne og kvalitetsbevisst privat tannklinikk i Namsos. Hos oss arbeider tannlege, tannpleier og dyktige medarbeidere sammen for å gi pasientene trygg og individuell tannbehandling i et hyggelig miljø.

Vi er stolte av å være Miljøfyrtårnsertifisert, noe som gjenspeiler vårt engasjement for bærekraft og miljøansvar i tannhelsetjenesten.

Klinikkens eier og tannlege har også et sterkt faglig engasjement gjennom tillitsverv i Den norske tannlegeforening, blant annet som leder av Nord-Trøndelag tannlegeforening.

Hos oss står faglig kvalitet, omsorg, arbeidsglede og personlig service i sentrum. Vi er en arbeidsplass der samarbeid, trivsel og engasjement verdsettes høyt.

  • Plan and promote webinars, conferences, and events in collaboration with our consultants and partners.

  • Manage LinkedIn and other digital marketing activities to increase awareness and generate leads.

  • Collaborate closely with our sales team to support lead generation, opportunity development, and customer engagement.

  • Track marketing performance and continuously improve campaigns based on measurable results.

Vi tilbyr

  • Professional development: Build your expertise in digital marketing, marketing automation, and emerging technologies.

  • Competitive compensation: Salary based on qualifications and experience.

Infotechtion delivers data and AI discovery solutions and managed services that help organizations understand their data, reduce exposure, and govern AI with confidence.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative / SDR (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
TL;DR – Wir entwickeln KI-gestützte Fachkräfte für das Gesundheitswesen von morgen. Unsere KI-Rezeptionistin Luna automatisiert bereits heute die Patientenkommunikation in Arztpraxen. Nachdem wir uns als Marktführer in der Zahnmedizin etabliert haben, gehen wir jetzt den nächsten großen Schritt: neue medizinische Fachbereiche, neue Länder, neue Produkte. Als Sales Development Representative bist du der erste persönliche Kontakt für Praxen, die Interesse an Luna zeigen: du rufst unsere eingehenden Leads an, begeisterst sie für unser Produkt und bringst sie in eine Demo. Damit legst du den Grundstein für unseren gesamten Vertrieb.

Wieso praxipal?

Der Fachkräftemangel ist die größte Herausforderung für unser Gesundheitswesen. Zehntausende Stellen bleiben jedes Jahr unbesetzt und der demografische Wandel sorgt dafür, dass sich diese Entwicklung immer weiter zuspitzt. Arztpraxen setzen auf unsere KI-Rezeptionistin Luna, um ihr Personal zu entlasten und die Versorgung für alle zugänglich zu halten.

Wir sind ein tech-driven Unternehmen und setzen bewusst auf ein kleines, hochtalentiertes Team. Was uns ausmacht, ist das Tempo und die Intensität, mit der wir arbeiten, aber ebenso wichtig ist uns das Miteinander. Deshalb kommen wir jeden Tag ins Büro: um uns auszutauschen, voneinander zu lernen und gemeinsam zu wachsen.

Was du tun wirst

In einem Satz: du verwandelst das Interesse unserer eingehenden Leads in gebuchte Demos – und wächst dabei selbst schnell in mehr Verantwortung rein.

  • Du rufst unsere Inbound-Leads an und bringst sie in eine Demo

  • Du bist schnell am Telefon, gehst neue Leads zügig an und bleibst hartnäckig dran, bis der Termin steht

  • Du qualifizierst Leads, verstehst ihre Situation und weckst Begeisterung für Luna

  • Du steuerst deine Pipeline mit vielen offenen Kontakten, bleibst mit sauberen Follow-ups am Ball und pflegst unser CRM

  • Du baust einen wiederholbaren Prozess auf, testest Gesprächsleitfäden und schärfst laufend, wie wir Leads am besten überzeugen

Wonach wir suchen

  • Du bringst erste Vertriebs- oder Telefonerfahrung mit

  • Du liebst das Telefon, führst gerne viele Gespräche am Tag und lässt dich von einem „Nein" nicht bremsen

  • Du bist hartnäckig und diszipliniert bei Follow-ups, kein Lead geht bei dir verloren

  • Du packst gerne selbst an und scheust dich auch vor unglamourösen Aufgaben nicht

  • Du kommunizierst sicher und überzeugend auf Deutsch und Englisch, schriftlich wie mündlich

  • Du willst 5 Tage die Woche vor Ort in Berlin arbeiten

Deine Vorteile

  • Kompetitives Grundgehalt plus attraktive, ungedeckelte Provision und Beteiligung an unserem VSOP-Programm

  • Steile Lernkurve: du baust unseren Sales-Prozess von Grund auf mit auf und wächst mit außergewöhnlichem Tempo in mehr Verantwortung rein

  • Zusammenarbeit mit einem starken, motivierten Team und viele Wachstumsmöglichkeiten

  • Urban Sports Club

  • Deutschland-Ticket Jobticket

  • Lunch-Zuschuss via Lunchit und gemeinsame Abendessen auf Firmenkosten

  • Regelmäßige Team Events und Offsites

Compensation: €60K – €70K • Offers Equity • Offers Commission

About the role

Luminovo builds the B2B SaaS platform that powers the electronics supply chain. DACH is our home market and one of our strongest, and we’re adding an Account Executive to the German-speaking team.

Unlike traditional transactional sales, you'll be selling complex supply chain software to technical buyers—requiring deep discovery, consultative selling, and the ability to prove measurable ROI in a trillion-dollar industry. You'll sell software that directly impacts how electronics companies—from automotive suppliers to industrial equipment manufacturers—manage their complete electronics supply chain. The impact is tangible, the industry is fascinating, and the growth trajectory is yours to shape.

Who you are

  • You’ve sold B2B software, and you can walk through your own numbers from memory: quota, attainment, average deal size, how long your ramp took

  • You’ve built something that didn’t exist before you — a segment, a first playbook, a function nobody had staffed, a company of your own. You’re more comfortable without a playbook than with an inherited one

  • You’ve been close to how electronics or physical products actually get made — manufacturing, hardware, or supply chain. A bonus rather than a must, and the strongest single signal we look for, because it’s what lets you find the pain before a customer names it

  • You’re consultative by instinct. Our buyers rarely arrive knowing they have a problem worth solving, so short cycles with demo-ready buyers aren’t the motion here

  • You work in German and English at a professional level. Discovery, demos, and negotiation happen in German; the company runs in English

Your potential growth path:

  • Months 1-6: Master the product, close your first 5-10 deals, build your DACH network

  • Months 6-18: Take on larger deals, navigate complex stakeholder environments, mentor BDRs

  • 18+ months: Transition to Enterprise AE (€100k+ deals), own strategic accounts, mentor junior AEs

Your performance objectives

📣 Generate pipeline

  • Build your network. Connect with 50+ relevant decision-makers at electronics manufacturers per quarter through industry events, LinkedIn, and targeted outreach. Establish Luminovo's presence at 2-3 key industry fairs annually.

  • Generate qualified pipeline. Create €240k-€400k in qualified pipeline ARR per quarter (depending on seniority) through outbound prospecting, events, and inbound lead qualification using SPICED discovery.

  • Qualify with precision. Run customer-centric discovery to uncover Situation, Pain, Impact, Critical event, and Decision criteria. Quantify potential value before investing in lengthy sales cycles.

💪 Close opportunities

  • Inspire with demos. Deliver product demonstrations tailored to each customer's pain points. Clearly articulate our competitive positioning.

  • Prove measurable value. Collaborate with domain experts to run workshops that demonstrate ROI through concrete impact calculations (time savings, cost reductions, efficiency gains).

  • Close strategically. Guide prospects through complex buyer journeys, map stakeholders, and turn negotiations into win-win outcomes. Close €60k-€100k in new ARR per quarter (depending on seniority) with smooth handovers to Customer Success.

💡 Build expertise

  • Become an industry insider. Develop deep knowledge of electronics supply chains and feed customer insights back to product teams.

  • Master consultative selling. Make SPICED your guiding principle and build expertise in technical SaaS sales with longer cycles and multi-stakeholder decisions.

📈 Lead by example

  • Own your metrics. Monitor pipeline health, conversion rates, and deal velocity. Use data to consistently hit quarterly targets.

  • Enable your peers. Mentor junior AEs through shadowing and deal reviews. Contribute to our sales playbook.

  • Embrace feedback. Reflect on every major customer interaction and proactively seek coaching to maximize impact.

🇪🇺 Your territory

You'll primarily cover the German-speaking market (DACH), with some English-speaking territories. Fluency in 🇩🇪 German and 🇬🇧 English is essential.

 

📍 Work location

Munich headquarters or Berlin satellite office (both in hybrid setup with home-office flexibility). Our sales team meets in the office three days per week. Occasional travel for team retreats and industry events (expenses covered).

 

Whom you'll be working with

  • Clifton Lobo, VP Global Sales — Your manager who'll coach you on deal strategy and career progression

  • Sebastian Schaal, Co-Founder — Provides strategic guidance on positioning and pricing

  • Inga Schwarz, Team Lead and Pioneer AE for OEM — Your primary partner in building the OEM sales playbook

  • Max Hungenbach and RevOps — Provide CRM support, dashboards, and sales enablement

  • Marketing, Customer Success & Product teams — Regular collaboration on campaigns, customer onboarding, and product roadmap

💡 Skills, knowledge, and expertise

Just so you know—we purposefully did not create a standard list of minimum qualifications for this role. We care much more about your motivation and ability to help us accelerate technical progress than we care about your CV.

If you're interested to find out more about why we banned requirements from our performance profiles—see here.

⚡️ About Luminovo

Luminovo is the first electronics supply chain platform that unites all data, processes, and stakeholders in the trillion-dollar electronics industry.

We fundamentally believe that technology is the best tool that humankind has developed to tackle the biggest challenges we face as a society today. And we want to do our share in accelerating technological progress.

We bring innovations to life faster and cheaper by creating a more connected and resilient electronics supply chain.

To date, over 300 active customers worldwide are working with us towards this shared goal. Supported by leading investors such as Cherry Ventures, General Catalyst/LaFamiglia, Chalfen Ventures, and others, we have raised more than €20 million.

Our core principles: putting people first & building great things

As a remote-first company headquartered in Munich, our brilliant team is spread across cities including Munich, New York, Austin, Calgary, Berlin, London, Valencia, Nairobi, and Verona, among others. 🌍

Our team includes a mix of product enthusiasts, people advocates, business masterminds, and engineering experts. Among us are graduates from institutions like Stanford University and the University of Cambridge, as well as talented individuals with unconventional CVs. What matters most is their drive to build great things.

We provide an authentic environment based on psychological safety to empower Luminerds from various backgrounds to succeed, grow, and focus on impact. Putting people first means that we deeply care about who our employees are, what makes them unique, and what they excel at.

jobs.title: VP, Strategic Finance
jobs.description:
Team: Finance (G&A)

Reports to: Chief Financial Officer

Location: London, Amsterdam or Stockholm. Remote-first, with travel as and when needed

About Nivoda

Nivoda is the B2B marketplace rebuilding how the jewellery industry works. We connect independent jewellery retailers with a global network of diamond and gemstone suppliers, so a jeweller in Denver or Devon can source from anywhere in the world without the cost, risk, and hassle of doing it the old way. We handle the logistics, the payments, and the quality checks, the messy middle that used to put global sourcing out of reach for small businesses.

Today we process over $300M in transactions a year in a $350B industry that still runs largely on personal relationships and paperwork. We are growing quickly, we are backed by leading investors, and we are only getting started.

We built Nivoda so every jeweller, whatever their size and wherever they are, has access to the same global supply, pricing and tools as the biggest players.

Why this role & why now

You will sit on the Extended Leadership Team, report to the CFO, and own how Nivoda plans, reports and is funded. You will present to the board, investors and our receivables lender yourself, work directly with the CFO on equity and debt financing, and build a finance function that runs on routine rather than heroics. This is for someone who wants to lead a team and shape the company’s financial story, not only model it.

What you will own

Planning and forecasting. You own the annual budget, quarterly reforecast and long-range plan, plus scenario and funding cases for the C-suite and board. You are accountable for forecast accuracy against agreed tolerances, and for an honest post-mortem whether we miss or overachieve.

Board, investor and lender reporting. You own the monthly board pack and the numbers behind it, plus materials for existing and prospective investors and our receivables lender, including covenant reporting and onsite diligence. You present to these audiences yourself and you are their first call for analytical questions. The aim is that they trust the numbers without the CFO needing to vouch for them.

Corporate finance. You build the models and documentation for equity and debt financing, analyse term sheets, work with the People team on cap table and option pool, and support the CFO on transactions.

Commercial and unit economics. You own cohort economics, customer lifetime value, geographic and segment profitability, and the return on marketing and sales spend. With the CRO’s organisation, you build quota and commission models so targets, incentives and the forecast point at the same numbers.

Business partnering. You partner with Product and Engineering, Fulfilment, Fintech and the commercial teams on build versus buy, hiring cases, pricing and fee experiments, and capital allocation. The function says yes, no or not yet, with a model behind it.

Leading the function. You lead the team: hiring, onboarding, objectives, development and performance, including written objectives and regular structured feedback for each person. You set the review standard and deliverables calendar, agree data contracts with the Data team, and own the tooling (Snowflake, NetSuite, ThoughtSpot, Claude and the modelling stack). We measure the function on on-time delivery, errors caught internally rather than by the audience, forecast accuracy, and how many people can produce each recurring deliverable.

What good looks like

First 90 days. You have taken over the monthly pack and the reforecast without the investors noticing a handover. You have met your leadership-team peers and told the CFO what you would change and in what order.

90 to 180 days. The monthly pack, FP&A-approved numbers and lender reporting land on the agreed date, each with a named owner and a written process. No board, lender or investor number has needed restating. The first version of the business line P&Ls is delivered at day 180.

Twelve months. The function delivers month-end and board commitments without you or the CFO stepping in, including when you are away. A team member has delivered a new analytical capability end to end. FP&A and the Data team work from one set of metric definitions. Board members, lenders and the leadership team rely on the numbers without asking the CFO to vouch for them.

The standard

A finance team has no quota. The thing it sells is trust, and trust is earned with accuracy a bar above the rest of the company and delivery on the date promised.

Three things must not fail in this role.

  • Timeliness: deadlines are commitments, not targets.

  • Quality: every external-facing number reconciles to a primary source and has been reviewed by someone other than its author before it leaves the team.

  • Capacity: within reason, not a constraint. The function absorbs the demands of a 450-person company by organising, prioritising and delegating. If capacity is a hard limit, you make the case for a hire or an automation with numbers, rather than letting the work slip.

That is a high bar, and it is fair because the role comes with the means to meet it: people to delegate to, authority over how the team's week is spent, a budget line, and the standing to say no to the business with the CFO's backing.

What you bring

  • A background in investment banking, FP&A or venture capital, building models that senior stakeholders made decisions on.

  • You have led a team, directly or through managers, and you want the management part of this role.

  • You have presented to boards, investors or lenders as the person answering the question, not the person who built the slide.

  • A working understanding of marketplace dynamics: two-sided liquidity, take rates, usage-based revenue without a contract, and what FX does to all of it. Complex cohort modelling is native to you.

  • You are comfortable in Snowflake and a modern BI tool, you treat AI tooling as part of the stack, and you would rather fix the pipeline than reformat the output every month.

  • You are calm under pressure, low on ego and allergic to spin. You tell people the uncomfortable thing early.

Useful but not required: receivables financing or lender reporting, a multi-jurisdiction group, NetSuite, or a business that trades physical goods across borders.

What this role is not

It is not a bigger version of a senior analyst role, and it is not where every difficult model gets built personally. If you are at your best as the smartest modeler in the room and would rather stay that way, this will frustrate you.

It is also not a quiet seat. Month-end, board and lender deadlines are fixed, a 450-person company makes a lot of demands on finance, and you will regularly be the one saying no, with the CFO’s backing. If you want a purely advisory or slower-paced role, this isn’t it.

What we offer

Nivoda is a place where smart, driven people do the best work of their careers. We move fast, give ownership early, and don’t have layers of bureaucracy slowing things down. If you see a problem, you can fix it.

Our current benefits include:

  • Flexible working hours and a vibrant, remote-first company culture

  • Unlimited holiday allowance

  • Participation in our equity programme

  • Genuine opportunities for growth: we promote from within and invest in your development

  • The chance to join during an expansion phase and shape how Nivoda operates at scale

Interview Process

  • Screening conversation with Talent Acquisition

  • Structured career-history interview with Hiring Manager

  • Focus interview: you present a case study to a panel from Finance and the leadership team

  • Final conversation with the C-suite

Equal opportunity

Nivoda is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.

If you meet most of this description and not all of it, apply anyway and tell us where the gaps are.

Please submit your CV in English.

Not the right role? Join our Talent Pool

If this isn’t quite the right fit but you’re excited about what Nivoda is building, we’d still love to hear from you. Join our Talent Pool and we’ll reach out when the right opportunity comes along.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

 

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • Work on a civilisation-scale problem - Clean, baseload fusion energy is one of the few genuinely world-changing challenges, and every hire in Finance, People, or Legal directly accelerates the path to a working stellarator.

  • Grow as fast as the company does - With headcount set to roughly 5x in a few years and major technical milestones ahead on the path to our demo machine and first power plant, your role grows under you; today's hire is tomorrow's function lead.

  • Tackle problems that don't exist elsewhere - Fusion sits at a rare intersection of deep-tech R&D, industrial procurement, government relations, and venture financing, so non-tech functions face challenges no other workplace can offer.

YOUR IMPACT

As a microwave design engineer, you will help build the basis for the millimeter wave hardware acting as the spark plug that initiates a fusion plasma and raises its temperature to greater than 100 million degrees. You’ll join the Alpha Heating System team ready to drive the integrated RF and thermo-mechanical design of high-power components, and help build and test these components in the lab before installing them at scale on our net scientific gain Alpha stellarator.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Provide innovative solutions to complex RF engineering challenges by collaborating closely with physicists to ensure component designs meet the Alpha plasma physics and thermal-mechanical constraints.

  • Develop designs and evaluate vendor designs to determine an optimal path to efficiently deliver our power to the stellarator - driving down the denominator of input power that will limit fusion power plant gain Q=Pout/Pin - and drive down costs.

  • Draw from and contribute to our stellarator development process, interfacing your RF components with other stellarator systems.

  • Contribute to mechanical and thermal analysis and sensitivity studies for component viability under the loads and stresses imposed by the combination of vacuum, magnetic fields, temperatures, and MW-scale RF loads.

  • Interface with the Alpha project management teams to realize the delivery of RF components and meet the tight Proxima timelines.

WHO YOU ARE

  • A highly capable RF engineer with experience in millimeter waves and knowledge of the tools and best practices for design of these systems

  • Demonstrated familiarly with RF modeling codes - SURF3D, CST, COMSOL, GdfidL, openEMS, even self-developed python codes or ones plasma physics community hasn’t heard of - capable of performing modeling at 200 GHz frequencies

  • Experience validating first-of-a-kind designs with uncertain performance, working as part of a team on multi-scale and multi-physics simulations, testing, and prototyping.

  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly and persuasively.

  • Experience with gyrotrons and associated components - transmission systems, launcher antennas, rf loads; experience with plasma physics is a plus.

  • Understanding of quasi optical propagation of millimeter waves; ray tracing and where it breaks down

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

jobs.title: Senior business analyst - deadline 03/11/2026
jobs.description:
Job description :

We are looking for an experienced Business Analyst to work closely with Product Owners, business stakeholders, Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), and technical teams to analyze business needs, define requirements, and ensure successful delivery of features within an Agile/SAFe environment.

The role involves managing the product backlog, preparing and refining user stories, facilitating requirements workshops, supporting PI Planning and sprint execution, and coordinating User Acceptance Testing (UAT). The ideal candidate will have knowledge of Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Apps, Power BI, Power Pages, and Dataverse, as well as the ability to leverage AI tools to improve requirements gathering and business process analysis.

Key responsibilities :

  • Requirements Gathering & Analysis: Collaborate with business stakeholders, Product Owners, and SMEs to gather, analyze, validate, and document business and technical requirements.

  • Feature & Backlog Management: Analyze upcoming roadmap features, identify business value, dependencies, risks, and gaps, and continuously refine the product backlog.

  • User Stories & Acceptance Criteria: Create and refine Epics, Features, and User Stories with clear scope, detailed acceptance criteria, dependencies, and relevant functional and non-functional requirements.

  • Business Process Documentation: Prepare process flows (as-is/to-be), mockups, business rules, data mappings, impact assessments, and other supporting documentation as required.

  • Microsoft Power Platform: Understand Power Apps (Canvas and Model-driven), Power BI, Power Pages, Dataverse, access structures, data models, solution architecture, and inbound/outbound data flows.

  • Agile & SAFe Delivery: Participate in PI Planning, backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily meetings, system demos, and other Agile/SAFe ceremonies.

  • PI Preparation: Support pre-PI planning activities, identify knowledge gaps and dependencies, prepare refinement materials, and coordinate with relevant teams to ensure feature readiness.

  • Definition of Ready & Definition of Done: Ensure that User Stories meet the agreed Definition of Ready (DoR) before entering a sprint and contain the necessary information to support the Definition of Done (DoD).

  • Technical & Cross-Team Coordination: Collaborate with development leads, testers, Product Owners, and other teams to clarify technical feasibility, resolve dependencies, and maintain alignment on scope and responsibilities.

  • User Acceptance Testing (UAT): Prepare UAT scenarios, use cases, and sample test data; coordinate end-user testing; collect and analyze feedback; and document decisions and follow-up backlog items.

  • Delivery & Release Support: Verify that delivered functionality meets business requirements, prepare sprint release notes, and ensure that documentation, user guidance, and training materials are updated.

  • Documentation & Traceability: Maintain centralized and accessible project documentation in tools such as SharePoint or Wiki, ensuring traceability from Epics and Features through User Stories, acceptance tests, and releases.

  • AI-Assisted Analysis: Use AI capabilities such as Copilot, AI agents, and other relevant tools to support requirements gathering, process analysis, validation of assumptions, and initial solution ideation.

  • Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to simplify business processes, improve requirements quality, and maintain a backlog buffer of approximately 1.5–2 sprints of ready User Stories.


Job requirments:

  • Proven experience as a Business Analyst in Agile/Scrum and SAFe environments.

  • Strong experience in requirements elicitation, stakeholder management, business process analysis, and documentation.

  • Practical knowledge of Microsoft Power Platform, including:

    • Power Apps (Canvas and Model-driven apps)

    • Power BI

    • Power Pages

    • Microsoft Dataverse

    • Data models, access structures, and data integrations.

  • Experience defining and refining Epics, Features, User Stories, and detailed Acceptance Criteria.

  • Knowledge of backlog management, refinement sessions, sprint planning, and PI Planning.

  • Experience with business process modelling, process flows, mockups, business rules, data mappings, and impact assessments.

  • Understanding of functional and non-functional requirements, including performance, scalability, availability, security, auditability, and GDPR/privacy.

  • Knowledge of Definition of Ready (DoR), Definition of Done (DoD), and requirements traceability.

  • Experience supporting UAT, including test scenario preparation, test data coordination, feedback analysis, and defect or backlog item management.

  • Ability to identify dependencies, clarify scope, assess gaps, and coordinate with technical teams and business stakeholders.

  • Familiarity with technical documentation, solution architecture, data models, APIs, and integration flows.

  • Experience using documentation and collaboration tools such as SharePoint, Wiki, and backlog management platforms.

  • Awareness of AI tools, including Copilot and AI agents, for requirements analysis, process improvement, and solution ideation.

  • Strong communication, analytical, facilitation, problem-solving, and organizational skills.

  • Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple features and priorities in a structured delivery environment.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer – Agentic AI
jobs.description:
Tout le monde parle d'IA Agentique, peu savent la faire survivre en production. En tant que Forward Deployed Engineer, tu n'es pas dans un laboratoire : tu es notre force de frappe déployée au cœur du SI de nos clients. chez SFEIR, tu incarnes l'Architecte qui transforme l'ambiguïté technologique en impact métier. 

SFEIR en 30 secondes

  • 950 consultants passionnés par la tech et augmentés par l'IA

  • 8 agences en France, au Luxembourg et à Bruxelles

  • Partenaire Anthropic Preferred (+200 certifiés)

  • 15 ans de partenariat Google Cloud + AWS, Scaleway, S3NS, Databricks, Snowflake, Confluent, DBT

  • +90 clients actifs et +5 000 personnes formées par an via SFEIR Institute

  • 150 certifiés Google Cloud, 30 Google Authorized Trainers, 7 Google Developer Experts

Ta mission

  • Déploiement & Immersion — intervenir directement chez nos clients pour transformer une intention stratégique en résultat mesurable.

  • Orchestration Multi-Agents — concevoir et intégrer des systèmes autonomes avancés (protocole MCP, RAG, function calling).

  • Évaluation & Sécurité — construire des frameworks d'évaluation pour des systèmes non déterministes et garantir la sécurité

  • FinOps IA & ROI — optimiser le compromis entre performance, latence et coût d'inférence.

  • Capitalisation (Land → Expand → Abstract) — abstraire les solutions spécifiques développées chez le client en patterns réutilisables pour le reste de l'entreprise.

Ton terrain de jeu

  • Stack : Python, LangChain / LangGraph, Anthropic (Claude) / Vertex AI, outils MLOps (LangSmith, Langfuse), Docker, CI/CD.

  • Tes outils au quotidien : Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot. Notre partenariat Anthropic te donne accès aux outils et certifications avant tout le monde.

  • Des projets qui sortent : APIs GenAI unifiées, plateformes d'agents d'entreprise déployées chez nos clients au cœur de leur SI. Du concret, pas des PoC qui finissent au placard.

Ce qu'on cherche chez toi

  • Les incontournables :

    • 4 ans minimum d’expérience 

    • Une expérience concrète de déploiement de systèmes intégrant des agents IA en production.

  • Le mindset :

    • Impact & Pragmatisme : tu as le sens du contexte client, tu sais vulgariser face à des interlocuteurs métiers ou exécutifs.

    • Gouvernance & Rigueur : tu refuses un code non explicable par un agent, tu encadres l'autonomie de l'IA selon le niveau de risque métier.

    • L'esprit 10x :  tu automatises systématiquement les tâches à faible valeur pour te concentrer sur l'architecture et les problèmes complexes.

Ton évolution

  • Une trajectoire au choix : Staff Engineer / Principal Engineer ou Engineering Manager

  • SFEIR Institute & C4E : formation continue et certifications (Claude Code, Dev Augmenté, Google Cloud)

  • Le programme AI Champions : 6 mois pour rejoindre notre cercle d'ambassadeurs IA et propulser ton impact, en interne comme en externe

Prêt(e) à devenir un(e) Sfeirian 10x ?
