jobs.description:
SFEIR est un cabinet d'expertise technologique spécialisé dans la conception, l'architecture et l'industrialisation de solutions numériques sur-mesure. Nous accompagnons les organisations dans leurs transformations les plus complexes en combinant la rigueur du Software Craftsmanship avec la maîtrise des technologies d'avenir. Convaincus que la souveraineté numérique est un enjeu stratégique majeur, nous concevons des architectures sécurisées, performantes et indépendantes, portées par des partenariats solides avec des acteurs clés comme SENS et Scaleway. Acteur de référence sur l'intelligence artificielle, nous faisons évoluer les standards d'ingénierie modernes. À travers notre plateforme GenAI RAISE et notre statut de partenaire Anthropic Preferred (au sein du Claude Partner Network), nous plaçons le Context Engineering et l'IA générative au cœur de nos pratiques. 

Nos chiffres clés :

  • 950 consultants passionnés par la tech et augmentés par l’IA.

  • 8 agences en France, au Luxembourg et en Belgique.

  • Partenaire Anthropic Select au sein du Claude Partner Network.

  • 15 ans de partenariat avec Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Databricks, Confluent...

  • +5000 personnes formées par an via le SFEIR Institute.

▪️ À propos du poste

Tu conçois et déploies des agents IA et systèmes agentiques complets exécutant des processus métier de bout en bout : support client avancé, recherche multi-sources, opérations IT, ainsi que des cas d'usage avancés liés à l'industrie du futur et à la continuité digitale (ex. traçabilité des exigences, maintenance prédictive, continuité de l'ingénierie et jumeaux numériques). Tu sais aussi bien développer des agents sur-mesure en code que configurer des agents via des plateformes low-code/no-code avec des plateformes type Gemini Enterprise.

Ton terrain d'action combine maîtrise technique du cycle de vie logiciel (SDLC) et compréhension fonctionnelle fine des enjeux métiers. Tu orchestres l'autonomie des agents, la planification, le choix des outils et la mémoire, tout en garantissant la fiabilité, la gouvernance et le respect des garde-fous.

Les missions :

  • Analyser et appréhender les besoins et processus métiers avec une vision fonctionnelle claire pour définir les cas d'usage d'automatisation et la répartition des tâches (autonomie agentique vs validation humaine).

  • Construire les outils des agents : function calling, intégration d’API et de systèmes d’information, création et consommation de serveurs MCP, workflows asynchrones et longue durée.

  • Maîtriser la fiabilité : gestion des erreurs et des reprises, boucles de contrôle, limites de budget et de pas, comportement face à l’imprévu.

  • Évaluer les agents : jeux de scénarios, analyse des trajectoires, taux de réussite des tâches, LLM-as-judge, tests de non-régression à chaque changement de prompt, d’outil ou de modèle.

  • Observer en production : traces détaillées, coûts par tâche, détection des dérives et des boucles, tableaux de bord.

  • Sécuriser l’autonomie : permissions minimales sur les outils, protection contre la prompt injection, isolation des actions sensibles, validation humaine, traçabilité, conformité (RGPD, AI Act).

  • S'intégrer dans le cycle de vie logiciel (SDLC) complet et déployer sur le cloud (Google Cloud / Vertex AI) avec intégration CI/CD et gestion des coûts.

  • Partager : documenter les patterns, former les équipes clientes, contribuer aux publications et événements SFEIR.

▪️ Le profil idéal

  • 5 ans d’expérience en développement logiciel (hors stage et alternance) avec une vision transverse du SDLC et une première expérience solide sur des projets LLM / IA
  • Pratique démontrée de la création d'agents IA : développement custom (frameworks/code) ou création via des environnements low-code/no-code (Gemini Enterprise, AWS,...)
  • Connaissance de MCP et des protocoles d’interopérabilité entre agents (A2A)
  • Compréhension fine des modes d’échec des agents : dérive, boucles, mauvais choix d’outil, perte de contexte
  • Solide maîtrise des API, de l’asynchrone et des architectures événementielles
  • Rigueur d’ingénierie : tests, observabilité, code relu
  • Aisance relationnelle et bon niveau fonctionnel pour échanger avec les équipes métiers, comprendre leurs enjeux et leur expliquer les possibilités et limites des agents IA

Un plus

  • Expérience d’évaluation d’agents et d’observabilité (OpenTelemetry, Langfuse…)
  • Connaissance de la méthodologie BMAD 
  • Google Cloud (Vertex AI, Cloud Run, Gemini),
  • Sensibilité sécurité : modèles de menaces sur les agents, gestion des identités et des permissions
  • Notions de RAG, vues comme un outil de l’agent
  • Contributions open source, side projects agentiques, talks

▪️ L'ancrage Bordelais 

L'agence SFEIR Bordeaux regroupe une quinzaine d'ingénieurs et d'architectes seniors. Tu y trouveras la proximité et l'agilité d'une structure à taille humaine, adossée à la solidité d'un grand groupe. Tu participes activement à l'écosystème tech local (meetups, conférences BDX/IO, SFEIR Talks) et tu peux intégrer le programme AI Champions pour piloter la R&D de l'agence.

▪️ Tes conditions de travail

  • Organisation : 2 à 3 jours de télétravail par semaine.
  • Équipement : Laptop haut de gamme au choix (MacBook Pro ou Dell Precision dernière génération).
  • Package : Rémunération fixe attractive, prime de vacances, accord d'intéressement, forfait mobilités durables, mutuelle et titres-restaurant.

▪️ Le processus de recrutement 

  1. Échange RH : Alignement sur ton parcours, tes attentes et les opportunités SFEIR.
  2. Session Technique ("PlayOffs") : Évaluation pratique en pair-programming (Algo et GenAI) avec deux Sfeirians.
  3. Échange Métier & Projection : Discussion approfondie sur les cas d'usage, les missions cibles et le contexte client à Bordeaux
  4. Entretien Final : Échange stratégique avec le Directeur d'Agence.

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
At CesiumAstro, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.

We are looking to add a Senior Systems Engineer to our team in Munich Germany. If you enjoy working in a startup environment and are passionate about developing leading-edge phased array antennas and radios for satellites, spacecraft, and aerospace systems, we would like to hear from you. 

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in systems engineering, experience in space technology, and the ability to be the technical point of contact for our communication programs. In this position, you will lead the development of communication system architectures, operational concepts, requirements, and system-level performance analysis for advanced communication terminals and networks. You will coordinate activities across multidisciplinary engineering teams, raise issues at the program level, and drive complex programs to success. 

The successful candidate will communicate effectively with team members and internal stakeholders, both verbally and through written content. 


SUMMARY OF RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Evaluate customer and operational needs to define requirements, integrate technical parameters, and assure compatibility of all physical, functional, and program interfaces.
  • Represent CesiumAstro in customer meetings, design reviews, and technical discussions across Europe.
  • Define and validate space system requirements and interfaces, ensuring end-to-end feasibility.
  • Develop and direct technical concept development in support of proposals and demonstrations.
  • Participate in developing system engineering processes for requirements management, flow-down, and traceability.
  • Lead system-level trade studies, including antenna architecture design, modem design, performance analysis and system level integration
  • Coordinate with RF/Antenna, Electrical, and Software/FPGA engineers to ensure concept feasibility and compliance.
  • Support proposal development, design reviews, and technical documentation. 

    • JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
  • M.S. or higher in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in system engineering for communications payloads, RF systems, or space/defense platforms.
  • Very strong background in communication theory.
  • Practical experience working with antenna systems (design, integration, or performance evaluation).
  • Experience with and understanding of satellite-communications standards (e.g., NR NTN, DVB-S2x, CCSDS).
  • Proven ability to capture and manage requirements across multidisciplinary teams.
  • Excellent communication skills; comfortable presenting to customers and leading design reviews.
  • Fluent in English (German language skills a plus).
  • Deep understanding of RF concepts, impairments, and their impacts on system performance. 

    • WHAT WE OFFER
  • The opportunity to help establish CesiumAstro’s first European office and grow our Munich team.
  • High-impact role with direct exposure to leading EU space programs.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.
  • A collaborative, innovative environment shaping the future of space communications.
    • CesiumAstro considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, education/training, and key skills.

    Please be aware that many roles will be subject to both security and export control restrictions. These restrictions mean that factors including new starter’s nationality, any previous or dual nationalities held, place of birth and country of residence may limit those roles that you can perform for the organization.

At the Senior II level, you will be tasked with full-stack hardware development for complex modules and small systems. You will have the opportunity to start at concept development and progress through detailed design, analysis, layout, build, test, and delivery, doing hands-on work at each phase. The Senior II level also introduces technical leadership opportunities, gaining responsibility for small teams of hardware engineers developing new products and systems.

  • Provide technical support for field trials, demonstrations, customer evaluations, and deployment activities.

  • Minimum of 6 years of relevant experience in board-level electronics design, analysis, and test.

  • Design, develop, code, test, debug and document system software

As an Account Manager at Aircall, you are the owner of customer success and revenue growth across your portfolio. You drive Net Revenue Retention (NRR) by uncovering opportunities to expand, renew, and strengthen customer relationships. Acting as both the voice of Aircall for the customer and the voice of the customer within Aircall, you ensure our customers realize the full value of their investment while fueling sustainable growth for Aircall.
 
By deeply understanding the needs of our customers across a variety of industries and use cases, you become the trusted expert who identifies growth potential and helps improve the customer experience. This means translating customer goals into solutions that unlock adoption, value realization, and expansion — ensuring each account grows in both impact and partnership over time.
 
This is a highly strategic and commercial role — blending consultative relationship management with the rigor and energy of a quota-carrying seller. You’ll partner cross-functionally with Customer Engineering, Product, and Support to accelerate adoption, drive usage of add-on SKUs, and build deep, long-term relationships with customers at all levels of their organizations.
 
Aircall is undergoing an exciting transformation — building on our market-leading communications platform and introducing AI functionality that helps customers operate more intelligently, efficiently, and competitively. Join us and be part of shaping that journey.
 
This is a hybrid role, in office 3 days a week in Paris.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Brand Partnerships EMEA
jobs.description:
👫  About the team

Equativ's EMEA Demand team is responsible for growing relationships with agencies, advertisers, DSPs and other demand partners across the region, helping them leverage Equativ's full suite of omnichannel advertising solutions.

As we continue to strengthen our position with the world's leading agencies, we are also increasing our engagement directly with brands - understanding their business and media challenges, and ensuring Equativ's capabilities are represented in the conversations that shape future investment.

We are looking for a Senior Director EMEA, Brand Partnerships to define and lead this strategy, reporting to our VP Demand, EMEA.

This role is about creating stronger connections between brands, their agencies and Equativ, helping us build more strategic relationships with advertisers while creating incremental opportunities for our existing agency ecosystem.

This is a highly visible, entrepreneurial role for someone who knows the European advertising industry exceptionally well, has strong relationships with senior marketers, and can build a new commercial motion from the ground up.

✍️  What you'll do

  • Define and lead Equativ’s EMEA Brand Partnerships strategy, identifying priority brands, verticals and markets, and building a scalable plan to strengthen Equativ’s position with advertisers across the region.

  • Build senior relationships with leading brands, engaging CMOs, Media Directors, Digital, Programmatic and Marketing leaders to understand their priorities and position Equativ as a strategic partner across programmatic, CTV, data, curation, commerce media and omnichannel activation.

  • Work closely with Equativ’s agency teams and partners to ensure Brand Direct initiatives complement — rather than compete with — existing agency relationships. Develop coordinated account strategies for shared clients and identify opportunities to create incremental value for both brands and their agencies.

  • Develop strategic commercial partnerships, from initial engagement through proposals, joint business plans, pilots and long-term agreements, while building a strong pipeline of advertiser opportunities across EMEA.

  • Act as the voice of the advertiser within Equativ, bringing market insight back to Product, Marketing and Commercial teams, helping shape Equativ’s proposition and representing the company across key advertiser forums, industry events and senior-level conversations.

💪  About you

We are looking for someone who combines industry relationships, strategic thinking and commercial execution.

You will ideally have:

  • 10+ years of experience in advertising technology, digital media, programmatic advertising, media, data or a related sector.

  • A strong and active network of senior brand-side relationships across EMEA, particularly among CMOs, Media Directors, Heads of Digital, Programmatic and Marketing.

  • A proven track record of opening doors and building meaningful commercial relationships directly with major advertisers.

  • Deep knowledge of the European advertising ecosystem and a strong understanding of how brands, agency holding companies, independent agencies, trading desks and technology platforms work together.

  • Strong knowledge of programmatic advertising and the broader adtech ecosystem, including DSPs, SSPs, CTV, data, identity, curation and omnichannel media.

  • Experience developing sophisticated strategic partnerships, annual agreements or Joint Business Plans with large advertisers.

  • A demonstrated ability to turn senior relationships into measurable commercial outcomes.

  • The ability to navigate complex brand/agency dynamics with diplomacy, transparency and sound commercial judgement.

  • Strong executive presence and the ability to engage credibly with C-level marketing executives.

  • An entrepreneurial mindset: you are comfortable building a strategy and operating model where there is not yet a complete playbook.

  • Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.

  • Strong internal collaboration skills and the ability to bring multiple stakeholders together around shared commercial objectives.

  • A willingness to travel regularly across EMEA.

Above all, you should be someone who is deeply connected to the advertising industry, intellectually curious about where the market is heading, and excited about helping Equativ build a significantly stronger position with the world's leading brands.

👊 Growth Expectations

Within your first 90 days, you will have developed a deep understanding of Equativ's EMEA demand business, product portfolio and existing agency relationships. You will have identified priority advertiser accounts and verticals, established an initial EMEA Brand Partnerships strategy, and defined clear rules of engagement between Brand Direct and Agency teams.

Within 6 months, you will have developed senior relationships across a focused portfolio of strategic advertisers, built a meaningful pipeline of opportunities, launched the first strategic partnerships or pilots, and demonstrated an effective model for collaborating with agencies on shared clients.

Within 12 months, you will have established a repeatable Brand Partnerships motion across EMEA, generated measurable incremental revenue and strategic product adoption, built a portfolio of flagship advertiser relationships, and created the foundation for Equativ to further scale its Brand Direct organisation.

jobs.description:
Senior Vet Surgeon

Salary up to £75,000 DOE

Relocation Allowance up to £5,000 plus a Welcome Bonus of up to £5000

 

Dragon Vets, part of inspiring vet care, are seeking an enthusiastic Veterinary Surgeon to join our Rissington site as a Senior Vet, The role will require you to help shape the future of the branch by developing the staff and supporting senior management to ensure the site thrives.

 

We promote further growth and development within the team, giving you access to a large client base with a wide variety of cases, equipment, CPD and a supportive team. In this role you will be working with a large team of dedicated Vets, Nurses and support team members to deliver excellent client and patient care.

 
The role will be based at our Rissington branch and is a full-time position, working four days per week.
 

At inspiring vet care, our people are at the heart of everything we do. As the UK’s number one vet care provider, we're trusted with the care of over 2 million animals, delivering our purpose of healthier animals and happier owners.

 

Practice Highlights

 

Located in the heart of Cheltenham, renowned for horse racing and a thriving bar and restaurant scene, Dragon Vets is an established practice and has invested in specialist equipment including CT, DR, rigid and flexible endoscopy, high-end Doppler ultrasonography and well-equipped operating facilities including laparoscopic kits and TPLO kits, and much more.

 

We have a team of 16 vets, including certificate holders with Advanced Practitioner status in Small Animal Surgery, Cardiology and Medicine, and value evidence-based medicine with regular clinical discussions and readily available colleague support.

 

We function as more than a first-opinion practice, often performing complex surgeries and treating intensive medical cases that may otherwise have been referred. Having been established for decades, we have a huge client base which comes with lots of variety in caseload.

 

We have a dedicated, separate out-of-hours team – Vets Now – based within the same building, enabling 24-hour care. Our nursing team is made up of 17 RVNs and 4 SVNs in various stages of their training.

 

Working Pattern

 
* Average of 37 hours per week over 4 days
* 1 in 4 Saturday mornings
* No out-of-hours or on-call requirements
* Flexible options available for both part-time and full-time applicants
 

Here's what the team have to say

 

"I started at Dragon Vets nine years ago working after school as an ACA. After leaving to go to vet school, I was welcomed back into the team as a new graduate vet in 2023. Dragon have given me a supportive and exciting start to my career. We are lucky to have the facilities in house to advance diagnostics and care beyond first opinion. I enjoy working with all the team and am proud to be a part of it." – Sofia, Vet.

 

How You’ll Make a Difference

 

As Senior Veterinary Surgeon, you will be the most senior veterinary clinician within the practice, responsible for leading clinical standards, governance and the delivery of outstanding patient and client care.

 

You’ll provide clinical leadership to the veterinary team, oversee complex cases and act as the primary source of clinical guidance and decision-making within the practice. Working closely with the senior practice leadership team, you’ll support the strategic direction of the practice and drive continuous improvement in clinical quality, outcomes and ways of working.

 

You Might Be a Great Fit If...

 

You are a highly experienced veterinary surgeon with strong clinical expertise and a passion for leadership and clinical excellence. You’ll bring:

 
* A Veterinary degree and registration with the RCVS, with significant experience in small or mixed animal practice, including advanced surgical and medical capability
* Proven experience in mentoring, coaching and supporting veterinary colleagues
* Strong leadership, communication and decision-making skills
* Experience contributing to or leading clinical governance, audits and quality improvement initiatives
* The ability to manage clinical complaints and provide professional guidance in complex situations
* Professionalism, integrity and a commitment to the highest standards of patient and client care
 

How We’ll Support You

 

At inspiring vet care, we’re committed to supporting your ongoing development and wellbeing. When you join us, you’ll benefit from:

 
* Clear career pathways with progression opportunities across primary care, referral, leadership and specialist roles
* Funded learning and development including CPD allowance and access to IVC Academy training centres and role-relevant courses
* £1,250 annual Care Fund for every vet
* Access to mentors, regional clinical coaches and peer networks
* Support to develop clinical interests and expand your capabilities
* A collaborative, values-led culture focused on care, community and continuous improvement
 

What We Offer Our Team

 
* 6.6 weeks’ holiday including bank holidays
* Private medical insurance
* Enhanced family leave and pay across maternity, paternity, adoption and surrogacy
* BVA membership, VDS cover & RCVS fees
* Cycle to Work and Green Car schemes (eligibility applies)
* Retail discounts and cashback offers
* Reduced-cost veterinary care for your own pets
 

We’re committed to supporting our people through career development opportunities, wellbeing initiatives and access to world-class learning resources.

 

Whether you’re just starting out or looking to take the next step in your career, inspiring vet care offers the support, opportunity and community to help you grow.

jobs.title: Lead Data Scientist H/F
jobs.description:
Volta Medical is an innovative, data-inspired US and European-based growth MedTech aimed at creating and bringing to the market cutting-edge AI software products to revolutionize interventional cardiac electrophysiology.  

Volta has created a data collection and enrichment ecosystem for curated EP lab data which is fed into a physician validated, machine learning methodology to support complex AF solutions. Our newest technology, Volta AF-Xplorer II, is a data-driven AI decision support system that easily integrates into the standard physician workflow, providing a patient-tailored approach to complex AF and AT procedures.  

Our dynamic, innovative team is made up of 100+ collaborators in the EU and USA from a wide variety of backgrounds including engineers, business professionals and physicians, working together to develop AI solutions that help electrophysiologists help patients.


Mission

As Lead Data Science, you will play a key role in shaping the future of Volta's AI technology. You will lead a multidisciplinary Data Science team and contribute directly to the development of innovative machine learning solutions embedded in medical devices used daily in electrophysiology labs worldwide. 

Reporting to the VP Innovation, you will combine scientific expertise, technical leadership and people management to drive the development of next-generation AI algorithms while ensuring compliance with medical device quality and regulatory standards.


Your Responsibilities 

Technical Leadership 

  • Define and drive the Data Science roadmap in alignment with product and business priorities.  

  • Lead the design, development and validation of state-of-the-art Machine Learning and Deep Learning algorithms.  

  • Ensure scientific excellence and promote best practices in AI research and development.  

  • Stay up to date with the latest advances in AI and identify opportunities to integrate new technologies into Volta's products.  

  • Support the definition of data strategies and contribute to the continuous improvement of data collection pipelines.  

Team Leadership 

  • Lead, mentor and grow a team of Data Scientists, Data Engineers and PhD researchers.  

  • Foster a collaborative, innovative and high-performance culture.  

  • Coach team members in both technical and professional development.  

  • Coordinate priorities, allocate resources and ensure timely project delivery.  

Product Development 

  • Collaborate closely with Software Engineering, Clinical, Regulatory and Product teams throughout the product lifecycle.  

  • Contribute to software architecture discussions involving AI components.  

  • Ensure production-ready, maintainable and high-quality code.  

  • Participate in the preparation of technical documentation required for regulatory submissions.  

Scientific & External Collaboration 

  • Represent Volta Medical at scientific conferences and technical events.  

  • Contribute to publications, patents and collaborations with academic partners.  

  • Communicate AI strategy and technical achievements to executive leadership, partners and investors. 


Your Profile

Education & Experience 

  • PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Physics or a related field.  

  • 10+ years of experience developing Machine Learning solutions in an industrial R&D environment.  

  • 5+ years of experience leading technical teams or mentoring Data Scientists.  

  • Experience working in regulated environments (Medical Devices, Healthcare, Automotive, Aerospace or similar) is a strong plus.  

  • Experience bringing AI models from research to production.  

Technical Skills 

  • Strong expertise in Machine Learning, Deep Learning and statistical modeling.  

  • Excellent understanding of model development, evaluation and deployment.  

  • Strong programming skills in Python.  

  • Experience with PyTorch, Scikit-learn, NumPy, Pandas and related ML libraries.  

  • Familiarity with software engineering best practices (Git, testing, CI/CD, Docker).  

  • Good knowledge of Linux environments.  

  • Experience with cloud computing and MLOps is a plus.  

  • Signal processing knowledge would be highly appreciated.  

Soft Skills 

  • Strong leadership and coaching abilities.  

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.  

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.  

  • Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary and international environment.  

  • Fluent English (spoken and written). 


Why join Volta Medical? 

Artificial Intelligence is transforming healthcare, and Volta Medical is at the forefront of this revolution. 

Joining us means contributing to cutting-edge medical technologies that directly improve patients' lives while working alongside internationally recognized experts in electrophysiology, AI and medical devices. 

At Volta, you will enjoy: 

  • Meaningful work with real clinical impact.  

  • An international, multidisciplinary and collaborative environment.  

  • The opportunity to work on state-of-the-art AI applied to healthcare.  

  • High autonomy and opportunities for professional growth.  

  • Regular scientific exchanges and innovation-driven culture.  

  • A workplace located in Marseille, offering an exceptional Mediterranean lifestyle. 

Volta Medical is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We encourage qualified individuals from all backgrounds to apply. If you are passionate about leveraging technology to make a positive impact on healthcare, we'd love to hear from you! 


Recruitment Process
  • Introductory & Culture Fit interview with our Senior VP People (45 min)
  • Technical & Leadership interview with our VP Innovation and our CTO (90min)
  • Interview with our CEO (60 min)
  • Coffee chat at our Marseille HQ (120 min) 
    Spend time with the Data Science team, our Chief Clinical & Regulatory Officer, and our Co-founders (Julien/Clément). Discover our working environment, exchange ideas, and get a feel for what it's like to build AI solutions at Volta Medical.

vivenu s’engage auprès de ses partenaires pour assurer un support d’excellence et pour répondre de façon simple à leurs enjeux en créant des expériences exceptionnelles.

  • Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des intégrations sur mesure (connexions API, systèmes d’authentification SSO, ERP, etc.) en vous appuyant sur les puissants outils proposés par vivenu.

  • Utiliser des scripts, l’IA et le prototypage pour tester rapidement différentes solutions. Vous transformerez ensuite les solutions éprouvées en guides et modèles d’intégration réutilisables à l’échelle de l’entreprise.

  • Vous immerger dans des secteurs d’activité variés afin de relever de nouveaux défis techniques, de la conception initiale jusqu’à la mise en œuvre de la solution.

  • Intervenir en tant qu’expert technique aux côtés de nos équipes commerciales, en les conseillant sur l’architecture des solutions, la faisabilité des intégrations, les délais et les ressources nécessaires.

  • Rester impliqué tout au long de la phase de mise en œuvre afin de garantir que la solution livrée corresponde pleinement aux engagements pris auprès du client, tout en identifiant et en anticipant les éventuelles contraintes techniques en amont de la livraison.


    • Ce dont vous aurez besoin pour réussir dans ce rôle :
  • Au moins 5 ans d’expérience en tant que Solution Architect, Ingénieur ou dans un rôle technique similaire.
  • Une expérience en développement ou une solide expertise technique, ainsi qu’une évolution assumée vers la relation client, les enjeux business et la conception de solutions.
  • Une bonne compréhension du fonctionnement des applications web, des API REST, des webhooks, de la modélisation des données et des interactions entre les différents composants des écosystèmes logiciels modernes.
  • Une capacité à lire et comprendre rapidement une documentation d’API, à écrire des scripts fonctionnels pour tester des solutions et à analyser ou déboguer du code généré par l’IA.
  • Une réelle aisance dans les échanges avec des clients exigeants, ainsi que la capacité à gérer plusieurs priorités simultanément et à cadrer les attentes avec assurance.
  • Un diplôme universitaire en informatique, en ingénierie ou dans un domaine scientifique ou technique connexe.

    Pour être au cœur de l’exploitation de clients de renommée mondiale, en redéfinissant l’expérience utilisateur, grâce à une technologie de rupture.
     
    Une croissance durable
    Nous nous développons durablement en mettant l’accent sur la rentabilité et sommes soutenus par des fonds d’investissement de premier plan. Cela signifie un investissement continu dans nos employés, nos produits et notre vision à long terme.
     
    Une équipe engagée et mue par l’excellence
    Collaborez avec plus de 170 professionnels dévoués, comprenant des leaders venant de Google, Slack et Salesforce. Ensemble, nous façonnons l'avenir des technologies au service de la culture, des événements et des loisirs.
     
    Une emprise globale
    Nous sommes une équipe riche de sa diversité, axée sur le mérite — et répartie dans six bureaux dans le monde. Le talent et l'impact sont ce qui compte avant tout chez vivenu.
     
    Une croissance rapide
    Sifted classe vivenu parmi les scale-ups à la croissance la plus rapide en Europe. Nous sommes nourris par la volonté d’apprendre au quotidien et de nous améliorer continuement.
     
    Développer notre position de leaders et contribuer directement à la transformation de notre industrie
    Travaillez aux côtés de visionnaires — des fondateurs de Forbes 30 Under 30, aux lauréats du prix Executive of the Year. Chez vivenu, vous contribuerez à établir les nouvelles normes de l'industrie de la billetterie.
     
    Consultez la mission et les valeurs d'entreprise de vivenu ici.
     
    Chez vivenu, nous croyons que nos employés sont la clé de notre succès – et que l’esprit audacieux et la diversité de nos collaborateurs sont une richesse. jobs.description:
Du möchtest komplexe Azure-Lösungen mit PaaS, IaaS und Containerdiensten entwickeln? Als Cloud-Architect in unserem Team wirst du fortschrittliche Cloud-Lösungen auf Azure entwerfen und entwickeln. Wir setzen auf agile Arbeitsmethoden, DevOps und testgetriebene Entwicklung.
 
Als technische/r Expert*in verstehst du die Kundenanforderungen und setzt diese ins technische Design um. Dabei stellst du sicher, dass unsere Projekte sichere, skalierbare und zuverlässige Azure-Lösungen liefern.

Was du bei uns machst
  • Du konzipierst und entwickelst fortschrittliche Cloud-Lösungen in Azure.
  • Durch deine Erfahrung nimmst du maßgeblich Einfluss auf Brownfield- und Greenfield-Projekte.
  • In unseren Projekten wendest du DevOps-Prinzipien und Infrastructure as Code sicher an.
  • Regelmäßig berätst du unsere Kunden zu passenden Architekturen und  Azure-Diensten.
  • Du begleitest unsere Projekte von Anfang an: Angefangen in der Pre-Sales Phase bis hin zur erfolgreichen Implementierung.

    • Wann du zu uns passt
  • Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung im Architekturdesign und mit Azure PaaS-/Iaas-/Container-Diensten.
  • Du bist in der Lage, Geschäftsanforderungen des Kunden in technische Architekturen zu übersetzen.
  • Du hast bereits Kund*innen zu Azure-Dienste hinsichtlich Funktionalität, Sicherheit, Skalierung und Betriebszeit beraten.
  • Mit Azure DevOps, automatisierten Pipelines und Infrastructure as Code bist du bestens vertraut und wirkst proaktiv im Entwicklungsprozess mit.
  • Du bist in der Lage, technische Meetings zu leiten und unseren Kunden die Fortschritte verständlich zu präsentieren.
  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und kannst dich auch auf Englisch sicher austauschen.
    • Hey, wir sind Skaylink.
    Begleite uns auf unserer Cloud Journey!
     

    Als Part of Vodafone bringen wir unsere Cloud-DNA und Innovationskraft ein. Gemeinsam treiben wir zentrale Cloud- und Transformationsprojekte voran. Von Cloud-Migrationen über Security-Lösungen bis hin zu Modern-Work-Projekten schaffen wir spürbaren Mehrwert für unsere Kund*innen. Dabei nutzen wir Synergien und bündeln unsere Stärken. So entstehen Lösungen mit nachhaltiger Wirkung und genau das macht uns zu einem der führenden Anbieter im Bereich Cloud-Technologien. 

    Unser Anspruch ist es, echte Ergebnisse zu schaffen, die messbar Wirkung zeigen und Projekte nachhaltig voranbringen. Wir beraten nicht nur, sondern setzen um. Denn Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Wirkung zu erzielen, gehört für uns zusammen. 

    Bei uns zählen deine Expertise, deine Leidenschaft und deine Motivation, etwas zu bewegen. Unterschiedliche Hintergründe, Perspektiven und Erfahrungen machen uns stark. Sie schaffen den Raum, in dem du dich einbringen und weiterentwickeln kannst. 

    Wenn du nicht nur mitlaufen, sondern wirklich etwas bewegen willst, bist du bei uns richtig. 

     
    Was du von uns hast
     
    🎯 Purpose – Deine Expertise einsetzen (in Projekten bei re­nom­mierten Unternehmen wie BMW Group, Henkel oder KWS)
    🌍 Flexibilität – Deine Balance finden (u. a. Workation, Urlaubsflexibilisierung) 
    📖 Entwicklung – Ankommen und Weiterkommen (u. a. Skaylink Campus, Entwicklungsgespräche, regelmäßige Befragungen der Mitarbeitenden)
    🏖️ Erholung – Kraft tanken (u. a. 30 Tage Urlaub, 24. + 31.12 frei, Sabbatical) 
    🚲 Mobilität – Von A nach B kommen (u. a. BusinessBike, Zuschuss zum Deutschland-Ticket)  
    💻 Ausstattung – Die Qual der Wahl (Apple/Windows, Firmenhandy) 
    💪 Unterstützung – Fühl dich wohl (u. a. Employee Referral Program, Corporate Benefits, Arbeitsplatzbrille, jährlich 5 bezahlte Kind-krank-Tage) 
    🏆 Events – Zusammenkommen und Feiern (u. a. Sommer- und Weihnachtsfeier, Teamevents, Cross-Company Tech-Talks) 
    🧩 Miteinander – We are Skaylink! 
     
    Du + Skaylink = Perfect Match? 
     
    Dann bewirb dich – auch falls du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst! Wir benötigen nur deinen Lebenslauf und sind schon ganz gespannt darauf, von dir zu lesen. 
     
    Wir freuen uns auf die gemeinsame (Cloud) Journey mit dir!

jobs.title: Kundeservicemedarbeider
jobs.employer: PERSONALHUSET SERVICE MANAGEMENT AS AVD VESTFOLD
jobs.description:
Kunne du tenke deg å jobbe med inngående kundeservice på telefon, mail og chat? 

Vi i Personalhuset ser etter kundeservicemedarbeider til flere av våre gode samarbeidspartnere i Sandefjord området.

Du vil sitte hovedsakelig på inngående trafikk via telefon, hvor man hjelper eksisterende kunder med det de måtte ha av utfordringer.

Erfaring er ikke nødvendig! 

Men det er viktig for oss at du er opptatt av 

- Å ha et ønske om å gi kundene ekstra god kundeservice, strekke deg det lille ekstra.

- God kommunikasjon. Du må snakke flytende norsk. Glad i å snakke med andre mennesker. 

- Å skape et god miljø. Positive holdninger og god energi. Ha det gøy på jobb. 

- Mersalg. 

Vi ser for oss at du er glad i å jobbe i team, men samtidig har evnen til å jobbe selvstendig.

Dagtid! 

Mandag - fredag. 

100% stilling.

Håper vi hører fra deg! 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Personalhuset er et av Nordens ledende rekrutterings- og bemanningsselskaper og inngår i konsernet Otiga Group.

Otiga Group består av flere selskaper innen rekruttering, bemanning, omstilling og konsulenttjenester. Personalhuset har 15 kontorer i Norge med stor geografisk spredning, hvor over 100 ansatte hver dag jobber for å inspirere, utfordre og ikke minst bry seg om våre kunder og medarbeidere.

Vår visjon er å utfordre det etablerte. Sammen med våre kunder skal vi møte morgendagens behov gjennom fokus på teknologi og utvikling av mennesker. Vårt mål er å være det mest synlige og innovative rekrutterings- og bemanningsselskapet. Uansett hvor du møter oss, vil samme høye kvalitet og entusiasme prege våre tjenester.

For mer informasjon se personalhuset.no

La structure garantit un flux constant de nouveaux patients, assurant un agenda bien rempli.ADN de la structureLa clinique bénéficie d'infrastructures modernes, récemment rénovées, et dotées de technologies de pointe : Invisalign Diamond Provider, scanners de dernière génération, panoramique, cone beam et céphalométrie. L'équipe est composée de 10 assistantes dentaires et 5 secrétaires, assurant une gestion fluide et efficace. Les praticiens bénéficient également d'un accompagnement personnalisé pour leur installation et leur évolution professionnelle.RémunérationCette opportunité vous permettra de percevoir une rémunération attractive, définie selon le profil du candidat.Avantages- Huit semaines de congés payés- Week-end de trois jours- Mutuelle et contrat de prévoyance de qualité- Remboursement des frais de transport à hauteur de 50 %- Accompagnement personnalisé (inscription à l'Ordre, logement, véhicule, communication, etc.)- Garantie et maintien du salaire pour une activité sans objectif de chiffre d'affairesProfils recherchés : Pédodontiste diplômé(e) en France ou dans l'Union-Européenne, inscrit(e) ou inscriptible au Conseil national de l'ordre des chirurgiens-dentistes en France.Candidats provenant de l'Union Européenne : Jober Group, leader de l'intégration des chirurgiens-dentistes en France, vous accompagne gratuitement jusqu'au démarrage de votre activité. Un de nos consultants vous aidera pour l'apprentissage de la langue, la mise en relation avec nos professeurs partenaires, l'inscription à l'ordre et votre recherche de logement.Contactez-nous au : O6 67 76 6O 76Référence de l'annonce : 9351Retrouvez plus de 4000 offres d'emploi santé sur notre site et application mobile Jober Group. Profitez d'un réseau de 1000 partenaires sur toute la France, d'une équipe d'experts du recrutement à votre écoute et d'un service totalement gratuit dont 99% de nos candidats sont satisfaits.Profil recherché:Profils recherchés : Pédodontiste diplômé(e) en France ou dans l'Union-Européenne, inscrit(e) ou inscriptible au Conseil national de l'ordre des chirurgiens-dentistes en France.

jobs.description: Secrétaire juridique - Environnement juridique spécialisé / Horaires flexiblesVous souhaitez mettre votre expertise en secrétariat juridique au service d'un environnement juridique spécialisé en croissance, tout en vous projetant à long terme au sein d'une équipe stable ?Notre client situé à Luxembourg, recherche un secrétaire juridique pour accompagner ses collaborateurs au quotidien. Avec une dizaine de personnes et un très faible turnover, cette structure vous offre la possibilité de développer des relations de travail durables et de trouver pleinement votre place au sein de l'équipe.L'activité de notre client repose principalement sur des transactions pour des sociétés, ainsi que structures immobilier/ières. Cette diversité vous permettra de travailler sur des dossiers variés et d'enrichir votre connaissance.Afin d'accompagner cette étude en pleine croissance, vous prendrez une place centrale dans le quotidien d'une équipe à taille humaine. Profil et parcours / Secrétaire juridique - Kirchberg Vous disposez d'au moins deux années d'expérience en secrétariat juridique, vous permettant de prendre en charge vos missions de manier/ière autonome.Vous maîtrisez obligatoirement le luxembourgeois pour communiquer facilement avec vos interlocuteurs. Le français et l'anglais constituent des atouts supplémentaires.Vous appréciez l'autonomie et savez identifier les priorités pour faire avancer votre travail au quotidien.Vous aimez le contact avec les clients et savez instaurer une relation professionnelle et rassurant/ante dès les premiers échanges. Vous pourrez adapter vos horaires dans le respect de votre temps de travail, afin de mieux concilier vos contraintes personnelles et professionnelles.Vous occuperez un poste associant préparation de dossiers, recherches et réception, pour varier vos missions et mobiliser aussi bien vos compétences administratives que relationnelles. Nous savons que l'écoute est essentielle et, ce faisant, cela nous permet de déterminer ensemble les opportunités qui pourraient vous convenir le mieux ainsi qu'à vos critères. Que vous soyez candidat ou entreprise, nous sommes là à chaque étape et il nous fera plaisir de vous accompagner dans votre évolution.Contactez-nous dès aujourd'hui au +   pour discuter de votre parcours professionnel ou consultez nos offres d'emploi actuelles sur www.abiomis.com.

jobs.title: Comptable Germanophone - Equipe à taille humaine, Equilibre de vie (H/F)
jobs.description: Comptable Germanophone - Equipe à taille humaine, Equilibre de vie Vous êtes Comptable et souhaitez rejoindre une structure reconnue, offrant à la fois stabilité, diversité des missions et possibilités d'évolution ?Notre client est une fiduciaire implantée au cœur d'un quartier financier de Luxembourg, qui compte aujourd'hui plus de collaborateurs. Grâce à une équipe expérimentée et à des compétences couvrant plusieurs domaines, la société accompagne une clientèle composée aussi bien d'acteurs commerciaux que financiers.Au-delà des services comptables, la fiduciaire dispose d'une expertise en fiscalité, gestion des salaires, administration juridique et dans différents services liés à l'accompagnement de ses clients. Cette diversité permet aux collaborateurs d'être confrontés à des problématiques variées et de développer continuellement leurs compétences, notamment grâce à un programme de formations régulier/ièrement proposé.Vous évoluerez dans une organisation avec une hiérarchie accessible et peu pyramidale, favorisant les échanges directs avec le management. L'environnement de travail repose sur des valeurs de confiance, de collaboration et de flexibilité, avec une organisation permettant à chacun de travailler dans de bonnes conditions tout en développant progressivement son expertise. Vos responsabilités / Finance - Fiduciaire - Commerciales - Fiscalité - TVA Vous prenez en charge de manier/ière autonome la gestion comptable d'un portefeuille de sociétés commerciales, en assurant un suivi rigoureux des différents dossiers.Vous intervenez sur des entités luxembourgeoises et allemandes, vous permettant de travailler dans un environnement comptable à dimension internationale.Vous préparez et contrôlez les déclarations de TVA et fiscales, aussi bien au Luxembourg qu'en Allemagne.Vous bénéficiez, si nécessaire, d'une formation complète en fiscalité allemande, afin de développer progressivement vos compétences sur ces aspects.Vous êtes en relation directe avec vos clients luxembourgeois et allemands, en les accompagnant au quotidien et en construisant une relation basée sur la confiance. jobs.title: Driftsleder Høyspent/Prosjektleder
jobs.description:
Hydro Energi har mer enn 100 års erfaring fra produksjon av fornybar energi. I dag er vi en av de tre største vannkraftprodusentene i Norge, og en betydelig kraftmarkedsaktør i Norden og Brasil. Vi er ansvarlig for å utvikle nye forretningsmuligheter og støtter Hydros forretningsområder innen kontrakter, forsyningssikkerhet og energipolitiske rammevilkår.

Hva vi tilbyr deg

 

Form fremtidens vannkraft som prosjektingeniør i Hydro Energi!

Hydro Energi er operatør for 40 vannkraftverk og en vindpark i Norge, med en total produksjon på 14 TWh. Kraftverkene ligger i områdene Røldal-Suldal, Sogn, Telemark, Stavanger og Tonstad.    

Hydro Energi Stavanger har ansvar for drift og vedlikehold av 15 vannkraftverk og to pumpestasjoner i Stavangerregionen. Vi identifiserer, utvikler og gjennomfører investeringsprosjekter i tett samarbeid med våre eiere (Lyse og Hydro Energi). Kraftverkene driftes kostnadseffektivt og har høy markedstilgjengelighet.  

Hos oss får du

  • Muligheten til å påvirke prosjekter som vil ha en direkte innvirkning på samfunnet og miljøet.  
  • Varierte arbeidsoppgaver som utfordrer din faglige ekspertise og kreativitet.  
  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø med høy kompetanse både lokalt og sentralt.   
  • Stort faglig miljø og muligheter i et solid norsk industrikonsern.  
  • Klar for å bli en nøkkelperson i Hydros tekniske fremtid? Vi vil vi høre fra deg!
Hva du skal gjøre

 

Som driftsleder høyspent har du det lovpålagte ansvaret for sikker drift, vedlikehold og etterlevelse av forskrifter i våre høyspentanlegg. Du har evnen til å omsette forskrifter og lovkrav til praktiske tiltak i tett samarbeid med våre fagfolk, ingeniører og mellomledere. Samarbeid med vedlikeholdspersonell for oppdatering av vedlikeholdsrutiner, er en viktig oppgave for å ivareta og for å løfte anleggspåliteligheten. Oppdatering av anleggsdata i Fosweb utføres ofte av driftsleder selv, eller av andre i forståelse med driftsleder. 

Driftsleder rapporterer direkte til kraftverkssjef og inngår i vår utvidede ledergruppe. 

I rollen prosjektleder vil du jobbe med modning og gjennomføring av prosjekter. Alt fra modifikasjoner, erstatninger og nybygg inngår i eksisterende prosjektportefølje. Oppdatering av tegninger og annen dokumentasjon inngår også som en viktig del av prosjektarbeidet, såvel som i rollen som driftsleder.  

  • Prosjekt- og detaljoppgraderinger: Planlegge, koordinere og gjennomføre oppgraderings- og vedlikeholdsprosjekter innen kontrollanlegg, automasjon, energitilførsel og høyspenningsanlegg. 
  • Feilsøking og teknisk forbedring: Bidra i utredning av avvik, programmering og oppfølging av PLS- og styringssystemer, samt kontinuerlig optimalisering av anleggene. 
  • Tverrfaglig samarbeid: Delta i prosjekter og disiplinteam på tvers av fagområder som mekanisk, elektro, samband og driftssentral.
Hva som vil bidra til din suksess?

 

Vi ser etter deg som er  serviceinnstilt, praktisk anlagt og løsningsorientert elektroingeniør som trives i spennet mellom feltarbeid og teknisk fordypning. Du bygger gode relasjoner og kommuniserer godt med både operatørene ute på kraftverkene og prosjektlederne på kontoret. 

Utover det ser vi for oss at du har følgende bakgrunn: 

  • Utdanning: Relevant master- eller bachelorgrad (ingeniør), eller toårig utdanning som fagskoleingeniør innen elkraft, pluss relevant fagbrev (energimontør eller elektriker).  
  • Det er et fortrinn om du har bestått elektroinstallatørprøven.  
  • Yrkeserfaring: Minimum 5 års relevant erfaring fra kraftproduksjon, elektroinstallasjon og/eller vedlikehold.  
  • Språkferdigheter: Sterke kommunikasjons- og presentasjonsevner på norsk og engelsk, skriftlig og muntlig. 

Sjekker du ikke av alle boksene? Ikke la noen manglende punkter holde deg tilbake! Dersom du har den faglige bakgrunnen og motivasjonen til å lære, ønsker vi veldig gjerne å høre fra deg. 

Like muligheter

I vårt selskap mener vi at mangfold gjør oss sterkere. Vi ønsker ulike erfaringer og perspektiver velkommen. Vi vurderer hver søknad rettferdig, og ønsker å gi like muligheter for alle til å vokse og lykkes i Hydro.

Korttids og rehabiliteringsavdelingen ved Døli pleie og omsorgssenter har 1 ledig fast stillinger i 100%. Stillingen er todelt turnus med arbeid hver 3. helg.  

Vi trenger deg- sykepleier med stort faglig engasjement, entusiasme, humor og som brenner for rehabilitering, eldreomsorg og gode pasientforløp. Vi kan tilby varierte arbeidsdager med givende og utfordrende oppgaver. Er du en fagperson med et helhetsperspektiv på beboeren og de tjenestene vi skal gi?

Sykehjemmet ligger nedenfor Varingskollen togstasjon og bussen stopper 3 minutter unna sykehjemmet. Dersom du kjører bil fra Oslo, kjører du mot køen begge veier. Kjøretid fra Oslo er beregnet til ca. 30 minutter.Sykehjemmet har flotte, lyse lokaler og består av 77 rom fordelt på fire avdelinger, hvorav tre er langtidsavdelinger og en korttids-/rehabiliteringsavdeling. Raushet, redelighet og respekt er viktige prinsipper som vi bygger på. Brukers medbestemmelse og trygghet står sentralt i våre tjenester.Vi har god kompetanse på geriatri og demens og har fokus på fagutvikling innen området. Vi har en stor flott sansehage som innbyr til å være ute. Det er sansesti, flere sittegrupper og grillhytte i hagen. Vi er opptatt av å benytte musikk, erindring og måltider som miljøbehandling. jobs.title: Patent Engineer (Life Sciences)
jobs.description:
The way companies innovate is broken. The systems built to create and protect ideas can’t keep up with the pace of change. Today, 90% of S&P 500 company value is intangible (e.g., in intellectual property) - yet R&D and IP teams spend half their time buried in manual work, sifting through patents and paperwork instead of pushing the frontier forward. The tools of creating and protecting are stuck in the past. We’re here to fix that.

Ankar is building the R&D tools for the AI era and defining what applied research will look like in the next 20 years. We’re building infrastructure and product experiences our customers rely on every day. You’ll translate messy, ambiguous problems into clean, dependable software—and you’ll do it at the cutting-edge of AI.

We’re at an inflection point:

  • We’ve raised >$24M to date from Tier-1 VCs like Atomico, Index Ventures, Norrsken, Daphni, and angels like the Founder of Hugging Face, CEO from Datadog, and Leaders from DeepMind and OpenAI.

  • We’re already working with the world’s most innovative companies including Fortune 500 company L’Oréal and global law firm Vorys

  • Expanding our world-class team with alumni from Palantir, Amazon, and BCG to tackle the $1T+ innovation market. We’re just getting started.

What you’ll be doing
We’re looking for a patent professional with deep large-molecule life sciences expertise who can bridge product development, engineering and IP protection. You’ll work hands-on with pharmaceutical and biotech customers to design AI-powered patent solutions that understand the nuances of biologics—including antibodies, proteins, peptides, nucleic acids, vaccines and cell and gene therapies—and the conventions that govern their patent protection.

  • Build life sciences-specific patent products: Partner with product and engineering teams to develop AI tools tailored to large-molecule patents—from protein and antibody sequence analysis to biologics claim generation, sequence-listing support and prior-art searching across life sciences databases.

  • Embed with pharmaceutical and biotech customers: Work directly with in-house patent counsel and prosecution teams to design, prototype and deploy high-value proofs of concept for large-molecule patent workflows.

  • Shape product development with biologics expertise: Translate complex large-molecule patent challenges into product requirements, ensuring our AI understands sequence data, CDR and epitope definitions, functional claim language, sequence variants, experimental data and biologics drafting conventions.

  • Drive customer success in large-molecule patents: Lead technical sessions with patent professionals to ensure our products deliver measurable value across biologics patent portfolios.

  • Identify emerging biologics patent opportunities: Recognize evolving needs across therapeutic antibodies, recombinant proteins, vaccines, nucleic acid technologies, cell and gene therapies, biologics formulations and regulatory IP strategy.

What we’re looking for

  • Large-molecule patent expertise: At least two years of experience in biologics patent prosecution, pharmaceutical or biotech IP, or other large-molecule-focused patent work, with a strong understanding of the patent lifecycle from invention disclosure through prosecution, grant and enforcement.

  • Technical life sciences foundation: Strong knowledge of molecular biology, biochemistry, immunology or a related discipline, including an understanding of protein and nucleic acid sequences, antibody structure and function, biologics development, and how these translate into patentable subject matter.

  • Strong biologics drafting skills: Experience developing claim strategies for antibodies, proteins, nucleic acids or other biologic modalities, with an understanding of written-description, enablement, sequence-listing and functional-claiming requirements.

  • Builder’s mindset: You thrive in ambiguity, iterate quickly on prototypes and enjoy creating order from complexity. You can move seamlessly between high-level patent strategy and detailed biologics claim construction.

  • Extreme ownership: You anticipate problems, take responsibility for outcomes and consistently deliver. This is how you grow—and how we win.

  • [Bonus points]: Experience at a patent law firm representing pharmaceutical or biotech clients; in-house patent counsel experience at a pharmaceutical or biotech company; expertise in emerging modalities such as antibody-drug conjugates, bispecific antibodies, RNA therapeutics or cell and gene therapies; or an advanced life sciences degree combined with patent training.

     
 

This role is not for you if...

  • You need a highly structured environment, a predefined playbook, regular working hours, or a schedule that never requires travel. We operate with high autonomy and ownership, expect our team to go above and beyond, be obsessed with our mission and thrive in ambiguity rather than wait for direction.

  • You prefer long planning cycles and certainty before acting. We move quickly, ship often, and adapt based on customer feedback and new information.

  • You want to manage the work rather than do the work. We're builders first, and everyone is expected to contribute directly to creating exceptional products.

  • You take it personally when ideas are challenged, priorities shift, or work gets redirected. We care more about finding the right answer than defending a particular one.

 

What we put behind our people

Building at the frontier takes exceptional people. We invest accordingly.

  • Health Insurance : Full private health & dental coverage for you and your dependents.

  • Pension: Flexible pension scheme with up to 5% employer matching on qualifying earnings.

  • Food on us: Team lunches twice a week, plus dinner when working late in the office.

  • Cycle to work: Green Commute initiative scheme (up to £3k) to help you get a new bike tax-free.

  • Way we work: We combine deep, in-person collaboration (3 days/week in our Shoreditch office) with flexibility and trust. What matters is ownership, impact, and results, not where you work from.

  • Visa sponsorship: Yes

jobs.title: GTM Lead, UK - SMB/MM/Enterprise
jobs.description:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

The Role

We’re hiring a hands-on sales leader for the UK. You’ll build, lead, and coach the regional Sales team, deliver against ARR and pipeline goals, and build a repeatable local growth engine.

You'll act as the business lead for your market, with accountability for revenue. As a sales leader, you'll lead and coach the sales team, stay close to customers and deals, and build a repeatable sales approach that fits your market. As an orchestrator, you'll coordinate the local pipeline generation activities that feed your number, including marketing and pre-sales. You'll work closely with leaders across BDR, Growth, Field Marketing, Partnerships, Revenue Operations, Solutions Engineering, Deployment, and Customer Success, and influence how they support your market's priorities.

What you’ll do

  • Own the region’s ARR plan, forecast, and qualified pipeline. Work with the CRO to set priorities, understand capacity needs, and support the team to deliver against the plan.

  • Build and lead the regional Sales team. Hire, onboard, coach, and develop sellers, while staying hands-on in priority opportunities from prospecting and discovery through qualification, evaluation, negotiation, and close.

  • Make clear, evidence-based recommendations to Product based on regional customer conversations, deal patterns, and market needs. Build and refine a repeatable regional sales approach using pipeline, win/loss learning, and customer outcomes.

  • Drive the plan in partnership with field marketing to set priorities for events, campaigns, customer advocacy and community programs, and direct how field marketing resources are used to support your pipeline and ARR goals.

  • Partner with the marketing leadership, who own field marketing standards, methods and team management, to make sure regional programs are well executed, measured and consistent with Dust's broader marketing approach

  • Partner with BDR and Growth leaders to build a qualified pipeline through a deliberate mix of outbound and other locally effective channels.

  • Set direction for how Partnerships can support regional priorities. Work with the Partnerships lead to identify opportunities for sourcing, co-selling, or delivery.

  • Coordinate with Solutions Engineering, Deployment, Professional Services, and Customer Success to support credible evaluations, successful implementations, customer outcomes, and expansion.

  • Represent regional customer needs internally and share market learning with the CRO and functional leaders, contributing to consistent GTM practices across Dust.

Market-specific focus

United Kingdom

Build on early customer and partner traction. Use customer referrals, targeted events, and focused market experiments to build qualified pipeline and strengthen local customer proof.

What we’re looking for

  • A proven sales professional who has grown from individual contributor into people leadership, with 5+ years leading B2B software sales and coaching regional sales teams and a hands-on understanding of how to help reps succeed in-market.

  • You've owned a market or segment revenue number end to end, not just a team's quota. You've built pipeline through functions you didn't manage, such as marketing, partners and pre-sales, and you've made real calls about where capacity and budget go, including between direct sales and partners

  • Ability to lead by example in priority opportunities, from discovery through close.

  • Experience building pipeline and customer relationships in a market where the brand or sales motion is still developing.

  • A disciplined approach to forecasting and performance feedback, paired with high EQ and a genuinely supportive leadership style.

  • An appetite for building, testing, and refining a market over multiple quarters while balancing near-term results with durable growth.

What success looks like

The region delivers against its ARR and pipeline goals while developing a repeatable sales approach suited to local customers. The team builds customer trust and referenceable outcomes, cross-functional support is focused on regional priorities, and market learning informs Dust’s broader GTM approach.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

  • Our product constitution, a story about our mission

  • Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human, Stanislas Polu, VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

  • Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI, Gabriel Hubert, Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe.

About the role

Ramp is building its UK partnerships ecosystem, and we're looking for a Channel Partner Manager who can turn relationships across a myriad of industries into meaningful customer opportunities. This is a generalist role for someone who can see where a partnership makes sense, move quickly, and build momentum across a varied partner portfolio.

You'll identify how and where Ramp can create value for a prospective partner's customer base, then carry the relationship through to qualified introductions and customer adoption. You'll learn what uniquely motivates each partner and turn early success into a repeatable flywheel of referrals. Some relationships will need to be built from the ground up; others will need sharper activation and follow-through. The mix will evolve, so you should be comfortable moving between different partner models while staying focused on commercial outcomes.

You'll work closely with Ramp's UK Sales team and colleagues in Partnerships, Marketing, Events, Product, and Engineering to connect the right partners and customers and make each introduction count.

What you'll do

  • Build and manage a varied portfolio of UK partners, adapting your approach to each relationship and industry.

  • Identify how Ramp can create value for a prospective partner's customer base, then prioritize relationships with the clearest path to fast execution.

  • Understand what matters to each partner and shape a referral motion that gives them a compelling reason to keep bringing relevant customers to Ramp.

  • Create repeatable sources of qualified introductions through partner enablement, account mapping, joint campaigns, events, and warm networks.

  • Use business communities, hospitality, and executive events when they can create relevant introductions and measurable commercial value.

  • Coordinate partner introductions and follow-up with Ramp's Sales team so opportunities have a clear owner and a strong customer experience.

  • Track partner activity from introduction through qualified opportunity and customer adoption; use the data to refine each motion and focus time on what works.

  • Run regular partner reviews, keep commitments moving across teams, and represent Ramp credibly with partner executives and prospective customers.

What you need

  • 5+ years of experience, including 3+ years in partnerships, business development, partner sales, account management, or commercial strategy.

  • A record of building trusted senior relationships and delivering measurable commercial results through partners.

  • The ability to learn different partner business models quickly, understand their customers, and spot where Ramp can create value.

  • Strong commercial judgement in prioritizing prospects, shaping warm introductions, and managing opportunities with sales teams.

  • Experience executing partner go-to-market activity, such as enablement, account mapping, campaigns, events, or co-sell programs.

  • Comfort using performance data to assess partner activity, report results, and adjust course.

  • Excellent written, verbal, and listening skills, with the ability to work across partner organizations and internal teams.

  • A hands-on, organized working style that keeps multiple relationships and commitments moving at once.

  • UK-based, with flexibility to travel across the UK and attend occasional evening or weekend partner events.

Nice to haves

  • A background in strategy consulting or investment banking.

  • Experience creating B2B pipeline through partner networks, executive events, hospitality, or account-based campaigns.

  • Familiarity with UK small and medium-sized businesses and the finance leaders who buy and use Ramp's products.

  • Experience building a new partner motion in a growing market or adapting a successful approach to a new partner category.

What success looks like

  • Partners and Ramp teams know who owns each introduction, opportunity, and next step.

  • Partner activity produces a consistent flow of relevant introductions, qualified opportunities, and customers.

jobs.title: Growth Engineer (Intern)
jobs.description:
👷🏻‍♀️ What we do 👷🏻‍♀️

At Emidat, we are building the first climate-native product management system for building material manufacturers.

Emidat aims to decarbonise building materials, making up 11% of global GHG emissions. We collect data from physical production processes, generate a digital product passport with verified environmental data and make it usable along the value chain. In short: One solution to assess, design, buy, sell and manage products - with environmental impact at the core.

Embodied carbon is emitted on day zero and can never be reduced later, while global floor area is set to double by 2060. From January 2026, EU regulation (CPR) requires verified environmental data. 430,000 manufacturers will need it, and only about 2,500 have it today. That gap is our market.

Find out more about us, the team and our values here.

What you will work on

Your mission

Drive initiatives that grow Emidat. In Growth we prioritise by one question: does this bring in new customers? As a Growth Engineer Intern you work across our four growth functions that sits closest to that answer; 1. Growth Engineering, 2. Growth Marketing, 3. Sales Development and 4. Partnerships

Topics you might work on: our automated campaign planning and lead development process, and the automations behind it. Our mapping of the total addressable market (TAM) and the GTM analysis sheet we use to decide which segments and countries to go after. Our industry get-togethers, for example expert exchanges and C-level breakfasts, from the invite list to the follow-up. LinkedIn posts and customer case studies, which means talking to manufacturers who use Emidat and turning what they tell you into material our sales team can send.

This internship is ideal for someone who has future aspirations to ‘found’ a company. Building a revenue function is one of the most difficult parts of founding, and during your internship, you’ll get insights into how demand is created, how a pipeline is built, and how AI actually optimises a go-to-market team. You will work on initiatives with the leads of each growth function, including our Head of Growth. We expect you to work independently, form your own view on what to prioritise, and challenge us when you think we have it wrong.

 

During your Internship, you will:

Joining our Growth team involves:

  • Own our Campaign Process: Run and sharpen the automated workflow that qualifies and enriches our target accounts, and take responsibility for the pipeline our SDR team works from.

  • Map our Market: Extend our TAM mapping into every new geography we enter, and keep our view of the relevant manufacturers, associations and registries current - so the commercial team always plans against a reliable picture of who is worth targeting.

  • Turn Data into Decisions: Build and maintain the reporting our team steers by, from campaign performance to pipeline health. Translate data into clear, actionable insights and own the data quality that makes those numbers trustworthy.

  • Organise our industry get-togethers: Organise formats like the BAU Dinner, our C-level AI Breakfasts and the Climate Native Summit end-to-end - guest list, invitations, on-site logistics and follow-up - turning each one into a reliable source of senior conversations.

  • Build Our Market Presence: Draft posts for our company page and keep our content calendar running: webinars and event announcements, product news, new joiners, and the pieces that build our positioning in the market.

Internal Tech Stack:

Automation: N8N, Clay

Content & design: LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Figma

Messaging: Slack & Google Workspace

What you will bring to this role

Minimum Requirements

  • Language: Fluent (C2/Native) in German and business fluent (C1+) in English.

  • Data-Driven System Integration: Proven ability to interpret complex performance data, generating actionable insights that directly inform strategy. You must be able to effectively bridge data analysis with our internal tech stack to drive business outcomes.

Nice to have’s

  • Expertise in Growth Stack Technologies: Hands-on experience and familiarity with core automation, analytics, and CRM systems, including specific platforms like Hubspot, N8N, Clay, Lemlist, and Make.
