jobs.title: Workday Financial Systems Architect
jobs.description:
Hi! We are AMBOSS and we are looking for a Financial Systems Architect to join our team, and shape the future of medical education with us!

About AMBOSS

AMBOSS is a dynamic learning and clinical decision support tool committed to empowering medical professionals globally to deliver optimal care. Since our inception in 2012, we've harnessed cutting-edge technology to transform the way physicians acquire and apply scientific knowledge. Each AMBOSSian is passionate about being the champion of clinicians today - this motivates and unites us each day towards success. And what does success look like? When a clinician or med student tells us, “AMBOSS makes practicing medicine easier and enjoyable. I love what I do, and a big part is because of AMBOSS.”

Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our video to explore what makes us unique.


Why Systems at AMBOSS?

AMBOSS runs on a growing landscape of business systems: Workday as the ERP at the center, connected to Stripe, HubSpot, Pleo, Avalara, our banks, payroll and archiving. The Systems team, part of Data & Systems, makes this landscape develop as a whole: every problem solved in the system where it belongs, and processes that run smoothly from order to cash and from purchase to payment. Our expertise is platform-independent: accounting logic, process design, integration patterns and systems thinking. Working side by side with Finance, Accounting, Commercial, Data and IT, we support AMBOSS in pursuing its mission: empowering medical professionals worldwide to provide the best possible care.

Why can this position be exciting for you?

You are the technical owner of Workday Financials at AMBOSS: you take the tenant over from our implementation partner and run it. Some days that means a configuration fix before the close, other days the design of a new integration or the assessment of a new module.

You are the expert and advisor for everything Workday. Our Business Systems Manager owns the roadmap, stakeholder coordination and partner management and works with you day to day.

This is a senior individual contributor role: you build and own Workday the way a senior engineer owns a production system. It is not an administrator role with a ticket queue.

Where we are

Workday Financials goes live in November 2026 as our ERP for three entities in Germany, the US and Italy. Around twelve integrations connect it to the rest of the landscape, and they are the most demanding part of it. You join during hypercare and the first closes in Workday, with the first year-end close and statutory audit ahead.

You will:

  • Own the tenant technically. Configuration and business processes across record-to-report (General Ledger), procure-to-pay (Accounts Payable), order-to-cash (Accounts Receivable) and bank connectivity (Banking & Settlement), the security model and the financial data model.

  • Take over from the implementation partner. Review, document and harden what was delivered, close the gaps and bring run responsibility in-house as early as possible after go-live. Where we still use consultants, you set the technical standard and review their work.

  • Own the Workday side of every integration. Design and build the EIBs, Core Connectors, Studio integrations, web services and RaaS reports behind each interface and agree the interface contracts with our Data Platform engineers, who build and run the pipelines around the tenant.

  • Advise Accounting and Finance. Translate requirements into system design, say clearly what Workday can and cannot do and advise where in the landscape a problem is best solved.

  • Run it like a production system. Tier 2/3 support with root-cause fixes, testing discipline (unit, regression, UAT), the two Workday releases a year and a change log with configuration documentation. You enable the accounting stream leads who handle first-line questions.

  • Build the reports, dashboards and calculated fields that Finance and leadership rely on, and make them self-serve where possible.

  • Be the technical expert on expansions. HCM, treasury, automated VAT reporting and global payroll off DATEV: assess feasibility, design the solution and configure it.

You bring:

  • Workday Financials depth. 5+ years hands-on, including at least one full implementation and the post-go-live ownership of a tenant (hypercare, first closes, releases).

  • Configuration expertise. Core modules (GL, AP, AR, Banking & Settlement), the business process framework, configurable security and the financial data model (FDM, worktags).

  • Reporting. Custom and matrix reports, calculated fields and BIRT.

  • Systems thinking. Experience connecting SaaS business systems (APIs, integration patterns) and the habit of thinking in end-to-end processes across tools.

  • Accounting understanding. Chart of accounts, period close, reconciliations and audit requirements.

  • Engineering mindset. Structured troubleshooting to the root cause, disciplined testing and documentation that others can use.

  • Communication. Excellent English: precise with engineers, plain with finance colleagues.

Nice to have:

  • Hands-on experience with Workday integration tooling: EIBs, Core Connectors, Studio, web services, RaaS and XSLT

  • Proficiency in German

  • Workday Pro certification in Financials or Integrations

  • Multi-entity, multi-currency or multi-GAAP experience (IFRS alongside local GAAP); experience with tax and e-invoicing platforms such as Avalara

  • Accounting Center, Prism Analytics, Extend or Orchestrate

  • A Workday consulting or CoE background

  • A formal accounting background (degree, CPA or equivalent) or experience with internal controls and SOX in a Workday context

You enjoy:

  • Owning a system end to end. Taking over a freshly built tenant and knowing it better than anyone else in the company within months.

  • Depth you can explain. You do the hard configuration and integration work yourself, and you explain the result to accountants and engineers in language each of them understands.

  • Getting the details right where they matter. Financial systems punish sloppiness: a misconfigured business process or a broken integration shows up in the books. You can tell a load-bearing detail (audit trail, data integrity, reconciliations) from polish that can wait.

  • Working like an engineer. You bring testing, documentation and versioned change into Workday and use modern tooling, including AI assistants, to move faster. When a release or a new module moves the ground, you question your own setup first.

What success looks like after your first year:

  • The tenant runs without the implementation partner.

  • The integrations run reliably through every month-end and year-end close: data lands in Workday without manual intervention, and monitoring catches failures before Accounting does.

  • The first year-end close and statutory audit in Workday are done with you answering the auditors' system questions, and two Workday releases are handled end to end.

  • Accounting and Finance treat you as the expert and advisor for everything Workday: requirements are shaped with you from the start, and your call on how a process should run in the system is the one they act on.

Benefits:

🌴 Rest & Time Off (30 paid vacation days, AMBOSS holiday, personal purpose day and more)

🥙Food & Office Comfort (Daily healthy breakfast & lunch by in-house chef in Berlin HQ, AMBOSS daycare, work remotely from other office spaces in Cologne, Sardinia, Cape Town)

🏃 Health, Fitness & Mobility (Urban Sports Club -M plan- , Fitbit Versa 3, Deutschland Ticket…)

Check out the full list of benefits below:

https://go.amboss.com/the-amboss-prescription-de

That’s why we are committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful, and supportive environment where everyone—regardless of gender, age, ethnic or cultural background, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity—is valued and given equal opportunity to thrive. We warmly welcome people of all backgrounds to help us fulfil our mission: empowering all medical professionals to provide the best possible care 🩺

jobs.description:
Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

The Role

Solution Consulting sits at the center of how Omnea wins - deals are complex, cycles are competitive, and multiple stakeholders (finance, procurement, legal, risk) all need to be convinced simultaneously. You are the person who takes a messy, high-stakes, multi-threaded sales process and makes the future state obvious and credible, working strategically with the world's largest logos. You'll be sitting across the table from C-suite executives at companies going through massive transformation projects, at the center of decisions that reshape how they operate.

Solution Consulting is not an established playbook you're stepping into. You're building it. You'll decide how we sell, what our demos look like, how we structure technical validation, and how the function scales as the team grows. You won't be stepping into someone else's playbook. You'll be shaping the entire GTM motion for our most important market.

You'll own & define the technical and business case throughout the sales cycles - from discovery through demo(s), supporting RFPs, and defining the solution approach. That means translating a prospect's current-state, disconnected tools, broken workflows, poor adoption, into a compelling, specific vision of what Omnea makes possible, and building tailored demos across an expanding product surface spanning orchestration, risk, compliance, legal, sourcing, and AP. You'll partner directly with our GTM team to navigate complex, multi-stakeholder multi-country deal - and act as the voice of the market back into product and GTM: what's working, what's not, and what needs to change.

What You'll Do

  • Own the technical strategy on our largest, highest-stakes enterprise deals: lead deep discovery across Heads of Procurement, IT, Security, and Finance, and translate what you uncover into a technical narrative compelling enough to justify a strategic investment, not just a tool purchase.

  • Multi-thread every stakeholder in the deal, from operational users to economic buyers, and navigate the political dynamics between teams that have never had to agree on a system before.

  • Scope, design, and own proof-of-concept projects end to end, combining a prospect's current state and processes within the Omnea platform to validate what that specific buying committee needs to see - not only a demo can run smoothly.

  • Present the outcome of a PoV and the roadmap to full implementation directly to executives up to C-level, framing the conversation around measurable ROI rather than a features checklist.

  • Build the reusable collateral, solution patterns, and demo frameworks that outlast your own deals: what you create should make every SE who joins after you productive faster than you were.

  • Mentor teammates on customer engagement and technical strategy, and help define what a great Solution Consultant at Omnea actually looks like, since the function itself is still being built.

  • Work hand in hand with Product: Bring competitive intelligence and prospect insight back from the field, and work with Product to shape what we build and how we position it.


What's Different About This Role

  • This is a career-defining chance to help build Omnea's GTM and Solution Consulting function from the ground up in the U.S., at a company that's still writing its playbook rather than handing you one.

  • You'll own complex enterprise deals end to end, working directly with AEs and senior customer stakeholders, which means you'll influence not just how individual deals get won but how the entire Solution Consulting function operates as it scales.

  • We're a flat, high-bar team where senior hires are expected to be self-directed from day one: you won't be eased in with a slow ramp or a junior support structure, you'll be trusted with real ownership immediately.

  • The company is on an incredibly strong growth trajectory with enterprise momentum behind it, which means the scope for you to create visible, immediate impact is significant rather than incremental.

  • Expect a genuinely meritocratic culture, one with high standards and direct feedback, where performance is recognized quickly and equity upside reflects the level of ownership and impact you actually have.

About you

Someone who thrives in this role is highly ambitious, genuinely energized by ambiguity and wants to influence how this function works from the ground up. They're also an exceptional individual contributor first: whatever they've been trusted with before, they've delivered on it.

  • 5-7+ years in enterprise sales engineering, solutions engineering, or senior technical consulting, ideally in B2B SaaS

  • A track record supporting high-contract-value enterprise deals - you know that winning one takes strategic positioning and deep discovery.

  • Comfortable working across large organizations with stakeholders at every level

  • Experience owning strategic accounts, mentoring others, or shaping solution strategy in a high-growth environment

  • An excellent communicator who can explain the same system to a procurement analyst and a CTO, and be credible to both

  • Proven as a top-performing individual contributor, with the ambition to go further: helping shape how the Solution Consulting function operates, not just working inside it.

  • Able to work from our New York office at least three days per week




At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

  • We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

jobs.title: Senior AI - Computer Vision Engineer - UK
jobs.description:
Senior AI / Computer Vision Engineer

Build the spatial AI behind the future of construction

At XYZ Reality, we've created the world's first engineering-grade Augmented Reality solution for construction. Our technology, The Atom, is already being used on major construction projects around the world to help teams build more accurately, efficiently and with fewer mistakes.

Our R&D team applies computer vision, spatial AI and machine learning to one of the most demanding real-world settings there is: the active construction site.

We’re looking for a Senior AI / Computer Vision Engineer with deep expertise in 3D computer vision and spatial AI to join the team and help develop the perception technology behind our products.

As a Series B business entering our next phase of growth, we're investing in our R&D capability and growing our team. This great opportunity will be based out of our Angel, London office on a hybrid basis, 2-3 days per week.

The Role

This is an opportunity to solve computer vision problems that exist at the intersection of the digital and physical world.

You’ll develop the perception and scene-understanding systems that enable our wearable technology to recognise construction objects, understand complex 3D environments, and relate what’s on site to the design model, using real-world sensor data.

For this role, 3D / spatial computer vision expertise is fundamental. We’re looking for someone who understands how AI and computer vision can reason about physical space, not simply someone with broader AI or machine learning experience.

You’ll work across research, algorithm development, optimisation, deployment and productisation, taking sophisticated computer vision techniques and turning them into robust technology capable of performing on active construction sites.

You’ll bring senior technical expertise to the team as we build our capability and presence in Calgary. You’ll also collaborate closely with our Navigation, Embedded Software, Hardware and Product teams across the wider business.

This is a role where you can combine deep technical work with real-world impact, seeing the algorithms and systems you develop ultimately deployed through wearable technology on some of the world's most complex construction projects.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Develop advanced computer vision algorithms for construction scene understanding and spatial intelligence.

  • Design and develop semantic segmentation, object detection and instance segmentation models.

  • Build algorithms capable of understanding 3D environments, spatial relationships and physical geometry.

  • Develop automated BIM correspondence and object-matching capabilities.

  • Develop algorithms using multi-modal sensor data.

  • Combine AI, 3D vision, SLAM and BIM to develop geometric and spatial reasoning capabilities.

  • Explore emerging scene representation techniques including Gaussian Splatting and NeRFs.

  • Improve localisation-assisted perception and robustness across varying lighting, weather and real-world site conditions.

  • Design, train and evaluate large-scale deep learning models.

  • Develop data pipelines supporting supervised, self-supervised and semi-supervised learning.

  • Evaluate emerging foundation models, multimodal AI and modern computer vision techniques where they can add meaningful value.

  • Optimise models for embedded deployment, improving inference speed, accuracy and robustness.

  • Deploy and optimise models for embedded GPU platforms.

  • Build and improve production inference pipelines, benchmarking performance, latency and accuracy.

  • Contribute to technical architecture, design reviews and our technical direction.

  • Share knowledge and mentor other engineers as the team continues to grow.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years’ industrial experience in Computer Vision, with strong hands-on experience solving complex technical problems.

  • MSc or PhD in Computer Vision, AI, Computer Science or a related discipline.

  • Experience with perception for autonomous or embodied systems, such as SLAM, sensor fusion or state estimation, would be valuable.

  • Deep expertise in 3D Computer Vision / Spatial AI, this is a core requirement for the role.

  • Strong understanding of geometry, spatial relationships and scene understanding.

  • Experience developing and deploying computer vision and deep learning systems in production.

  • Strong Python development skills and expert knowledge of PyTorch.

  • Experience with semantic segmentation, object detection, image understanding and modern computer vision architectures.

  • Experience designing and training large-scale deep learning models and working with large image datasets.

  • Strong mathematical foundations in machine learning and computer vision.

  • Ability to bridge research and production engineering, comfortable exploring emerging techniques while remaining focused on building robust, deployable products.

  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills and the ability to work through complex, ambiguous technical challenges.

  • A collaborative approach and the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary engineering teams.

What matters most for this role is genuine depth in 3D / spatial computer vision and the ability to apply that expertise to complex, real-world engineering problems.

We’re particularly interested in someone who is curious about where computer vision and AI are heading, but who also has the practical engineering mindset to turn emerging research into technology that works reliably outside of the lab.

What You Could Be Working On

From the outset, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to some of our highest-priority R&D initiatives, including:

  • 3D construction scene understanding

  • Construction semantic segmentation

  • Automated BIM understanding and object correspondence

  • Spatial reasoning across wearable sensor data

  • Embedded AI deployment

  • Foundation models for construction understanding

  • Perception for wearable AR

Why Join Us

  • 🚀 Work at the intersection of Spatial AI, 3D Computer Vision, AR and real-world engineering

  • 🧠 Solve genuinely difficult perception and scene-understanding problems

  • 🥽 Develop AI that ultimately runs through physical, wearable technology – not just software on a screen

  • 🏗️ See your work applied to some of the world’s most ambitious construction projects

  • 📈 Join a Series B business at an exciting stage of international growth

  • 🔬 Work alongside specialists across Computer Vision, AI, Navigation, Embedded Software and Hardware

  • 💡 Have meaningful influence over technical architecture and the future direction of our perception technology

  • 🌍 Build technology with tangible, real-world impact

If you’re passionate about 3D computer vision and spatial AI, enjoy solving difficult problems at the intersection of research and engineering, and want to see your work move from algorithms into technology being used in the physical world, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Paid Social Specialist - UK&I
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are seeking a Paid Social Specialist to join our UK&I Media team. In this role, you will be responsible for planning and executing Paid Social marketing campaigns across multiple brands. You will play an important role in executing new campaigns and the wider strategy to grow the channel within our local structure for the UK & Ireland.

 

You will be reporting directly to the Paid Social & Programmatic Lead, while working closely with other stakeholders in the UK&I Media team and across the wider UK&I cluster, including Marketing, Brand, Creative, AdTech teams and more. In order to drive successful campaigns, you will utilise all the latest solutions and tools from Paid Social platforms (including Meta, Snapchat, X, TikTok, Reddit and similar).

 

To succeed in this role, you need to be a self-driven and self-motivated individual - ready to work hands-on across multiple accounts. You will actively manage and optimise campaigns, whilst working closely with the team and expanding your digital marketing experience. The ideal candidate will be a positive and adaptable team player, with a problem-solving attitude, and good communication and presentation skills.

 

YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR:

  • Executing and managing a wide range of Paid Social campaigns hands-on across multiple platforms (including Meta, Snapchat, X, TikTok, Reddit and similar), for all verticals (casino, live casino, sports betting) and multiple brands.

  • Working closely with the team to analyse metrics from internal tools and platforms to track campaign performance and continuously optimise our accounts.

  • Implementing new channel solutions and running regular A/B tests across our activity, aligned with the overall goals and KPIs.

  • Building active collaboration with our key partners across external digital platform teams and tech vendors.

  • Navigating complex tracking and attribution systems with the Media team and AdTech teams to maximise our measurement capabilities across the channel and expand our incrementality testing.

  • Collaborating with Brand and Creative teams to ensure messaging and creatives are aligned across the funnel and utilise channel best practices.

  • Activating CRM data within our platforms to execute highly targeted segmentation strategies as well as drive lookalike modelling.

  • Staying ahead of platform updates, new ad formats, and emerging media opportunities.

  • Working closely with the Central Marketing teams to ensure alignment, consistency and best practice sharing across markets.

  • Ensuring full compliance with regional advertising regulations and other compliance standards.

OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING:

  • 1-2 years of experience in Paid Social or wider digital marketing role (client side or agency). Gaming industry experience will be considered a plus.

  • Hands-on experience working with some of the popular social media platforms (Meta, Snapchat, X, TikTok and/or Reddit).

  • Basic knowledge of Paid Social best practices - from a technical perspective, through performance delivery, to creative guidelines and tools.

  • Strong analytical mindset, confident in spotting opportunities for growth. Professional experience in using analytics tools will be considered a plus (Tableau/Looker, Google Analytics, Appsflyer or similar).

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.

  • Fluent English is essential for this role, both written and spoken.

At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We’re a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 19 offices worldwide.

jobs.title: Meewerkend voorman buitenterrein Universiteit Tilburg (vacature voor doelgroep Banenafspraak)

Want als jij denkt dat coachen bestaat uit een uurtje trainen, een beetje gezellig kletsen met klanten en daarna weer naar huis gaan, dan is dit niet jouw plek. Wij zoeken geen trainer. Wij zoeken een coach. Iemand die begrijpt dat mensen niet bij ons komen voor een trainingsschema. Ze komen omdat ze hun leven willen veranderen. Misschien herken je dit… Je bent trainer. Je geeft goede trainingen. Je klanten zijn enthousiast. Maar toch hoor je iedere week weer: "Deze week was druk..." "Volgende week pak ik het echt op..." En diep van binnen voel je dat er iets ontbreekt. Dat gevoel klopt. Want trainen is niet het moeilijke. Gedrag veranderen is het moeilijke. Mensen verantwoordelijkheid laten nemen. Wij verkopen geen losse trainingen. Wij bouwen resultaatgerichte groeitrajecten waarin mensen fysiek én mentaal sterker worden. Want een sterker lichaam is mooi, maar een sterker mens is nog veel waardevoller.Wat verwachten we van jou? Je hoeft vandaag niet de beste coach van Nederland te zijn. Maar je moet wel de wil hebben om dat ooit te worden. Bij ons geldt één overtuiging: The will must be stronger than the skill. Je bent: ✅ Leergierig ✅ Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid ✅ Je kunt eerlijke feedback ontvangen én geven ✅ Je zoekt oplossingen in plaats van excuses ✅ Je wilt iedere dag beter worden

jobs.title: a Logistics Worker
jobs.description: Tasks, salary, and working through Charlie works  30 September 2026 4 min read What exactly does a logistics worker do? Do you want to know what a logistics worker does before you start working in the Netherlands? In short, a logistics worker ensures that products end up in the right place. This starts with unloading trucks and ends with preparing orders for shipment. A lot happens in between: scanning, sorting, packing, and sometimes driving a pallet truck or forklift. The job is physical, varied, and very suitable if you enjoy working with your hands. You do not need a diploma, and basic English or Polish is often sufficient on the work floor. That is why this is a popular first job for migrant workers from Poland, Hungary, Slovakia, and Romania. What is a logistics worker? A logistics worker usually works in a warehouse or distribution center. You are part of a team that manages the flow of goods. Think of large centers for webshops, supermarkets, or transport companies. There are thousands of these types of locations in the Netherlands, especially around Venlo, Tilburg, Rotterdam, and Utrecht. The role is broad. One day you pick orders, the next you help in the packing department or check the stock. Do you want to know more about what such a location looks like from the inside? Then read our article about working in a distribution center in the Netherlands . The main tasks at a glance Tasks vary by company, but these are the most common activities: - Order picking : removing products from the shelves using a handheld scanner or voice-picking system. - Packing : preparing orders for shipment, including labels and shipping documents. - Loading and unloading : filling or emptying trucks, often with a pallet truck. - Checking stock : counting and registering whether everything in the system is correct. - Forklift driving : moving pallets (you need a certificate for this). - Sorting : distributing packages by destination or rout...

jobs.title: Management Consultant (Public Sector & Defence)
jobs.description:
How do you build a national vaccine supply chain? Turn complex, novel defence requirements into a workable procurement? Help a council make every pound work harder?

  

In Efficio’s UK Public Sector practice, you’ll combine analytical thinking with hands-on delivery: working alongside clients to get into the detail and help turn difficult decisions into practical results, tackling challenging questions, and driving value for the taxpayer. 

 

Get close to the challenge

As a Management Consultant, you’ll own defined workstreams with support from experienced project leaders. Depending on the engagement, you’ll:

  • Find the story in the data: Analyse spending, suppliers, and operational challenges to develop practical recommendations clients can act on.  Deploy our AI-enabled data solutions to drive efficient decision-making. 
  • Move from insight to delivery: Develop business cases and commercial strategies, drive procurements and negotiations, ensuring government gets the best value for money from its suppliers.
  • Keep things moving: Manage workstream plans, deliverables and client relationships, bringing stakeholders together to resolve challenges and reach decisions.
  • Make the team stronger: Support junior colleagues and share knowledge with client teams, helping improvements last beyond the project

 

Our practice also includes Security Check (SC)-cleared delivery and Developed Vetting (DV)-cleared capability for selected assignments, supporting important government and defence work.  We especially welcome applications from individuals with UK security clearance to SC (with eligibility for DV) or DV, though this is not a requirement. 

 

Build depth while keeping your horizons wide.

  • Procurement and supply chain are at the heart of our business. You’ll develop your specialism alongside colleagues who understand the discipline, supported by the Efficio Academy, practitioner-led training, and learning on live projects.
  • Be part of a business that is growing quickly, and fast becoming a leader in AI procurement solutions
  • Build your UK public sector expertise across different organisations and challenges, while retaining opportunities to explore private sector experience.
  • You’ll also join a collaborative, inclusive team that values thoughtful questions, fresh perspectives, and people who bring others with them.

 

Bring your experience and an appetite to learn

Ideally, you will have experience in consulting, the public sector or a relevant industry role, with strong analytical and communication skills, and practical proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint.

Procurement, supply chain, commercial delivery, or transformation experience is particularly relevant. Familiarity with UK public-sector governance, regulated procurement or business case approvals are also a positive.

We're after individuals with sound judgement, strong relationship-building skills, and the drive to take ownership while continuing to learn.

Flexibility and willingness to travel to client sites is important, though hybrid working is often available.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer  (Excavator Automation)
jobs.description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 

Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 

The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.  

 

 

About the Job

The autonomy team at Gravis builds autonomous systems for excavators operating in real construction environments. This role is at the intersection of system engineering, integration, field deployments, and debugging.

We are looking for an engineer with a degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Robotics or relevant fields and at least 2 years of practical, hands-on experience working with real systems - and if they fail, you can help us figure out why. This is not an entry-level or new-graduate role.

You will help define and execute system-level test scenarios, support atypical and beta deployments, and act as a technical bridge between the field and the engineering team. You will help train our field engineers and keep them in touch with fast evolving autonomy capabilities.

What you will do

  • Validate system behavior across machines, environments, and operating conditions

  • Identify edge cases, failure modes, and operational limits

  • Collaborate with engineering teams on making technical decisions on a system level

  • Investigate system failure during field testing or deployments

  • Apply hotfixes when appropriate

  • Support or conduct deployments if needed, especially pilots or beta customers

  • Support/conduct atypical deployments, pilots, and beta customers

  • Capture lessons learned from deployments and feed them back into system testing and design

  • Help prioritize fixes and improvements based on real-world impact

  • Strong system-level troubleshooting and debugging skills

  • C++ and Python programming skills, proficiency in git systems

  • Comfortable working in field environments (construction sites, test yards, deployments)

  • Ability to travel abroad, according to needs of the business

jobs.title: Senior Security Operations Engineer
jobs.description:
As a Security Operations Engineer, you will help protect DiliTrust's SaaS platform, cloud infrastructure, networks and production environments. You will join the Infrastructure & Security team, a 12-person team spread across France, Canada and Spain, and work in an international context (Europe, North America and EMA). The infrastructure you will secure is managed in an automated way and counts more than 350 assets hosted across our cloud providers. 

You will contribute to the continuous improvement of our security posture through monitoring, incident response, vulnerability management, hardening and automation, and you will work closely with infrastructure, DevOps, development and product teams so that security is embedded into our architectures, operations and delivery processes. 

Missions: 

In this role, your main responsibilities will include: 

Security monitoring & incident response 

· Monitor the security of networks, cloud infrastructure, systems, applications and endpoints. 

· Administer, configure and continuously improve our security tools, including CNAPP, SIEM, EDR, bastion, ZTNA, PKI, antivirus and WAF solutions. 

· Continuously evolve our detection mechanisms and threat-detection scenarios. 

· Investigate security alerts and incidents, support incident handling, and contribute to root-cause analysis, remediation and post-incident reviews. 

Hardening, vulnerabilities & secure architecture 

· Implement hardening measures and support vulnerability identification, prioritization, remediation and follow-up through action plans. 

· Validate the security aspects of IT architectures and application projects. 

· Actively participate in security audits and penetration tests: scoping, support during the exercise, remediation of findings and follow-up. 

· Test products and run technical validations on prototype environments before they reach production. 

Automation & Infrastructure as Code 

· Automate deployments and security / infrastructure operations using Infrastructure as Code, configuration management and scripting. 

· Create and maintain security procedures, incident-response playbooks, operational documentation and technical standards. 

Roadmap, watch & knowledge sharing 

· Define and deliver the team's security roadmap together with the Hiring Manager and your peers. 

· Keep an active watch on threats and security news, and share what you learn with the team. 

Candidate Profile: 

Experience & seniority 

· You have at least 5 years of professional experience in Security Operations, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure Security, Cloud Security or a related field (network, systems or cloud engineering with a strong security component). 

· You have practical experience with security monitoring, incident response, vulnerability management, system hardening and operational security. 

Mindset & collaboration 

· You are passionate about cybersecurity and interested in automation and the DevOps culture; you would rather automate a process than repeat it. 

· You are analytical, autonomous, versatile and rigorous, with a strong sense of service and good synthesis skills. 

· You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and you are confident in your expertise without losing the team spirit. 

· You enjoy working collaboratively in an international, distributed team and have a good command of English. 

Technical Skills: 

Required 

· Good knowledge of Linux (Debian-based environments in particular), Docker and Kubernetes;. 

· Good knowledge of networking, enough to design, routing and firewall rules: TCP/IP, DNS and TLS; static routing, VLANs, segmentation and NAT; stateful and application-level firewall rule design; reverse proxies and load balancers; VPN and overlay technologies (WireGuard, IPsec); ZTNA principles (identity-aware access, device posture, micro-segmentation); cloud networking (VPC, peering, private endpoints). 

· Ability to manage network and security configurations as code, using Infrastructure as Code and automation tools such as Terraform, Ansible and AWX. 

· Good knowledge of PKI and certificate management: CA hierarchies, certificate lifecycle (issuance, renewal, revocation, automation), TLS / mTLS, key and secret management. 

· Administration of security tools: CNAPP, SIEM, EDR, bastion, ZTNA and PKI, including interpreting security events and alerts. 

· Hands-on experience with WAF (policy and rule tuning). 

· Familiarity with monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana and Datadog. 

· Ability to script and automate repetitive operational or security tasks. 

Nice to have 

· Knowledge of Google Cloud Platform or an equivalent cloud environment. 

· An active interest in security news, emerging threats, conferences and meetups. 

Our Security & Infrastructure Environment: 

· Cloud: Google Cloud Platform and other cloud providers, with automated infrastructure management (700+ assets) 

· Systems & containers: Linux (Debian), Docker, Kubernetes 

· Automation: Ansible, AWX, Terraform 

· Network & access: ZTNA, bastion 

· Security tooling: SIEM, EDR, WAF, antivirus, PKI 

· Monitoring: Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog 

Process: 

· Interview with a member of the Talent Acquisition team (30–45 minutes) 

· Technical interview with the SecOps Team Lead and the Team manager, including a practical case study (about 90 minutes) 

· Final interview with the CTO (30 minutes)

jobs.title: Data Engineering & Analytics Manager
jobs.description:
Insurance is a numbers business, and most of those numbers are harder to trust than they look. You would lead the team that defines the numbers Insify runs on, from the event a customer fires on our website to the report a risk carrier audits months later.


About the Role

You would lead our Data & Analytics team of 3-4 engineers end to end: ingestion, the warehouse and its models, the metric layer, and the analysis and reporting built on top of it. It is a small team with a big surface, so there is nowhere to hide and nothing you can't reach.

We are deliberately not splitting data engineering from analytics. At our size the hard problems sit in the handover between the two, and we want one person who enjoys that whole puzzle.

The team serves four groups with genuinely different needs. Growth wants hourly to daily signals and can live with approximately right. Carrier reporting and corporate finance are calendar-locked and need numbers that reconcile and survive an audit months later. Actuarial needs depth and lineage over speed. Prioritising here is arbitration between things that fail in different ways, and the arbitration is yours.

It's a hands-on role. You can open the warehouse and read the models, you review a new data model before it ships, and your team trusts your technical judgement because you still use it. The job is still the team: its own game, its communication, and each person in it. When something slips, hands-on work is the first thing that yields.


What you'll be doing
  • Leading a team of 3-4 data engineers and analysts end to end: what it builds, how it runs in production, and who you hire and grow to get there
  • Running discovery with the teams we serve: understanding what they need from data, and bringing the platform and datasets that enable them
  • Owning the trade-offs between Growth, carrier reporting, finance and actuarial: deciding what the team works on, driving alignment with key partners across other teams, and saying no when the answer is no
  • Making the platform scale: a new country, carrier or product should mean configuration and reused models, and recurring manual work, like carrier reporting and cash reconciliation, should turn into automation
  • Bringing engineering excellence to how the team works: data contracts with product teams, testing in CI, alerts that get resolved, a way to try changes before they hit production
  • Challenging our ideas and bringing your own. We encourage each other to act this way, so you can expect the same from others

    • What you'll need
  • You've managed or led a data team before, including hiring, feedback and growing people. It doesn't have to be for long, but it has to be real and you have to want more of it
  • Depth on one side of the data stack and working fluency on the other. You still love shipping, you review your team's work, and they trust your judgement on it
  • A track record of shaping what gets built, not only how: you've turned business problems into data priorities, cut scope, and can show the decisions that followed
  • Ownership & impact instinct - when needed you go beyond your team's boundaries to get to results
  • You get real leverage out of AI in your daily work, and you can say where it helped, and where it hurt. Your team gets that from you: you try new tools and ways of working first, and bring the ones that stick

    • Nice to have
  • Experience with reporting that has to reconcile: bordereaux, revenue, cash, ledger
  • Experience building B2B products, especially in insurance & fintech
  • Experience working on a product distributed across different country markets
  • Experience with Databricks, dbt and event tracking (Snowplow or similar)

    • Our stack

    Databricks with Unity Catalog, dbt with SQL-based transformation, running on AWS.

    None of this is a hard requirement, and you don't need to know all of our stack. We care more about how you reason about data, systems and teams than which tools you have used. Strong on most of it? Apply.


    How we hire
    Five conversations, each with a clear purpose, and you hear where you stand after every one:
    1. Leadership. We look at your experience with performance management, personal development and building teams.
    2. Data Model Review. You review a change to our warehouse models with two of our engineers.
    3. Data Platform Design. A modelling and platform problem close to what we deal with.
    4. Values Interview. We look at your approach to work, and how it adds to our Values.
    5. Meet the Founder.
    You get the outcome within three days of your last round, with specific feedback either way.
     

    We offer
  • Competitive compensation. We offer a salary in the range of 85k-110k EUR plus performance-based equity grants
  • Hybrid. 3 days in the office, 2 from home, up to 4 weeks a year from abroad, 25 holiday days
  • Pension. 6% employer contribution
  • Wellbeing budget. €50 net a month via Epassi, from the gym to takeaway, rolls over
  • Learning and coaching. Internal leadership programs and coaching
  • Central Amsterdam office. Shared lunches, dogs, Friday drinks, high-spec MacBook Pro

    • About Insify

    Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by €43M in total funding from world-class investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years, we've expanded from the Netherlands into France and Germany, and we're just getting started. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance.

    We aren't just building a company; we're leading a revolution. Our culture is intense, high-stakes, and mission-driven. We hire smart, ambitious "owners" who possess a relentless drive to win. This is an environment for those who thrive on challenges, value intellectual honesty, and share our mindset of becoming a global category leader.

    Our founding team consists of seasoned entrepreneurs who have previously built iconic businesses like HelloFresh, Bloomon, and SumUp. We bring that same bias for speed, scale, and high standards to one of the most structurally broken experiences in financial services. Together, we combine that deep fintech and e-commerce expertise with cutting-edge AI to stay ahead of the curve.

jobs.title: Director of Cloud Infrastructure & Security
jobs.description:
Vestiaire Collective is the leading global platform for desirable pre-loved fashion and a pioneer in transforming how people consume fashion.
 
Our mission is simple: make circular fashion the norm, not the exception.
Through technology, expertise, and a highly engaged global community, we enable millions of people to buy and sell fashion in a more sustainable way.
 
Founded in Paris in 2009, Vestiaire Collective is now a globally scaled marketplace with offices in Paris, London, Berlin, New York, Singapore, and Ho Chi Minh City, and logistics hubs across Europe, Asia, and the US.
Today, we are a team of around 600 people from over 50 nationalities, united by a shared ambition: to drive meaningful change in the fashion industry.
 
Our values, Activism, Transparency, Dedication, Greatness, and Collective, shape how we build, collaborate, and grow every day.

About the Role:

Vestiaire Collective runs a global marketplace on AWS and GCP — Kubernetes, Kafka, Terraform, Vault, Cloudflare, Datadog, a large PHP application under active modernisation, a series of microservices in different tech stacks (Goland, PHP, Node) and a fast-growing surface of AI-powered services. 

 

As Director of Cloud Infrastructure and Security, you will lead a small team of six senior individual contributors across Cloud Infrastructure (DevOps/SRE) and Security. This is a hands-on Director role: alongside setting the strategy and roadmap, you will work directly with the team on architecture, technical decisions, incidents and delivery. You will be accountable, alongside Product Development teams, for the reliability, cost-efficiency and security posture of everything we run in production.

What you will do:

Leadership across two teams

  • Directly lead, develop and retain a small team of six (6) experienced engineers across Cloud Infrastructure and Security. This is a player-coach role without multiple management layers, so you will remain close to the team’s technical work and day-to-day priorities.

  • Define a joint roadmap for both teams, aligned to business priorities and risk appetite, and make explicit calls on what we will not do.

  • Establish clear KPIs, SLOs and risk metrics, and report regularly to leadership on reliability, cost and security posture.

  • Set the operating model: what product teams self-serve behind guardrails versus what your teams own centrally. 

  • Foster a culture where reliability and security are shared accountabilities, not tickets thrown over a wall, including establishing a Security Champions model across engineering.

Cloud infrastructure, reliability and platform

  • Own our AWS and GCP footprint end to end: EKS, networking, secrets (Vault), data stores (RDS/Aurora, MSK, ElastiCache, MongoDB Atlas, OpenSearch) and the edge (Cloudflare).

  • Establish real reliability engineering practice: SLOs and error budgets, capacity planning, and a business continuity plan.

  • Drive infrastructure-as-code maturity: Automating Terraform change application, advancing our move to GitOps (ArgoCD), and enforcing guardrails at creation time with policy-as-code (Kyverno/OPA) so provisioning is safe, self-serve and reviewable.

  • Consolidate observability into a single source of truth for metrics, logs and traces.

  • Improve developer experience and delivery throughput: CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions), paved roads, test environments on demand, and delivery metrics that hold up.

  • Own FinOps: infrastructure cost per unit of business value, cost accountability pushed back to each team, and continued run-rate reduction. Cost discipline is a first-class objective.

  • Support the modernisation of our core platform: Tech migrations, runtime and framework upgrades, and continuous database and Kubernetes upgrades.

  • Attack toil systematically: automate the recurring requests, and hand safe self-service back to product teams rather than absorbing the work.

  • Grow the foundations for AI-augmented engineering and operations

Security

  • Own security strategy and posture across cloud, application, identity, detection and response, building and improving the governance: risk register, published roadmap, remediation SLAs, and a recurring reporting cadence for leadership.

  • Strengthen cloud security posture management (CNAPP) and secure-by-default configurations across all environments.

  • Improve Embedding security into the SDLC and CI/CD: establish full static-analysis and dependency-scanning coverage with clear criteria for when critical findings block a release.

  • Mature vulnerability management, penetration testing and our bug bounty program into one prioritised program with SLAs and aging reports that measurably reduce risk.

  • Advance identity and access management toward least privilege and zero trust: automated provisioning from groups, and periodic access reviews.

  • Mature logging, detection and incident response, closing SIEM coverage gaps

  • Set guardrails for safe AI adoption (shadow AI outside approved paths, data and prompt leakage, prompt injection, model abuse) and defend against AI-enabled fraud and phishing.

  • Ensure compliance with GDPR, PCI DSS v4, NIS2, and CIS v8, including a maintained, reusable evidence library rather than evidence gathered on request.

  • Collaboration with legal and finance teams on compliance and forensic investigation topics

  • Manage third-party and supply-chain risk with vendor tiering and a recurring review cadence.

  • Own the security-built services your team already runs (back-office authentication and ACL, banning/fraud tooling, phone verification) and decide what to keep, hand over or retire.

  • Own endpoint security and partner closely with Corporate IT on device and identity coverage.

  • Keep security awareness and training relevant to a threat landscape that now includes AI-enabled social engineering.

Who you are:

  • 8+ years with a Significant experience in Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, DevOps, SRE or Cloud Security, including experience leading engineers.

  • You may currently be an Engineering Manager, Senior Engineering Manager or Head of who is ready to broaden your scope and step into a first Director role.

  • Strong practical experience with public cloud, ideally AWS, Kubernetes and Infrastructure-as-Code, with the willingness to remain close to architecture, incidents and technical delivery.

  • Track record establishing reliability practice at scale — SLOs, incident management, on-call, capacity planning, disaster recovery.

  • Demonstrable cloud cost optimisation / FinOps results at meaningful scale.

  • Strong grounding in cloud and application security fundamentals — IAM, network security, secrets management, CSPM, OWASP Top 10 — and the judgement to know when to hire the depth you don't have.

  • Working knowledge of compliance frameworks (GDPR, DORA, PCI DSS, NIS2) and how to turn requirements into practical controls.

  • Experience leading through incidents and security events under pressure.

  • Excellent communication skills: able to make a technical trade-off legible to a CFO and a risk decision legible to an engineer.

  • Comfortable operating with a lean team — ruthless prioritisation, automation over headcount, pragmatism over perfection.

 

Our Tech Stack includes: 

  • AWS cloud (primary), GCP, Kubernetes, Vault, Cloudflare, Datadog, ArgoCD, Okta. Applications are built on top of PHP 8, Golang and Node.js, using MariaDB, MongoDB and Kafka.

What We Offer

  • Purpose-driven work at scale
    Join a company reshaping the fashion industry towards circularity, you directly contributes to reducing waste and extending the life of luxury items.
  • High-impact scope & ownership
    Work on products used globally, where your decisions have immediate, measurable impact on millions of users across 70+ countries.
  • A truly international environment
    Collaborate with a diverse team of 50+ nationalities across Paris, London, Berlin, New York, Singapore, and Ho Chi Minh City.
  • Career acceleration in a fast-moving scale-up
    Take ownership early, grow fast, and shape your path, as an expert or a future leader.
  • Learning & growth as a priority
    Dedicated budget, continuous feedback culture, and opportunities to work on cutting-edge topics (AI, marketplace dynamics, scalability, etc.).
  • Flexible ways of working
    Hybrid model (typically 2 days remote per week), with trust and autonomy at the core of how we operate.
  • Give back through action
    2 paid days per year to support a cause of your choice and actively contribute to positive impact beyond your day-to-day role.
  • Competitive compensation & benefits
    Including bonus, health coverage, lunch vouchers, Gym-Pass, and additional legal perks depending on your location.

 

 

Research shows that candidates from underrepresented backgrounds including women, people with disabilities, and other marginalized communities, are less likely to apply unless they meet 100% of the criteria.

At Vestiaire Collective, we believe diversity drives better decisions, stronger products, and more meaningful impact.

Vestiaire Collective is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

At Makersite, we're pioneering the future of sustainable product development and digital collaboration. As a leading platform for product lifecycle management (PLM), we empower companies to make smarter, more sustainable decisions across their entire supply chain. Our cutting-edge software enables teams to design, prototype, and manufacture with transparency, efficiency, and responsibility—reducing environmental impact while optimizing performance. 

We're a fast-growing, innovative company that thrives on creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning. If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation. 

 

Who we're looking for: 

 

As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Site Reliability Engineers who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. If you're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you! 

This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will need to reside in Germany with legal working permits or residence permits.  

 

The role:  

 

  • Infrastructure Management: Maintain and manage new and existing infrastructure, balancing both proactive and reactive maintenance. 

  • Technical Problem Identification and Resolution: Identify technical problems and bottlenecks. Collaborate with the engineering team to resolve these issues efficiently. 

  • ISO Compliance: Ensure all infrastructure and processes are in compliance with ISO standards, and assist in maintaining those certifications. 

  • Production Support: Work closely with engineering teams to ensure our developed tools and applications run smoothly in a production environment. 

  • Backup Management: Oversee and manage all system backups, ensuring Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO) are met. 

  • Release Management Support: Assist in managing software releases to minimize disruption and maximize uptime. 

  • Off-Duty Support: Participate in an off-duty or pager duty rotation to provide round-the-clock system reliability and support. 

  • Incident Review and Analysis: Lead postmortems following any system disruptions, and help identify ways to prevent future incidents. 

  • Infrastructure Monitoring: Monitor system alerts and respond quickly to maintain system health and maximize uptime. 

  • Capacity Planning: Participate in planning server capacity, ensuring we can meet current and future demands 


  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or a related field. 

  • 7+ years of experience in site reliability engineering or a similar role.

  • 3+ years in SRE, DevOps, or related infrastructure roles  

  • Experience supporting/coaching less experienced team members. 

  • Ability in building alerting and observability into all production systems (Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch etc.)

  • Proven experience with cloud platforms, preferably AWS (ECS, EC2, etc) or Azure. 

  • Extensive experience using Terraform and Ansible. 

  • Incident management, postmortems, and on-call quality of life experience

  • Familiarity with disaster recovery planning and testing. 

  • Strong knowledge of system monitoring tools. 

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex issues. 

  • Strong communication and teamwork skills. 

  • Proven experience managing system backups and understanding of RTO and RPO. 

  • Familiarity with release management processes. 

  • Ability to work in an on-call capacity. 

  • Define the Site Reliability Strategy and Execute on it

jobs.title: Global Mobility Lead San Mateo, CA, United States People & Talent
Skolpsykolog
jobs.description: Vill du ha inflytande och vara delaktig i utvecklingsarbetet på din arbetsplats? Då är du välkommen till Tranemo kommun. Här verkar vi för stark känsla av samhörighet och uppmuntran till inflytande och delaktighet. Vi erbjuder gott ledarskap och bra arbetsvillkor. Vi levererar tjänster med god service och hög kvalitet och söker efter engagerade medarbetare som vill vara med och bygga framtidens Tranemo.1 plats(er). ARBETSUPPGIFTERSom skolpsykolog är du en del av den samlade elevhälsan, där medicinska, psykologiska, psykosociala och specialpedagogiska insatser ingår. Elevhälsans uppdrag är att stödja elevernas utveckling mot utbildningens mål genom ett hälsofrämjande, förebyggande och åtgärdande arbete.Du är en del av skolornas elevhälsoteam och bidrar med psykologiska perspektiv på organisations-, grupp- och individnivå. Ditt uppdrag utgår från skollagen och innebär att, i nära samverkan med skolans övriga professioner, främja elevers hälsa, lärande och utveckling. Tillsammans arbetar ni för att skapa en tillgänglig, trygg och inkluderande lärmiljö där alla elever ges goda förutsättningar att utvecklas.Genom konsultation, handledning och kompetensutveckling stödjer du rektorer, pedagoger och övrig skolpersonal i det förebyggande och hälsofrämjande arbetet. Du erbjuder även stöd och rådgivning till vårdnadshavare i frågor som rör barns och ungas utveckling, psykiska hälsa och lärande. Konsultation till förskolans pedagoger förekommer vid behov. Du deltar även i kommunens krisstödsorganisation.På individnivå genomför du bedömningar och konsultationer utifrån frågeställningar som är relevanta för elevens skolsituation. Du ansvarar för psykologutredningar inför mottagande i anpassad grundskola och anpassad gymnasieskola. I uppdraget ingår även vårdhänvisning, remisshantering samt dokumentation i ProRenata enligt gällande lagstiftning och riktlinjer.Arbetet innebär nära samverkan med externa aktörer, såsom barn- och ungdomspsykiatrin, Ungas psykiska hälsa, habiliteringen, socialtjänsten och primärvården, för att säkerställa en samordnad och ändamålsenlig vård- och stödinsats utifrån elevens behov.I Tranemo är du ensam skolpsykolog. Du har ditt kontor på Familjecentralen, där också medarbetarna i skolsocialt team har sina arbetsplatser. Arbetsplatsen präglas av en mycket god gemenskap och hög trivsel där olika perspektiv och kompetenser kompletterar och berikar varandra.Huvuddelen av arbetet sker på plats i Tranemo kommun.Vill du bli en del av vårt elevhälsoarbete och bidra till att skapa goda förutsättningar för barns och ungas lärande och mående? Då ser vi fram emot din ansökan. Vi erbjuder dig ett självständigt, spännande och lärorikt arbete där du tillsammans med engagerade och kompetenta kollegor får göra skillnad för barn och unga.Vi kommer att arbeta med rekryteringen löpande under ansökningstiden.KVALIFIKATIONERKvalifikationerVi söker dig som:    • är legitimerad psykolog     • är trygg i din yrkesroll och kan driva ditt arbete på ett strukturerat och självständigt sätt    • har stort engagemang för elevers lärande, hälsa och utveckling    • har mycket god förmåga att samarbeta med elever, vårdnadshavare och professioner inom och utanför skolanErfarenhet som skolpsykolog, psykolog inom barn- och ungdomspsykiatrin, barn- och ungdomshabilitering eller primärvård för barn och unga är meriterande, liksom erfarenhet av psykologiska bedömningar och utredningar samt konsultation.Körkort är ett krav.Stor vikt läggs vid personlig lämplighet.Löneform: Månadslön.Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.Varaktighet: 6 månader eller längre, tillträde: 2027-01-11  .Arbetstid: Dagtid.Vid intervju behöver du uppvisa pass, nationellt identitetskort eller personbevis där svenskt medborgarskap framgår. Personbevis laddar du enkelt ner via skatteverket.se Om du inte är svensk medborgare behöver du visa upp dokument som styrker din rätt att arbeta i Sverige. Information om lönespann för aktuell tjänst hittar du på Tranemo kommuns hemsida, https://tranemo.se/jobb--foretagande/jobb-och-praktik/lonetransparensVi som arbetsgivare har enligt lag möjlighet att, vid rekrytering till vissa tjänster, begära utdrag ur belastnings- och misstankeregister.Alla dina uppgifter sparas på ditt CV-konto enligt GDPR och du kan enkelt logga in och uppdatera dina uppgifter. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!Vi undanbeder oss bestämt kontakt med mediesäljare, rekryteringssajter och liknande.

jobs.title: Daglig leder
jobs.description:
Kan du få folk med deg? Da har vi en lederjobb utenom det vanlige!Haugesund Turistforening jakter en daglig leder med engasjement, gjennomføringskraft og hjertet på rett plass! Vi har fjellene. Vi har hyttene. Vi har turene. Og vi har fantastiske ansatte og frivillige som brenner for det de gjør. Nå søker vi en leder som skaper engasjement, bygger lag og setter retning for fremtiden! Haugesund Turistforening er en organisasjon med stolte tradisjoner, sterke verdier og store muligheter. Vi søker ikke en leder som bare holder hjulene i gang. Vi søker en som bygger lag, skaper begeistring og får ting til å skje!Er dette deg?
  • Du ser folk, bygger tillit og får det beste ut av menneskene rundt deg.
  • Du er tydelig og handlekraftig – du tar beslutninger og følger dem opp.
  • Du skaper struktur uten å kvele engasjementet.
  • Du er en relasjonsbygger som trives med både ansatte, frivillige, næringsliv og samarbeidspartnere.
  • Du har økonomisk forståelse og vet hvordan gode ideer blir til resultater.
  • Du forstår verdien av natur, friluftsliv og bærekraft.
Hva blir din jobb?Du skal samle laget, sette retning og videreutvikle en av regionens viktige friluftsorganisasjoner. Du skal sørge for god drift, utvikle menneskene rundt deg og bygge videre på det som allerede fungerer godt. Samtidig skal du løfte blikket, skape nye muligheter og gjøre Haugesund Turistforening enda mer synlig og relevant. Du blir vårt ansikt utad – og en leder som er til stede innad.Må du være friluftsekspert for å bli vår neste leder?Du trenger ikke kunne alt om friluftsliv fra dag én – men du må forstå verdien av det! Vi søker en leder med engasjement for mennesker, natur og friluftsliv. Du trenger ikke ha hele karrieren fra denne sektoren. Det viktigste er at du har evnen til å inspirere, samle mennesker og skape resultater – og ønsker å bidra til at enda flere får oppleve gleden ved å være ute.Klar for en lederjobb med mening?Her får du ikke bare en jobb. Du får muligheten til å gjøre en forskjell for mennesker, naturen og friluftslivet på Haugalandet. Vi har laget. Vi har mulighetene. Har du det som skal til for å lede oss videre? Søk stillingen som daglig leder i Haugesund Turistforening!Søknadsfrist: 1. novemberKontakt: Styreleder May Britt Vihovde 930 63 649Elektronisk søknad skal benyttes via "søk på stilling" knappen på siden.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Haugesund Turistforening skal arbeide for et enkelt, aktivt, allsidig og naturvennlig friluftsliv, for sikring av allemannsretten og friluftslivets natur- og kulturgrunnlag. Nå drifter Haugesund Turistforening (HT) 13 hytter, både på fjellet og langs kysten. HT jobber med å legge forholdene til rette for at flest mulig skal få gode naturopplevelser, gjennom blant annet merking og vedlikehold av stier og rutenett, hyttedrift, organisering av turer og arbeid for vern av friluftsområder.

jobs.title: Kreativ Klubbmedarbeider – Bygg fellesskap i Gamvik kommune - 2. gangs utlysning
jobs.description:
Gamvik kommune søker engasjerte klubbmedarbeidere til ungdomsklubben i Mehamn og noe i Gamvik. Vi ser etter deg som liker å være sammen med ungdom, bygger gode relasjoner og ønsker å bidra til aktivitet, trivsel og fellesskap, og som kan skape til et trygt og trivelig sted for ungdommene.

Hva vi ser etter

Vi ser etter deg/dere som:

  • Har interesse for arbeid med ungdom

  • Er positiv, ansvarsbevisst og samarbeidsorientert

  • Er god til å bygge relasjoner og skape tillit

  • Trives med å ta initiativ og skape aktivitet

  • Bidrar til fellesskap og inkludering

  • Erfaring fra arbeid med barn og unge er en fordel, men personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Være en trygg og tydelig voksenperson i ungdomsklubben

  • Bidra til at alle ungdommer blir sett og inkludert

  • Planlegge og gjennomføre aktiviteter sammen med ungdommene. Aktiviteter som ikke kan gjennomføres på klubben, kan flyttes til skolene eller andre kommunale bygg.

  • Motivere til medvirkning og engasjement

  • Bidra til et godt og trygt klubbmiljø

Vi tilbyr

Vi tilbyr

  • En meningsfull jobb hvor du kan gjøre en forskjell

  • Et positivt arbeidsmiljø

  • Lønn etter gjeldende tariffavtale

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Gamvik kommune har nyoppussede klubblokaler i Mehamn i samfunnshusets kjeller. For ungdomsklubben vil også skolene kunne brukes til aktiviteter som matlaging og andre kreative aktiviteter som kan bli utfordrende å gjennomføre i klubblokalene.

Nå håper vi det lykkes oss å få tak i en trygg og inkluderende voksenperson som kan holde klubben åpen. Der er også ønskelig at det blir gjennomført noen klubbkvelder i Gamvik, der det er klubblokale på skolen.

jobs.title: Vi søker ny medarbeider – fast torsdagsvakt + mulighet for flere vakter
jobs.description:
🎳 Vi søker en positiv og serviceinnstilt medarbeider til Futura Bowling! Fast vakt hver torsdag kl. 10–16, med åpning, klargjøring, servering av vafler og daglige driftsoppgaver. Ca. 15 % stilling, med gode muligheter for ekstra vakter og tilkalling.

Hva vi ser etter

Vi ser etter en positiv, pålitelig og serviceinnstilt medarbeider som trives med mennesker og som ønsker å bli en del av vårt team på Futura Bowling.

Du må være 20 år eller eldre, da stillingen også kan innebære arbeid i bar og servering.

Vi ser gjerne at du:

  • Er blid, imøtekommende og liker å møte nye mennesker

  • Er pålitelig og møter opp som avtalt

  • Trives med å jobbe selvstendig og tar ansvar for egne oppgaver

  • Er strukturert og flink til å se hva som må gjøres

  • Har et godt serviceinnstinkt og ønsker å gi gjestene en god opplevelse

  • Er fleksibel og kan ta ekstra vakter ved behov

  • Ikke er redd for å ta i et tak og bidra der det trengs

  • Bidrar positivt til arbeidsmiljøet og samarbeider godt med andre

  • Gjerne har erfaring fra service, butikk, restaurant, bar eller lignende -- men dette er ikke et krav

Det viktigste for oss er ikke nødvendigvis hvor mye erfaring du har fra før, men at du har riktig innstilling, arbeidslyst og lyst til å lære.

Du bør være komfortabel med at arbeidsdagen kan variere. Noen dager kan være rolige og hyggelige, mens andre kan være travle med mange gjester, bookinger og arrangementer. Vi trenger derfor en person som klarer å holde hodet kaldt, er løsningsorientert og bidrar til at ting flyter godt -- også når det blir litt ekstra hektisk.

Fast torsdagsvakt kl. 10.00--16.00 er en forutsetning for stillingen. Utover dette er det en fordel om du har mulighet til å ta ekstra vakter, men dette avtales etter behov og hva som passer for deg.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Som medarbeider hos Futura Bowling vil du ha en variert arbeidsdag hvor hovedfokuset er å sørge for at hallen er klar for gjester og at den daglige driften går smidig.

Stillingen innebærer først og fremst fast åpningsvakt hver torsdag kl. 10.00--16.00. Du vil ha ansvar for å åpne hallen, gjøre nødvendige forberedelser før åpning og sørge for at alt er klart til dagens gjester.

Hver torsdag har vi en fast gruppe pensjonister som besøker oss fra ca. kl. 11.00--14.00. En viktig del av vakten vil derfor være å lage og servere vafler, ta imot gjestene og bidra til at de får en hyggelig opplevelse hos oss.

Arbeidsoppgavene vil blant annet bestå av:

  • Åpne og klargjøre bowlinghallen før gjestene kommer

  • Lage og servere vafler og enkel servering til våre faste torsdagsgjester

  • Ta imot gjester, svare på spørsmål og yte god kundeservice

  • Følge opp bowling, minigolf og andre aktiviteter

  • Håndtere bookinger og drop-in-kunder som kommer i løpet av dagen

  • Gjøre klart til og følge opp eventuelle arrangementer eller bookinger

  • Betjene bar og servering ved behov

  • Tilberede og servere enkel mat og drikke etter gjeldende rutiner

  • Rydding og renhold av hall, kjøkken, bar og gjesteområder

  • Påfylling av varer og holde orden på lager og arbeidsområder

  • Utføre daglige sjekklister og rutineoppgaver

  • Sørge for at hallen til enhver tid fremstår ren, ryddig og innbydende

  • Ta tak i andre praktiske oppgaver som naturlig hører med til den daglige driften

Arbeidsdagen vil variere ut fra hvor mye aktivitet og booking vi har. Det er derfor viktig at du er selvstendig, ser hva som må gjøres og tar initiativ, samtidig som du er komfortabel med å spørre dersom det er noe du er usikker på.

Selv om torsdagen er den faste vakten, vil det også være mulighet for ekstra vakter og tilkallingsarbeid ved behov. Dette kan være både på hverdager, kvelder og helger, blant annet i forbindelse med arrangementer, travle perioder, sykdom og ferieavvikling.

Vi ser etter en person som ønsker å være en positiv del av teamet vårt, og som forstår at god service handler om mer enn bare å betjene kunder -- det handler også om å bidra til at hele hallen fungerer og at gjestene får lyst til å komme tilbake.

Vi tilbyr

Hos Futura Bowling tilbyr vi en variert og sosial arbeidsplass hvor ingen dager nødvendigvis er helt like. Vi har et godt arbeidsmiljø, og legger stor vekt på at våre ansatte skal trives, samarbeide godt og ha det kjekt på jobb.

Vi er en bedrift i stadig utvikling og jobber kontinuerlig med å videreutvikle tilbudet vårt, skape nye aktiviteter og finne nye måter å gi gjestene våre gode opplevelser på. Som ansatt får du derfor mulighet til å være med på utviklingen og komme med egne ideer og innspill.

Vi tilbyr:

  • Fast arbeid hver torsdag kl. 10.00--16.00

  • Ca. 15 % fast stilling

  • Mulighet for ekstra vakter og tilkallingsarbeid dersom du ønsker å jobbe mer

  • Varierte arbeidsoppgaver innen service, servering og drift

  • Et godt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø

  • En sosial arbeidsplass med mye aktivitet og ulike typer gjester

  • Mulighet til å ta ansvar og utvikle seg innen flere deler av driften

  • Opplæring og nødvendig innføring i arbeidsoppgavene

  • Mulighet for flere vakter i forbindelse med arrangementer, travle perioder, ferie og sykdom

  • Mulighet til å komme med ideer og bidra til videreutviklingen av Futura Bowling

  • Lønn etter avtale

For den rette personen kan dette være en fin deltidsjobb med en forutsigbar fast vakt hver uke, samtidig som det er gode muligheter for å jobbe mer dersom du ønsker det.

Vi ønsker oss en medarbeider som vil bli en del av teamet vårt over tid, og som har lyst til å bidra til både et godt arbeidsmiljø og videre utvikling av Futura Bowling.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Futura Bowling er mer enn bare bowling -- vi er en komplett opplevelsesarena i Kristiansund! 🎳

Hos oss finner du 10 bowlingbaner, 9-hulls minigolf, biljard, arcade-maskiner, bar med alle rettigheter og servering av mat og drikke. Vi har gjester i alle aldre og anledninger -- fra familier og vennegjenger til bedrifter, bursdager, arrangementer og faste grupper.

Vi er en sosial og aktiv arbeidsplass hvor det skjer mye, og hvor ingen dager nødvendigvis er helt like. Vi har et godt arbeidsmiljø, og er opptatt av at våre ansatte skal trives, samarbeide godt og være en viktig del av utviklingen videre.

Futura Bowling er i stadig utvikling. Vi jobber kontinuerlig med å fornye tilbudet vårt, skape nye konsepter og gi gjestene enda bedre opplevelser. Hos oss får du muligheten til å være med på reisen videre og komme med egne ideer og innspill.

Vi er stolte av å være en møteplass hvor folk kan spise, drikke, spille og ha det gøy -- og ønsker medarbeidere som vil bidra til nettopp det. 🎳✨
