jobs.title: PhD position in biology, specialisation in aquatic ecology
jobs.description: Department of Aquatic Resources (SLU Aqua)Third-cycle subject areaBiologyDescription of the doctoral projectA PhD position in biology with specialisation in aquatic ecology is available at the Department of Aquatic Resources at the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU Aqua). The theme of the PhD project is on management and conservation methods of critically endangered fishes, focusing on Anguillid eels. Trap and Transport (T&T) is a management method used to enable fish to continue their migration in fragmented riverine systems, and to reduce hydropower turbine mortality for downstream migrating fish. Today, we lack knowledge regarding how T&T should be conducted to optimize the method from an eel’s perspective. The aim of this project is to answer some of these knowledge gaps through field studies, experiments, analysis of existing data, modelling, and via international expert knowledge exchange. The main questions that will be addressed are:     How can the core aspects of the T&T process be optimized from an eel’s perspective?    How is T&T currently conducted in different countries and what can we learn from each other?    In which Swedish watersheds should T&T be prioritized today and in the future?    In addition, the project aims to develop best practice guidelines for T&T to be used at a national and international scale. About the positionThe main task is to conduct the PhD thesis work under supervision, including development of the PhD student's methodological, theoretical, analytical, writing, and presentation skills. The PhD student will conduct experiments in the field, including handling of eels, tagging and more. The work will be done at SLU Aqua in Drottningholm (Stockholm), and at various field sites. The position includes collaboration with international researchers, and one of the co-supervisors is Dr. Derek Evans at the Agri-Food and Bioscience Institute (AFBI), Northern Ireland. The student will also collaborate closely with Dr. Jani Helminen, Natural Resources Institute (LUKE) Finland. RequirementsTo meet the general entry requirements you must have been awarded a second-cycle (Master’s) qualification, satisfied the requirements for courses comprising at least 240 credits of which at least 60 credits were awarded in the second-cycle, or acquired substantially equivalent knowledge in some other way in Sweden or abroad (Higher Education Ordinance 1993:100, Chapter 7, Section 39). Specific entry requirements for the third-cycle courses and study programme in biology. To meet the specific entry requirements, you must have at least 90 HEC in biology-related subjects. This must include a degree project, and at least 30 HEC must be at second-cycle level.You must also meet the equivalent English language requirements as those necessary for the Swedish upper-secondary qualification Engelska B/6. Desirable experience    Experience with animal experiments and/or fieldwork.    Experience working with fish.    Experience with relevant practical and statistical methods.    Experience with independent writing.    Experience with organising workshops or large meetings.    Experience with analysis of large datasets.    Experience in collaboration with commercial fishers, industries and management agencies.    Will contribute to a good working climate.    Good communication skills in English, written and spoken.    Driver’s licence.    Great emphasis on personal qualities, collaboration skills, analytical and problem-solving abilities, and capacity for independent work. About usAt the Department of Aquatic Resources (SLU Aqua) we are passionate about conservation and sustainable management of aquatic animals, including fish. We are geographically distributed across Sweden, and this PhD position will be based in Stockholm at the Institute of Freshwater Research, beautifully situated on the countryside on the island of Lovön right by lake Mälaren. We offer:     An excellent and professionally stimulating working environment with dedicated colleagues    Access to a broad international network of scientists    Salary as PhD research fellow in the state salary scale    Good welfare benefits Read more about SLU Aqua: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/organisation/departments/aquatic-resources/ Read more about staff benefits and life as an SLU employee: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/ Read more about PhD courses and PhD study programmes: https://www.slu.se/en/study/programmes-courses/doctoral-education/ Form of employment and salary Employment as a doctoral student (4-year programme)Doctoral student’s salaries are set following the local collective agreement. Salary progression is fixed. Scope100% LocationDrottningholm, Stockholm Start date2027-04-01, or upon agreement. Application and selection Please submit your application using the link below. The deadline is 30 November 2027. Read more about the attachments that your application should include at https://www.slu.se/en/study/programmes-courses/doctoral-education/how-can-i-become-a-doctoral-student/application/ Selection among eligible applicants is based on the documents attached to the application, and is carried out with regard to the applicant’s ability to complete the programme within the allotted time. Academic union representativeshttps://internt.slu.se/en/my-employment/employee-associations/kontaktpersoner-vid-rekrytering/ The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden. SLU has around 4,000 employees, 6,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 4,5 billion. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses. We strive to provide a work environment characterised by inclusivity and gender equality, where different experiences generate conversations between people and pave the way for science, creativity and development. Therefore, we welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

jobs.title: Project Engineer
jobs.description: The OpportunityJoin a growing engineering team responsible for the plant electrical design of HVDC converter station projects. Based in Ludvika or Västerås, you will work with plant circuit and cable design, ensuring customer requirements are translated into compliant, high-quality engineering deliverables. Working closely with project teams, suppliers, and technical specialists, you will contribute to the successful delivery of complex projects from design through execution.You are a self-motivated engineer who takes ownership of your work and enjoys solving technical challenges in collaboration with others. You thrive in a project environment where priorities can shift and where balancing quality, schedule, and technical requirements is essential.How you’ll make an impact    Develop plant circuit and cable engineering designs for HVDC converter station projects.    Translate customer specifications and contractual requirements into compliant engineering deliverables.    Review and validate technical documentation from suppliers and other stakeholders to ensure technical and contractual compliance.    Apply established design principles, engineering standards, and available base solutions to meet project requirements.    Collaborate with project managers, engineers, suppliers, and technical specialists throughout project execution.    Identify and resolve technical issues, risks, and design deviations that may impact project delivery.    Contribute to continuous improvement of engineering methods, tools, and design documentation.Your Background    Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (electrical, mechanical, industrial, computer science) or a related technical field.    Proven experience in a technical engineering role, preferably within a project-based environment.    Ability to collaborate effectively with a broad range of internal and external stakeholders.    Strong communication skills and professional proficiency in English.    A structured and proactive approach with a focus on quality, accuracy, and delivery.    Experience from the energy sector, power systems, HVDC, or other related industries is highly valued.We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together. ​Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes:  ​    Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension    Group life insurance and additional insurances    Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank ​    Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home    Health care and wellness allowance ​    Discounted health insurances incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance    Psychological support program ​    Supplementary compensation for parental leave ​    Training and education supporting employee development ​    Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally ​    Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks ​The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations. ​Apply todayApplications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis; we therefore encourage you to apply today.Questions can be directed to Hiring Manager Ganesh Krishnamoorthy – ganesh.krishnamoorthy@hitachienergy.com or to Talent Acquisition Partner Johanna Niss – johanna.niss@hitachienergy.comUnions:    Unionen - Fredrik Holmgren +46 107-38 21 85    SACO - Mikael Hjort +46 107-38 29 86    Ledarna - Frank Hollstedt +46 10 7387043

jobs.title: Lärare till skolsocialt team på Tjörn
jobs.description: På Tjörn får medarbetarna ta plats! Inom Tjörns kommunkoncern står arbetsklimat och omsorg om varandra högt i kurs. Beslutsvägarna är korta, arbetsverktygen effektiva och kollegorna hjälpsamma. Du har stor frihet inom ditt yrkesfält och är med och påverkar utvecklingen. Det är enkelt att umgås och skapa kontakter med kollegor, chefer och politiker. Så börja jobba inom Tjörns kommunkoncern du också – här finns gott om plats att ta! Tjörn - möjligheternas ö hela året och för hela livet är Tjörns vision.Barn- och utbildningsförvaltningen arbetar mot målbilden:Framtidens skola på möjligheternas ö, här får alla växa. Tillsammans skapar vi en hållbar framtid i en trygg och meningsfull utbildning med tilltro till individen."Resurscentrum är kommunens samlade organisation för barn- och elevhälsa. Här arbetar flera professioner tillsammans för att stärka barns och elevers lärande, hälsa och utveckling och stödja förskolor och skolor i det hälsofrämjande, förebyggande och inkluderande arbetet.Nu söker vi en lärare till vårt skolsociala team, där du blir kollega med en speciallärare och två skolsocionomer.Här får du möjlighet att använda din lärarkompetens på ett annat sätt än i den traditionella lärarrollen. Teamet arbetar för att barn och unga tidigt ska få rätt stöd och ökade möjligheter till skolnärvaro, fullföljda studier och social inkludering. Tillsammans bygger vi broar mellan elev, hem, skola och andra viktiga aktörer.Vi söker dig som delar vår övertygelse om att närvaro börjar med relation, att förändring är möjlig och att varje elev ska få möjlighet att lyckas i skolan.1 plats(er). ARBETSUPPGIFTERSom lärare i det skolsociala teamet arbetar du nära elever som av olika anledningar har svårt att få sin skolgång att fungera. Med din pedagogiska kompetens bidrar du till struktur, motivation och fungerande lärandesituationer så att eleven stegvis kan stärka sin närvaro, delaktighet och tilltro till den egna förmågan.Uppdraget är främst operativt och sker både i elevernas ordinarie skolmiljö och, vid behov, i andra undervisningssammanhang. Du arbetar nära elevens hemskola och teamets övriga professioner för att skapa hållbara lösningar.I uppdraget ingår bland annat att:    • undervisa och ge pedagogiskt stöd till enskilda elever och grupper utifrån olika behov och förutsättningar    • arbeta relationsskapande och motiverande med elever med låg skolnärvaro eller svårigheter att delta i undervisningen    • möta elever och vårdnadshavare i utmanande situationer och föra förtroendefulla samtal som bidrar till förståelse, motivation och vägar framåt    • genomföra kartläggningar och upprätta handlingsplaner tillsammans med teamet.    • planera, genomföra och följa upp insatser tillsammans med lärare och övrig skolpersonal    • stödja elevens väg mot ökad delaktighet och en hållbar återgång till ordinarie undervisning    • bidra med ett pedagogiskt perspektiv i teamets tvärprofessionella arbete och samverka med skolornas elevhälsoteam    • dokumentera och följa upp insatser samt bidra till utvecklingen av teamets arbetssätt.Arbetet sker på olika skolor och utifrån elevernas och verksamheternas behov. Du behöver därför uppskatta variation och kunna arbeta både självständigt och tillsammans med andra.KVALIFIKATIONERVi söker dig som är legitimerad lärare med ett stort engagemang för elever som har svårt att få sin skolgång att fungera. Du är trygg i din yrkesroll, har god pedagogisk kompetens och kan anpassa undervisning och bemötande efter elevens behov.Du har lätt för att skapa förtroendefulla relationer och kan väcka motivation och lust till lärande även hos elever med låg skolmotivation, hög skolfrånvaro eller svag anknytning till skolan.Vi söker dig som:    • är trygg och tydlig i ditt pedagogiska ledarskap    • arbetar relationsskapande, lösningsfokuserat och uthålligt    • kan anpassa undervisning och arbetssätt efter situation och individ    • kan kartlägga behov samt planera och följa upp pedagogiska insatser    • har god samarbetsförmåga och trivs med tvärprofessionellt arbete    • är flexibel och strukturerad och kan behålla lugn och professionalitet även i utmanande situationer.Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av problematisk skolfrånvaro, elever i behov av särskilt stöd, NPF, motivations- och relationsskapande arbete eller tvärprofessionell samverkan.Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet. För oss är det viktigt att du är nyfiken på vad som ligger bakom en elevs svårigheter och kan skapa trygghet, motivation och framtidstro även när förändring tar tid.B-körkort och tillgång till egen bil är nödvändigt eftersom uppdraget innebär resor mellan verksamheter inom kommunen.Anställningsform: Tidsbegränsad anställning.Varaktighet:, tillträde: 2027-01-18  , upphör: 2028-06-30  .Om du erbjuds anställning inom Barn- och utbildningsförvaltningen är du skyldig enligt Skollagen att visa upp ett utdrag utan anmärkning från Polisens belastningsregister.Medarbetarna i kommunkoncernen ska ha en bra arbetsmiljö och arbete i balans med familj, vänner och fritid. Vi tillämpar en rökfri arbetstid och arbetsgivaren erbjuder bl a förmåner som friskvårdsbidrag. Vid anställning längre än tre månader blir du automatiskt medlem i Tjörns kommunanställdas fritidsförening, TKFF, som både anordnar och sponsrar olika aktiviteter. Du får ett årskort till Nordiska akvarellmuseet. Alla nya månadsanställda erbjuds en heldags kommunövergripande introduktionsdag. Är du tillsvidareanställd har du möjlighet att leasa en miljöbil som personalbil.Till bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag och till dig som är försäljare:Vi undanber oss vänligen men bestämt direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av ytterligare jobbannonser. Vi har upphandlat med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag.Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via vårt rekryteringssystem Visma Recruit/Offentliga jobb i enlighet med GDPR.

jobs.title: Learning & Digital Training Coordinator, ABB Oy Motion Service
jobs.description: [https://images.teamtailor-cdn.com/images/s3/teamtailor-production/original-v3/image_uploads/dbcc5f1a-58b3-437a-9531-571cb56c77a9/original.png]Do you want to play a key role in shaping learning and capability development in a truly global environment? We are looking for a Learning & Digital Training Coordinator to join ABB's international Learning & Digital Training team. In this role, you will support the coordination and delivery of learning programs, digital training solutions, and learning platforms while collaborating with stakeholders across a global organization.About the RoleAs a Learning & Digital Training Coordinator, you will play an important role in supporting and coordinating global learning and training initiatives within the Motion Global Capability Team of Motion Service organization. Working closely with internal teams, global stakeholders, and external partners, you will help track agreed actions, follow up with stakeholders, and keep learning content and documentation up to date.You will support the use of digital learning tools, including eLearning authoring tools such as Articulate, and assist with routine Learning Management System (LMS) activities under team guidance. Your work will help maintain a consistent, user-friendly learning experience and contribute to continuous improvement of the teams processes and tools.This position offers an excellent opportunity to develop your expertise in digital learning platforms, training operations, and global collaboration rather than independent ownership of learning content, platforms, or content strategy.Key ResponsibilitiesKey responsibilities include: * Supporting the coordination of learning and training activities across the Motion Service organization * Assisting with meeting organization KPIs, action tracking, and stakeholder follow-up· Support the use of digital learning tools, including eLearning authoring tools such as Articulate, and assist with routine LMS activities under team guidance * Updating and maintaining learning content and related documentation * Supporting communication with internal teams and external partners involved in training activities * Maintaining structured documentation of ongoing tasks, actions, and projects * Contributing to the continuous improvement of learning processes, tools, and ways of workingThis role offers an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience in digital learning, training coordination, and international collaboration while supporting a global organization's learning and development initiatives.What We Are Looking ForYou may be at the beginning of your career or already have a few years of professional experience. What matters most is your interest in digital learning solutions, willingness to learn, and understanding of how effective learning experiences are built.We hope you bring:· An interest in learning, development, and digital training environments· Confidence in using common digital workplace tools and platforms· Strong communication and coordination skills when working with different stakeholders· A structured and well-organized approach to managing tasks and priorities· The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with others· A proactive, flexible, and solution-oriented mindset, with curiosity and a willingness to learn and take initiative· Fluent English skills, as English is the daily working language and the official language used across the organization in this roleWhat Makes You Successful in This RoleYou thrive in collaborative and international environments and enjoy working with a wide range of stakeholders. You are motivated by improving learning experiences and supporting digital training initiatives that make a real impact across a global organization. With a proactive mindset and eagerness to learn, you apply best practices, work effectively within established processes, and contribute to an inclusive, safe, and supportive team culture.What We OffersABB is a global technology company where you will become part of an international yet close-knit team. This role offers an excellent opportunity to develop your expertise in learning and training while building a long-term career within a global organization.The position is a fixed-term assignment of one year, with a preferred start date as soon as possible. This position will be offered as a temporary agency assignment through Adecco Finland. The collective agreement is for senior salaried employees in the technology industryThe role offers full remote flexibility. However, we hope that the selected candidate will be able to visit the office at Pitäjänmäki occasionally to collaborate with the team and maintain personal connections with colleagues.While the position does not involve regular travel, you will work closely with international colleagues and stakeholders in a global environment. The role provides an excellent opportunity to expand your expertise within an international organization and contribute to the development of learning and digital training solutions across a broad global network.ContactApply through our website www.adecco.fi [http://www.adecco.fi] by submitting your CV and a short cover letter including your salary expectation.Interviews will begin during the application period, and the position will be filled as soon as we find the right candidate. The application deadline is Sunday, November 15th.For more information about the role or recruitment process, please contact:Sanna Lehtinen, Recruitment Consultant, Adecco +358 40352 4131 sanna.lehtinen@adecco.fi [sanna.lehtinen@adecco.fi]Please note that we can't accept applications via email for data protection reasons.Thank you for your application!

jobs.description: Osa-aikainen nuorten ryhmänohjaaja – Kotka**Sosiaalipalvelut Elämän Avaimet Oy** hakee osa-aikaista ryhmänohjaajaa nuorten toiminnalliseen ryhmätoimintaan Kotkaan.Olemme pieni sosiaalialan yritys, jonka toiminnassa korostuvat nuorten aito kohtaaminen, luottamuksellisuus, yhdessä tekeminen ja yksilöllinen tuki.TyötehtäväTehtävässä vastaat pääsääntöisesti itsenäisesti noin kuuden 12–15-vuotiaan nuoren ryhmän käytännön ohjaamisesta.Ryhmätoiminta on valmiiksi suunniteltua, mutta pääset vaikuttamaan käytännön toteutukseen ja tuomaan mukaan omia vahvuuksiasi.Toiminta on rentoa, osallistavaa ja käytännönläheistä. Siihen voi sisältyä esimerkiksi biljardia, erilaisia pelejä, liikuntaa, retkiä ja muuta yhdessä tekemistä. Tavoitteena on tukea nuorten sosiaalisia taitoja, osallisuutta ja mielekästä vapaa-aikaa.Työhön sisältyy nuorten kuljetuksia yrityksen autolla, toiminnan valmistelua sekä sovittuja kirjauksia ja raportointia.Työskentelet itsenäisesti, mutta yrityksen vastuuhenkilöt ovat tarvittaessa nopeasti tavoitettavissa ja tukevat toimintaasi.Työaika ja työsuhde- Osa-aikainen työ, alustavasti noin 5–8 tuntia viikossa. - Työskentely pääasiassa keskiviikkoisin klo 14.30–21.00 välisenä aikana. - Toimintaan voi sisältyä erikseen sovittavia retkiä ja tapahtumia myös iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin. - Työajan lisääntyminen on mahdollista uusien ryhmien käynnistyessä. - Työsuhde on alustavasti noin kuuden kuukauden määräaikainen. - Aloitus sopimuksen mukaan. Odotamme sinulta- Soveltuvaa sosiaali-, terveys- tai kasvatusalan koulutusta, ensisijaisesti sosionomi (AMK) tai vastaavaa osaamista. - Kokemusta nuorten kanssa työskentelystä. - Itsenäistä ja vastuullista työotetta. - Hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja ja kykyä kohdata erilaisia nuoria. - B-ajokorttia ja valmiutta kuljettaa nuoria yrityksen autolla. Arvostamme erityisesti kokemusta nuorten ryhmätoiminnasta, neuropsykiatristen erityispiirteiden huomioimisesta sekä toiminnallisista ohjausmenetelmistä.Tarjoamme- Monipuolisen ja itsenäisen työn nuorten parissa. - Valmiiksi suunnitellun ryhmätoiminnan ja perehdytyksen tehtävään. - Pienen yrityksen joustavan ja helposti tavoitettavan työyhteisön. - Tarvittavat työvälineet sekä yrityksen auton työtehtäviin. - Mahdollisuuden työmäärän lisääntymiseen uusien ryhmien käynnistyessä. **Palkkaus:** Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimuksen mukainen. Palkassa huomioidaan tehtävän vaativuus, koulutus ja aikaisempi kokemus. Palkasta voidaan neuvotella.Tehtävään valittavan henkilön soveltuvuus ja kelpoisuus tarkistetaan. Lasten kanssa työskentelyyn liittyvä rikosrekisteriote tarkistetaan soveltuvan lainsäädännön mukaisesti.HakuohjeetLähetä lyhyt hakemus ja CV sekä kerro kokemuksestasi nuorten kanssa työskentelystä ja mahdollisuudestasi työskennellä keskiviikkoisin.**Hakemukset ja lisätiedot:**Ilkka.huovila@elamanavaimetoy.fiTii.huovila@elamanavaimetoy.fi**Verkkosivut:** https://elamanavaimetoy.fi**Hakuaika:** 15.11.2026 asti.Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana ja voimme kutsua sopivia hakijoita haastatteluun ennen hakuajan päättymistä.

jobs.title: Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing
jobs.description:
Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing Department of Food Science Faculty of Science University of Copenhagen The Department of Food Science (FOOD), Faculty of Science (SCIENCE), University of Copenhagen (UCPH) invites applications for a position as Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor in Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing. The research areas of FOOD have a shared mission to contribute to new pathways for society and industry to support the development of solutions based in biology to improve sustainable food production, food security and food safety. FOOD is recognized for excellence in food research, education and industrial collaboration. The Department is an international workplace with Danish and English as parallel working languages, however it is expected that the successful candidate will be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 3 to 6 years. FOOD has the ambition to reinforce our teaching and research in designing and optimizing biology-based solutions as future sustainable food and ingredient technologies. UCPH is strengthening this area by offering the new MSc Biosolutions program in Kalundborg, Denmark, the largest bio-based manufacturing hub in Scandinavia, home to large fermentation-based manufacturers, and a vibrant innovation environment. The candidate for this position is expected to significantly contribute to this new Biosolutions initiative. The aim of the position is to explore the production and use of new solutions based on both biology and engineering addressing sustainability challenges inherent in food systems today. Although we welcome a diverse range of applicants, the focus of the position will be processing in relation to biochemically based solutions and could include the following disciplines:
  • Food process technology, ideally with an emphasis on fermentation & downstream processing
  • Food process system engineering
  • Use of sensor technologies such as in-line or at line spectroscopic tools
  • Large-data, modelling and prediction of food and ingredient processes.
  • Understanding of biological production systems and their use, and with an emphasis on downstream processing
A central part of the activities anchored to this position will be taking place in Campus Kalundborg, and it is crucial that the candidate is able to leverage the local ecosystem to foster strong collaboration with industry. Qualifications are expected in the following areas:
  • A collaborative and innovative mindset
  • Documented scientific impact and outreach in past research work
  • A proven track record in attracting external funding at both national and international level
  • Experience with international collaborations
  • Ability to establish industrial collaboration
  • Excellent interpersonal and communicative skills
Tenure-track assistant professor The tenure-track assistant professor’s duties will primarily include research, including obligations regarding publication/scientific communication and research-based teaching with associated examination obligations within Ingredient Biochemical Processing. To a limited extent the position may also include other duties. The tenure-track assistant professor must have an academic standing showing internationally competitive research, and/or have internationally recognized high potential to make a future impact. Assessment of applicants for the tenure-track assistant professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, internationally competitive research. The ability to attract external funding will be considered together with outreach qualifications. Teaching qualifications are not mandatory but documented teaching qualifications and teaching experience will be considered. Associate professor Applicants are required to have university level teaching experience, documented teaching competencies and must be able to explain and reflect upon own teaching practice and portfolio. Formal pedagogical training or supervision equivalent to the University of Copenhagen teacher training programme for assistant professors is required. The candidate must be an inspiring teacher with a vision on teaching development, especially in connection with the new MSc Biosolutions program. A new campus with research and teaching facilities is currently being built in Kalundborg and the candidate is expected to contribute to setting up the facilities Duties include the applicant’s own research, development of the field, assessment tasks, grant applications, and research management such as supervision and training of research fellows and other staff. The successful applicant must also teach, supervise, prepare and participate in examinations, and fulfill other tasks requested by the Department. Assessment of applicants for the associate professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, original scientific production at an international level, including contributions to developments in their field, as well as their documented teaching qualifications. Managerial and out-reach qualifications of applicants including ability to attract external funding will also be considered. University of Copenhagen’s criteria for recognising merit General criteria apply to the appointment of assistant professor / associate professor at the University of Copenhagen. The criteria (research, teaching, Innovation & societal impact, organizational contribution and leadership) are considered as a framework for an overall assessment of the applicant. In addition, each applicant will be assessed according to the specific requirements listed in this advertisement. Please read more here For tenure-track assistant professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5a_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Assistant_professors.pdf For associate professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5b_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Associate_professors.pdf Applicants are encouraged to read the University of Copenhagen's Guidance on the merit criterion Innovation and Societal Impact here The tenure-track assistant programme The tenure-track programme is a career programme and an assigned mentor will provide the tenure-track assistant professors with guidance related to career development, other academic topics and administrative procedures. Performance of the tenure-track assistant professor will be followed via internal yearly evaluations and a mid-term and final international evaluation by an assessment committee. If the ‘final appraisal’ is positive you will be promoted as associate professor. Performance and progression towards the criteria below will be evaluated with due consideration of differences between research fields. After a 6-year tenure-track period tenure-track assistant professors are expected to meet the criteria for appointment of associate professors at the University of Copenhagen. Salary and employment conditions The position is open from 1 May 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff. Employment is as either tenure track assistant professor or associate professor under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish). The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background. The Professor will be a part of the Section for Ingredients and Dairy Technology. The section has internationally acknowledged expertise within novel sustainable processing technologies, protein, polyphenol and lipid chemistry, functionality, and modification of food components, kinetics, oxidation, food engineering, rheology, digitalisation, and advanced data analysis. The section is also equipped with pilot facilities for brewing, dairy and bioprocessing. Further information on the Department is linked at Department of Food Science – University of Copenhagen Inquiries about the position can be made to Inquiries about the position can be made to Head of Department, Colin Ray (+45 93565911, colin.ray@food.ku.dk) or Head of Section, Mogens Larsen Andersen (+45 3533 3262, mola@food.ku.dk). Filing of application The position may be applied for at the tenure-track assistant professor level or associate professor level. Please note that it is possible to apply at more than one level. If applied at more than one level, separate applications must be submitted (see below). The application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below. Applying for the tenure-track assistant professorship please include

jobs.title: Tenure Track assistant professor, associate professor or professor of Food Processing & Technology
jobs.description:
Tenure-track Assistant Professor, Associate Professor or Full Professor of Food Processing & Technology Department of Food Science Faculty of Science University of Copenhagen The Department of Food Science, Faculty of Science, University of Copenhagen invites applications for a position as Tenure-track Assistant Professor, Associate Professor or Full Professor in Food Processing and Technology. Applicants must be capable of, and interested in, conducting and developing basic and applied interdisciplinary research of high international standard in the field of food processing and technology. The position will involve extensive collaborations within the department and with national and international academic groups and industrial partners. Research within the Department has a mission to unearth new solutions for society and industry to support sustainable food production, food security and safety as well as production of high-quality food promoting human health and wellbeing. The Department of Food Science is recognized for excellence in food research, education, and industrial collaborations. The Department is an international workplace with Danish and English as parallel working languages, however it is expected that the successful candidate will be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 3 to 6 years. We encourage applications from a range of disciplines within the food science and technology area, ideally covering the understanding of food macromolecular interactions on a mechanistic level, how processing and formulation affect or determine these interactions, and how this influences final product quality with focus on functional properties. We are seeking a candidate who will establish an internationally leading research program, and we encourage a diverse range of applicants whose work may center on one or more of the following disciplines:
  • Developing a mechanistic understanding of interactions of food macromolecules in complex matrices during processing or formulation spanning dairy, plant, and single-cell protein sources.
  • How this knowledge can be used in the rational design of functional ingredients and healthy foods using established and emerging processing technologies
  • Development and utilization of high throughput methods for characterizing and quantifying the physicochemical behavior of food macromolecules in complex matrices.
  • Modelling and the use of machine learning/AI for simulation and prediction of the outcome of process unit operations on food and ingredient functionality.
  • Formulation and fluid dynamics of complex emulsions and the mechanisms governing this.
In addition, it is expected that this position will be involved in a significant amount of collaboration with industry, and therefore it is expected that the successful candidate has a documented successful track record in industry collaboration and working with innovation-oriented research. Furthermore, we expect that the successful candidate has a genuine interest in leadership and the wellbeing and development of their group. Tenure-track assistant professor The tenure-track assistant professor’s duties will primarily include research, including obligations with regards to publication/scientific communication and research-based teaching with associated examination obligations within the Tenure Track Assistant Professorship. To a limited extent the position may also include other duties. The tenure-track assistant professor must have an academic standing showing internationally competitive research, and/or have internationally recognized high potential to make a future impact. Assessment of applicants for the tenure-track assistant professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, internationally competitive research. The ability to attract external funding will be considered together with outreach qualifications. Teaching qualifications are not mandatory but documented teaching qualifications and teaching experience will be considered. Associate professor and full professor Applicants are required to have university level teaching experience, documented teaching competencies and must be able to explain and reflect upon own teaching practice and portfolio. Formal pedagogical training or supervision equivalent to the University of Copenhagen teacher training programme for assistant professors is required. In particular, the candidate must actively contribute with research-based teaching on the BSc in Food Science and Nutrition, and the MSc in Food Science and Technology programs, with an emphasis on the specialization in Dairy Science and Technology. Duties include the applicant’s own research, development of the field, assessment tasks, grant applications, and research management such as supervision and training of research fellows and other staff. The successful applicant must also teach, supervise, prepare and participate in examinations, and fulfill other tasks requested by the Department. Assessment of applicants for the associate professorship and full professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, original scientific production at an international level, including contributions to developments in their field, as well as their documented teaching qualifications. Managerial and out-reach qualifications of applicants including ability to attract external funding will also be considered. University of Copenhagen’s criteria for recognising merit General criteria apply to the appointment of assistant professor / associate professor / professor at the University of Copenhagen. The criteria (research, teaching, Innovation & societal impact, organizational contribution and leadership) are considered as a framework for an overall assessment of the applicant. In addition, each applicant will be assessed according to the specific requirements listed in this advertisement. Please read more here: For tenure-track assistant professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5a_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Assistant_professors.pdf For associate professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5b_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Associate_professors.pdf For professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5c_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-professors.pdf Applicants are encouraged to read the University of Copenhagen's Guidance on the merit criterion Innovation and Societal Impact here The tenure-track assistant programme The tenure-track programme is a career programme and an assigned mentor will provide the tenure-track assistant professors with guidance related to career development, other academic topics and administrative procedures. Performance of the tenure-track assistant professor will be followed via internal yearly evaluations and a mid-term and final international evaluation by an assessment committee. If the ‘final appraisal’ is positive you will be promoted as associate professor. Performance and progression towards the criteria below will be evaluated with due consideration of differences between research fields. After a 6-year tenure-track period tenure-track assistant professors are expected to meet the criteria for appointment of associate professors at the University of Copenhagen. Salary and employment conditions The position is open from 1 April 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff. Employment is either as tenure track assistant professor, associate professor or professor under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish). This position comes with an opportunity to negotiate a start package that will help leverage the candidate’s scientific deliverables in the initial years of employment. The negotiation for the start package takes place as part of the recruitment process. Please read about the contents of the programme and conditions, as well as UCPH’s extensive support for international researchers, here Start package programme – University of Copenhagen . The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background. The successful candidate will be a part of the Section for Ingredients and Dairy Technology. The section has internationally acknowledged expertise within novel sustainable processing technologies, protein, polyphenol and lipid chemistry, functionality, and modification of food components, kinetics, oxidation, food engineering, rheology, digitalisation, and advanced data analysis. The section is also equipped with pilot facilities for brewing, dairy and bioprocessing. The section has extensive collaborations on research projects with major food industries in both Denmark and abroad. Further information on the Department is linked at Department of Food Science – University of Copenhagen Inquiries about the position can be made to Inquiries about the position can be made to Head of Department, Colin Ray (+45 93565911, colin.ray@food.ku.dk) or Head of Section, Mogens Larsen Andersen (+45 3533 3262, mola@food.ku.dk). jobs.title: Lähihoitaja kotihoitoon
jobs.description: ETSIMME OULUN ALUEELLE LÄHIHOITAJAA KOTIHOITOONKotihoito tarjoaa mahdollisuuden tehdä yksilöllistä ja merkityksellistä työtä, jossa asiakkaan hyvinvointi ja elämänlaatu ovat keskiössä. Etsimme nyt Oulun alueelle lähihoitajaa tai loppuvaiheen opiskelijaa kotihoitoon kokoaikaiseen tai osa-aikaiseen työhön (80-100% työaika). Pääset aloittamaan työn heti tai sopimuksen mukaan.MITÄ KOTIHOIDON TYÖ SISÄLTÄÄ?Kotihoidossa työsi on monipuolista, itsenäistä ja ihmisläheistä. Työskentelet asiakkaiden omissa kodeissa ja tuet heitä toimimaan arjessa turvallisesti ja mahdollisimman omatoimisesti. Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat mm.: * Perushoito ja asiakkaan päivittäinen avustaminen * Lääkehoito (osaamisen ja lupien mukaisesti) * Terveyden kokonaisvaltainen seuranta ja mittaukset * Asiakkaan toimintakyvyn, hyvinvoinnin ja turvallisuuden tukeminenKotihoidossa jokainen työpäivä on erilainen. Pääset hyödyntämään ammattitaitoasi laaja-alaisesti ja tekemään työtä, jolla on todellista merkitystä asiakkaiden arjessa.MITÄ TARJOAMME SINULLE? * Merkityksellisen, arvostetun ja itsenäisen työn * Mahdollisuuden työskennellä omalla tavallasi, asiakasta kunnioittaen * Ammattitaitoisen ja kannustavan työyhteisön tueksesi * Yksityisen sosiaalialan työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkanMITÄ TOIVOMME SINULTA? * Lähihoitajan tutkintoa ja voimassa olevia lupia * Asiakaslähtöistä, vastuullista ja lämminhenkistä työotetta * Kykyä itsenäiseen työskentelyyn ja päätöksentekoon * Erinomaista suomen kielen taitoa * Ajokorttia, sillä liikut asiakaskohteiden välilläKiinnostuitko? Jätä hakemuksesi! Haastattelemme jo hakuajan aikana.Nähdään Alinassa!----------------------------------------Haluatko tietää lisää meistä? Löydät lisätietoa verkkosivuiltamme [https://alinahoivatiimi.fi/].Alina on valtakunnallinen ketju, joka työllistää jo 350 alan ammattilaista. Paikallisia Alina-yrityksiä on jo yli 30 eri puolilla Suomea. Yhdeksän kymmenestä asiakkaastamme suosittelisi Alinaa tuttavilleen, ja työtyytyväisyytemme sai arvosanaksi 4,39/5 vuonna 2025.Alina on osa Norlandiaa [https://norlandiacare.fi/], joka tarjoaa innovatiivisia ja monipuolisia hyvinvointi- ja terveyspalveluita kaikille vauvasta vaariin sekä nelijalkaisille ystävillemme. Suomessa Norlandian toimintoihin kuuluvat hoivakodit YHDESSÄ palvelukortteleissa, Tampereella sijaitseva potilashotelli, Norlandia Päiväkodit ja Aberia.

jobs.title: Accountant
jobs.description: We are looking for an Accountant to join our Finance team at Senior Material Europe in Sweden. In this role, you will work with daily accounting operations, financial reporting, budgeting and audit support, contributing to the accuracy and efficiency of our financial processes.This is a fixed-term position for 6 months (working on-site 4 days per week, approximately 30 hours per week) offering hands-on experience across a broad range of finance activities in an international industrial organisation.About Senior Material EuropeAt Senior Material Europe, we manufacture separator film – a thin film used in lithium-ion batteries, including batteries for electric vehicles. The separator is a key component that helps make lithium-ion batteries safer, more durable and more efficient, supporting the transition towards a more electrified future.Our production is modern, advanced and operated under controlled cleanroom conditions. Together, we are building advanced manufacturing capabilities in Europe and developing solutions that make a difference – both today and for the future.The RoleAs an Accountant, you will support the daily operations of our Finance department and contribute to reliable accounting, timely financial closings and effective financial reporting.You will work closely with the Finance Manager and the wider Finance team, gaining exposure to different areas of accounting and financial management. The role combines routine accounting tasks with analytical work, budgeting and audit-related activities.We are looking for someone who is detail-oriented, organised and comfortable taking responsibility for their work. You should enjoy working with numbers, identifying discrepancies and ensuring that financial information is accurate and delivered on time.Job Responsibilities    Handle daily invoice processing and accounting transactions.    Contribute to monthly and annual financial closings, ensuring deadlines are met.    Perform bank reconciliations, manual journal entries and accruals.    Assist in preparing the 2027 budget and analysing the 2026 budget.    Prepare and provide financial documentation and supporting materials for audits.    Review financial information, identify discrepancies and support accurate financial reporting.    Maintain organised accounting records and ensure that financial documentation is complete and up to date.    Support the Finance Manager and colleagues with other finance-related tasks as required.Your BackgroundWe are looking for someone with:    A bachelor's degree or equivalent in Accounting, Finance, Economics or a related field.    Good knowledge of accounting principles and financial processes.    Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.    Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.    A structured and analytical approach, with strong attention to detail.    The ability to work independently, take responsibility and manage tasks according to deadlines.    Good communication and collaboration skills, with the flexibility to adapt to changing priorities.It Would Be an Advantage If You Have    Previous work experience in accounting, budgeting or financial reporting.    Experience supporting internal or external audits.    Familiarity with SAP Finance modules, particularly SAP FI/CO.    Professional proficiency in Chinese, both written and spoken.What You Can ExpectYou will join a collaborative Finance team of five people, working in an international manufacturing environment where accuracy, accountability and teamwork are essential.This role offers the opportunity to gain hands-on experience across core finance activities, develop your understanding of statutory reporting and budgeting, and collaborate with colleagues across different functions.We value responsibility, continuous learning, open communication and a practical approach to problem-solving. You will have the opportunity to broaden your financial knowledge while contributing to the day-to-day operations of our business.We look forward to welcoming a new colleague who is eager to contribute, learn and grow with us. If you are ready to take the next step in your finance career and become part of our team, we would love to hear from you!Employment type: Fixed-term employment for six months Working hours: Approximate four days per week, corresponding to a minimum of 30 hours per week Location: Senior Material Europe, Sweden Start date: As soon as possible

  • Håndtering af uforudsete hændelser i løbet af arbejdsdagen

Du får en spændende rolle, hvor du deltager aktivt i den daglige drift og gradvist får mere ansvar. Du refererer til regionschefen for Sjælland og Fyn.

Hvem er du?Vi søger dig, som har:

  • En naturlig interesse for processer
  • En struktureret og selvstændig tilgang til opgaver
  • Gode IT-kompetencer, især i Office-pakken
  • Øje for detaljer og lyst til at levere grundige resultater
  • Evne til at håndtere en varieret hverdag, hvor du kan blive afbrudt midt i en opgave
  • Gode samarbejdsevner og lyst til at hjælpe både kunder og kolleger

Uddannelseskrav:Du har bestået – eller forventer at bestå – en af følgende:

  • EUX Business (kontor)
  • HHX
  • HF, HTX eller STX samt 5 ugers EUS-forløb 

Er du over 25 år?Så skal du kontakte din lokale handelsskole for at få lavet en realkompetencevurdering (RKV), som skal vedhæftes din ansøgning.

OBS: Husk, at du ikke må oplyse dit CPR-nummer i din ansøgning eller dit CV.

Ansættelsesdato:Ønsket opstart mellem d. 1. januar og 1. marts 2027 – men vi venter gerne på den rette kandidat. Samtaler afholdes løbende.

Hvem er vi?HB-Care er Danmarks førende leverandør af visiteret specialkørsel til kommuner og institutioner. Vi sørger hver dag for, at ældre borgere kommer til genoptræning, at skolebørn bliver kørt til undervisning, og at personer med særlige behov kommer sikkert frem til deres destinationer. Vores arbejde kræver både præcision, struktur og stor omtanke – og det er netop her, du kan blive en vigtig del af vores team.

jobs.title: Senior Key Corporate Sales Manager
Lärare eller studiecoach i särskild undervisningsgrupp
jobs.description: Välkommen till Smedjebackens kommun! Vi är en kommun som med god och stabil ekonomi som grund och med invånarna i fokus arbetar aktivt med utveckling där målet är bästa möjliga verksamhet. Som arbetsgivare är vår styrka prestigelöshet, dialog och korta beslutsvägar. Vi är övertygade om att vi tillsammans kan leva upp till vår värdegrund där välkomnande, engagemang, trygghet och framtidstro är våra ledord.Bergaskolan Bergaskolan är en 7-9 skola som ligger centralt i Smedjebacken. Skolan har ca 270 elever och 40 personal. Lokalerna är genomgående ändamålsenliga, rymliga och fräscha. Skolans placering erbjuder, trots sitt centrala läge, fina grönytor och närhet till skog och mark. Skolans storlek möjliggör att alla vuxna och elever känner igen varandra, även om inte alla möts i undervisningen. Vår skola präglas av goda relationer och ett gott samarbete, både mellan personal, elever och vårdnadshavare. Lärarna arbetar tillsammans i ämneslag, som de också delar arbetsrum med, och varje vecka träffas arbetslag där lärarna som undervisar samma elever hjälps åt med olika strategier. De flesta lärarna är mentorer, men vi har också studiecoacher som stöttar upp extra kring de elever som behöver det.Studion är en särskild undervisningsgrupp där lärmiljön svarar upp mot olika behov av särskilt stöd. Personalteamet som arbetar i Studion samverkar nära och med stöd av en kunnig specialpedagog. ArbetsuppgifterJust nu söker vi en lärare eller studiecoach till vår särskilda undervisningsgrupp. Du arbetar tillsammans med andra lärare och tillsammans stöttar ni eleverna i sin kunskapsutveckling, sociala utveckling och trivsel.  I arbetsuppgifterna ingår     Undervisning i särskild undervisningsgrupp.    Mentorskap i en klass i årskurs 7-9 kan ingå i framtiden, men inte inledningsvis.    Även andra arbetsuppgifter kan förekomma och arbetets innehåll och förutsättningar kan komma att förändras över tiden.Tillträde den 7 januari eller enligt överenskommelse.Kvalifikationer    Vi söker dig som är legitimerad lärare för undervisning inom grundskolan. eller     dig som har goda ämneskunskaper samt erfarenhet av undervisning eller arbete med ungdomar.    Erfarenhet av att stödja barn eller unga med olika funktionsvariationer.Personliga egenskaper    Ett engagemang för lärande och att vara en viktig vuxen i våra ungdomars liv.     Du är en positiv och tydlig ledare, som visar eleverna vägen och skapar delaktighet.     Din undervisning är tydlig och du kommunicerar höga förväntningar på eleverna, samtidigt som du stödjer elevernas möjlighet att leva upp till dessa.     Du har en god värdegrund och en positiv människosyn, som märks både i ord, handling och bemötande.     Du skapar goda relationer till alla elever, genom att vara öppen, prestigelös och en god förebild.    I relation till kollegor är du intresserad av att dela med dig av erfarenheter, lära av andra och att samarbeta.     Du är lösningsfokuserad, och vill arbeta på en arbetsplats där tillit är grunden för vårt förhållningssätt och bemötande.    Du är flexibel och kan tänka dig att forma ditt uppdrag utifrån de behov som uppstår. Vi erbjuderNär du anställs hos oss får du en introduktionsperiod som anpassas efter dina förkunskaper. Vi erbjuder en arbetsplats i en välkomnande kommun med engagemang, trygghet och framtidstro. Vi tror på dialogen som verktyg för utveckling och värnar om korta beslutsvägar och prestigelöst förhållningssätt. Arbetsmiljöarbetet står i fokus där målsättningen är att arbetslivet ska vara hållbart, hälsosamt och tryggt för alla medarbetare. På https://www.smedjebacken.se/arbete-och-naringsliv/formaner.html kan du läsa mer om de förmåner vi erbjuder.   Vi undanber oss vänligt men bestämt all kontakt med annonsörer och bemanningsföretag i rekryteringsprocessen då urval av rekryteringskanaler redan bestämts för denna rekrytering.ÖVRIG INFORMATION I samband med erbjudande om anställning kommer kandidaten som erbjuds tjänsten att behöva styrka sitt medborgarskap. Det kan personen göra med pass alternativt personbevis tillsammans med ID-handling. Om du inte är medborgare i Sverige, EU, EES eller Schweiz måste du uppvisa att du har ett giltigt arbetstillstånd eller är undantag från skyldigheten att ha arbetstillstånd. Anställning kan ske först efter kontroll av arbetstillstånd, vilket krävs enligt utlänningsförordningen. Läs mer på smedjebacken.se om hur vi hanterar dina personuppgifter enligt GDPR. All rekrytering sker digitalt och via vår externa länk till rekryteringssystemet Webcruiter. Vid problem av registrering av CV var god kontakta https://talentech-support.freshdesk.com/sv-SE/support/login/new. Har du skyddade personuppgifter kontaktar du personalavdelningen genom kommunens växel så får du hjälp med din ansökan. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!KontaktinformationSara Sundh, Rektor, 0240660204, sara.sundh@smedjebacken.se Annette Öberg, Sveriges lärare fackligt ombud, annette.oberg@edu.smedjebacken.se Anders Varga, Sveriges lärare fackligt ombud, anders.varga@edu.smedjebacken.se ArbetsplatsSkolgatan 23 A 777 31 Smedjebacken Viktig information:Arbetsgivare: Smedjebackens kommun Ref.nr: 5202489771 Tjänstens omfattning: 100% Tillsvidareanställning Sista ansökningsdag: 2026-11-12

jobs.title: Vastuumyyjä, Sale Lauste, Turku, Turun Osuuskauppa
jobs.description: Primary location:TURKUSale Lauste etsii tiimiinsä vastuumyyjää!Tehtävä on osa-aikainen 30h/vko ja määräaikainen 31.12.2027 asti. Työt olisi tarkoitus aloittaa sopimuksen mukaan mahdollisimman pian.Vastuumyyjänä varmistat kaupan arjen sujuvuuden ja asiakastyytyväisyyden yhdessä myymäläpäällikön ja apulaispäällikön kanssa. Työpäivät koostuvat ihan perus tehtävistä, kuten asiakaspalvelusta, kassa- ja hyllytystyöstä, robotilauksien keräilystä sekä myymälän yleisestä järjestelystä ja siivouksesta. Lisäksi huolehdit tuoteryhmien saatavuudesta, tuotteiden tuoreudesta ja osaston siisteydestä. Hyödynnät tehtävässäsi raportteja ja järjestelmiä muun muassa tilauksiin sekä saldojen ja hävikin hallintaan.Toimit arjen esimerkkinä muulle tiimille kaikissa kaupan työtehtävissä, ja varmistat työvuorolle asetettujen tavoitteiden toteutumisen sekä priorisoit ja organisoit työtehtäviä. Huolehdit osaltasi sujuvasta tiedonkulusta. Lisäksi perehdytät uusia työntekijöitä, jaat osaamistasi sekä autat tiimiä onnistumaan päivittäisessä työssä.Työaika sijoittuu arkisin ja viikonloppuisin klo 6.30–21.10 välille.Varmistathan, että sinulla on mahdollisuus kulkea toimipaikkaan kaikkina kaupan aukioloaikoina.Millaista tyyppiä etsimme?Vastuumyyjänä onnistut tehtävässä, jos olet asiakaslähtöinen, helposti lähestyttävä ja toimeen tarttuva. Haluat olla luomassa onnistuneita asiakaskokemuksia ja toimit jokaisessa asiakaskohtaamisessa esimerkkinä muulle tiimille. Sinulla on positiivinen työskentelyote sekä hyvät viestintä- ja vuorovaikutustaidot. Pystyt ohjaamaan tiimin toimintaa, johtamaan työvuoroa sekä antamaan palautetta. Lisäksi sinulle sopii fyysinen vuorotyö, jossa työskentelet vaihtelevissa vuoroissa ja työtehtävissä, sekä kohtaat satoja ihmisiä päivässä. Vastuumyyjältä edellytämme aikaisempaa työkokemusta myyjän tehtävistä, ja eduksi katsomme kokemuksen vastuutehtävistä.Vastuumyyjän palkka perustuu Kaupan alan työehtosopimukseen palkkaluokkaan B sekä tehtäväkohtaiseen vaativamman työn lisään. Tuntipalkka on koulutuksesta ja kokemusvuosista riippuen 11,33-15,15 €/h. Vuorotyössä ilta- ja viikonloppulisät tuovat mukavaa lisää peruspalkan päälle. Lisäksi sinulla on mahdollisuus kannustepalkkioon, joka voi olla jopa 1,20 € per tehty työtunti.Liity meidän porukkaan, niin tarjoamme sinulle:Ihan tavallisia töitä, epätavallisen hyvillä henkilöstöeduilla! Työskennellessäsi meillä, saat rahanarvoisia ostoetuja S-etukortillasi, kuten S-ryhmän ravintoloista –25 %,Sokos ja Emotion myymälöistä -15 % tai autopesusta –50 %Työpäiviä poikkeuksellisen rennossa porukassa yhdessä Suomen innostavimmassa työpaikassaKattavan perehdytyksen työtehtävääsi ja mahdollisuuden ammatilliseen kasvuun, jota tukevat S-ryhmän monipuoliset oppimis- ja valmennusmahdollisuudetJos ihan tavalliset työt houkuttaa, laita hakemusta tulemaan 8.11. mennessä! Me ollaan sinuun yhteydessä sähköpostitse tai puhelimitse 010 764 –alkuisesta numerosta. Kannattaa seurata myös roskapostia, sillä meidän viestit voivat eksyä myös sinne.Haluaisitko kuulla lisää tehtävästä ja Turun Osuuskaupasta? &#x1f4de; Lisätietoja antaamyymäläpäällikkö JuliusAlikirri. Juliuksen tavoitat parhaiten arkisin klo 9–15 numerosta 010 764 3281.Me Turun Osuuskaupassa työskentelemme ihan tavallisissa töissä. Tavallisuus ei tarkoita, että meillä olisi täällä tylsää tai osaamatonta porukkaa töissä – päinvastoin! Meillä on harvinaisen hyvä työilmapiiri, epätavallisen hyvät henkilöstöedut ja poikkeuksellisen paljon erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia. 82 % työntekijöistämme suositteleekin meitä työpaikkana. Meitä tokkilaisia on reilu 2600 ja työskentelemme neljällä eri toimialalla. Työskentelemme pilke silmäkulmassa ja tavoitteenamme on olla asiakkaiden ykkösvalinta! Lue lisää Turun Osuuskaupasta: Tietoa meistä – TOK.

jobs.title: Elektronik fremstilling og test
jobs.description:
Vil du være med til at fremstille avanceret måleudstyr, der anvendes til måling af vakuumtryk i højteknologiske produktionsprocesser?

Vi søger en engageret og detalje orienteret produktionsmedarbejder med erfaring inden for elektronikmontage, og som trives i et mindre team, hvor kvalitet og samarbejde er i fokus.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil bl.a. være:

  • Montage af elektroniske og mekaniske komponenter

  • Loddearbejde (både SMT og through-hole)

  • Test og kalibrering af transducere

  • Kvalitetskontrol og dokumentation

Hos Sens4 bliver du en del af et mindre team, der samler, tester og konfigurerer tryk- og vakuumtransducere. Derudover vil du også indgå i opgaver omkring kvalitetskontrol ved varemodtagelse.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har erfaring med elektronikproduktion eller lignende teknisk arbejde

  • Er god til præcisionsarbejde og har et skarpt øje for detaljer

  • Har erfaring med lodning og arbejde med små komponenter

  • Arbejder struktureret og tager ansvar for kvaliteten af dit arbejde

  • Er en teamplayer, der trives i en mindre virksomhed med stor fleksibilitet

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring fra elektronikproduktion, men det er ikke et krav. Har du ikke tidligere erfaring, men er motiveret og har hænderne skruet rigtigt på, tilbyder vi grundig oplæring – især hvis du er komfortabel med at arbejde med små komponenter.

Vi tilbyder:

  • En alsidig hverdag med varierende opgaver, hvor vi hjælper hinanden

  • Et godt og uformelt arbejdsmiljø med en flad struktur og korte beslutningsveje

  • Mulighed for faglig udvikling og indflydelse på dine opgaver

  • Fleksible arbejdstider og god balance mellem arbejde og fritid

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt fuldtid (37 timer/uge), men kan også tilpasses som deltidsstilling afhængig af din situation.

Tiltrædelse er hurtigst muligt, men vi venter gerne på den rette kandidat.

Vi evaluerer ansøgninger og afholder samtaler løbende. Stillingen lukkes, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat, og kan derfor blive besat inden ansøgningsfristen.

jobs.title: Product Software Engineer
jobs.description: Hej Product Software Engineer,Do you want to furnish the future with innovative solutions? With us, you can feel at home in your work while sharing that feeling with millions of people around the world. We encourage you to stand up for yourself and others, creating an environment where everyone feels welcome. We invite you to open new doors, discover new tech possibilities, embrace mistakes, and grow from them. As our Product Software Engineer, you’ll have many opportunities to try things you’ve never done before. Your new job IKEA Range Core is part of the Technology area, working with critical digital products that enable the functioning of IKEA. You’ll be part of IKEA of Sweden and the Range Core Engineering organization within Range Operations. The Range Core Area focuses on building attractive, consistent, and efficient ways of working for pre-product development, our retailers and our suppliers. Our mission is to create a strong foundation for IKEA’s labelling systems, enabling seamless use across the entire value chain. We’re looking for a Product Software Engineer who wants to combine hands-on engineering with technical leadership to build reliable digital products that contribute to a better everyday life for the many people. You will work within Labels and Marking Management domain developing and operating software while helping govern the product architecture and keeping the technical solution coherent across the product and its closest dependencies. You will lead through expertise, coach other engineers and collaborate with Software Engineering Leaders to achieve all outcomes within the Labels domain. On a typical day, you will:     Develop, test, deploy and maintain software for Label and Marking Management.     Govern and evolve the architecture for Label and Marking Management Domain, ensuring coherence, robustness, security, interoperability and appropriate reuse.     Apply, promote and teach modern software engineering practices, including continuous integration and delivery, automated testing and observability.     Deliver secure, maintainable and production-ready code aligned with agreed architecture, standards, planning and budget.     Provide technical direction and mentor engineers through design discussions, code reviews, pairing and knowledge sharing.     Collaborate across products/ teams to manage dependencies and balance product-specific needs with common solutions.     Explore new technologies and create proposals or prototypes that improve architecture, productivity or user experience.     Maintain relevant technical documentation and contribute to indicators that help the team understand delivery and product health. What we’d like you to bring to the table The role as Product Software Engineer requires you to:     Have about 7+ years' experience in software engineering, including strong hands-on experience with RESTful APIs, SQL databases (Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL), including data modelling, complex queries, performance optimization, and stored procedures, or front-end development (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript) and at least one modern framework (React, Angular, or Vue).     Have experience governing or significantly influencing digital product architecture, using relevant architecture concepts or frameworks.     Be a technical coach to the team where you help uplift the team in terms of technical competence.     Ability to facilitate technical discussions, remove blockers, and support team cohesion and productivity.     Have broad knowledge of modern engineering practices, secure development, testing, CI/CD, observability and DevOps ways of working.     Strong interpersonal skills, including active listening, guiding discussions, mediating conflicts, and supporting team development.     Have proven ability to develop high-quality, maintainable code while making sound technical and architectural trade-offs.     Have experience leading and mentoring engineers through influence rather than formal people-management responsibility.     Communicate clearly and collaborate across products, functions, organisational levels and cultural backgrounds.     Be curious, pragmatic and comfortable navigating uncertainty while balancing delivery, user value, quality and long-term product health. It’s a plus if you also:     Have worked across several connected products, platforms or technology domains and managed complex technical dependencies.     Have experience with prototyping, technical discovery, engineering metrics or improving standards and ways of working at scale. Be yourself, a Product Software Engineer, and more! Inter IKEA Group is the group of companies that connects IKEA franchisees with range development and suppliers and aligns the overall IKEA strategic direction. Every day, we strive to develop, produce and sell products and services that are affordable and accessible to everyone. With us, you contribute to building a democratic brand and workplace that has a positive impact on both the planet and people's lives. We welcome your application Get ready to assemble something new! We look forward to receiving your application by 13th of November. This position is based in Malmö. We believe that your presence with the team and working most of the time in the workplace is important.   Please also note that we only handle applications in English and no applications coming in by email. If you have any questions about the role or the recruitment process, feel free to connect with the Hiring Manager manasa.konda@inter.ikea.com or the Recruiter vera.bendz1@inter.ikea.com. At IKEA, we are looking for people who believe everyone deserves a seat at the table. You’re welcome no matter where you come from, what you believe, and what you look like. We don’t even care how you have furnished your home. We’re interested in you simply because you’re you. Even if your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. We believe that people’s different perspectives, backgrounds, and personalities make us better at understanding our customers dreams and needs.

jobs.title: Vi søger rengøringshelte på 35 timer til Børnehave Solsikken med ansættelse pr. 1. januar 2027
jobs.description:
Bliv en del af Team Rent Guld – vi hjemtager rengøringen i hele kommunen Team Rent Guld er Guldborgsund Kommunes samlede rengøringsenhed, som fra 1. januar 2027 får ansvaret for rengøringen på tværs af hele kommunen. Vi er i gang med at opbygge en professionel og velfungerende organisation, hvor kvalitet, stabil drift og godt samarbejde er i centrum.

Vi leder efter engagerede rengøringshelte, som vil være med til at skabe rene, sunde og indbydende rammer for kommunens borgere og medarbejdere. Den gyldne mission er at indeklimaet er en ren fornøjelse at befinde sig i.

Om Team Rent Guld Afdelingen bliver en stor og vigtig del af kommunens daglige drift og vil bestå af 2 afdelingsledere, 3 fagkoordinatorer, 3 flyvere og ca. 90 rengøringsassistenter. Sammen sikrer vi rene, sunde og indbydende rammer for både borgere, brugere og medarbejdere.

Hos os er rengøring en faglig opgave, der gør en reel forskel. Vi arbejder systematisk med kvalitet, moderne metoder og gode arbejdsgange – og vi prioriterer, at alle medarbejdere er godt klædt på til opgaven.

Samtidig lægger vi stor vægt på fællesskab og fleksibilitet. Vi hjælper hinanden på tværs af lokationer ved fravær, spidsbelastninger og hovedrengøring, og vi tror på, at en god arbejdsdag skabes gennem samarbejde, ansvar og en positiv tilgang.

Team Rent Guld er derfor ikke bare en arbejdsplads – det er et fællesskab, hvor du bliver en del af noget større og er med til at sætte standarden for fremtidens kommunale rengøring.

Om stillingen

· 1 medarbejdere på 35 timer ugentligt

· Mødetid kl. 05:00

· Mulighed for flere timer ved fravær, travlhed og hovedrengøring

· Mulighed for helligdagsarbejde

· Synlig rengøring af kommunale bygninger

· Sikring af et godt indeklima for brugere og borgere

· Samarbejde med kollegaer på tværs af lokationer

Arbejdssteder kan være

· Skoler

· Daginstitutioner

· Plejecentre

· Sportshaller

· Administrative bygninger

· Offentlige faciliteter

Hvem er du?

· En sprudlende personlighed, der ikke er bange for at tackle smuds, snavs og andre udfordringer med et smil - du synes rengøring er sjovt  

· Du kan jonglere med dine opgaver 

· Du er organiseret og pålidelig 

· Du har sans for humor og evne til at skabe et positivt og sjovt miljø omkring dig og din rengøringsopgave  

· Du skal have gode kommunikationsevner og øje for detaljen

· Du kan tale, læse og forstå dansk

Tidligere erfaring og uddannelse som rengøringsassistent eller rengøringsteknikker kan være en bonus, men ikke et krav. Vi træner gerne den rette person til at opnå skinnende resultater  

Vi tilbyder

· Et sjovt og dynamisk arbejdsmiljø fyldt med humor og kollegial støtte 

· Mulighed for at være med til at forme Rent Guld og din egen hverdag 

· Gode personlige- og faglige udviklingsmuligheder

· Du bliver klædt godt på til at løfte rengøringsopgaven og vi holder dig opdateret på de nyeste rengøringsmetoder og teknikker

Ansættelsesvilkår· Stillingerne er til besættelse senest den 1. januar 2027

· Efter gældende overenskomst med 3F 

· Kørekort (kategori B) er en fordel, men ikke et krav

· Ansættelse sker med forbehold for godkendt børne- og/eller straffeattest

Ansøgning Send din ansøgning ved at klikke på ”send ansøgning” og vedhæft din ansøgning, dit CV samt et billede senest den 15. november 2026. Vi tager kun imod elektroniske ansøgninger.

Samtaler afholdes i 25. november 2026 på Rådhuset.

jobs.title: Processtekniker inom elektronik
jobs.description: Om KitronKitron, som är Skandinaviens ledande EMS företag, arbetar med utveckling, industrialisering och tillverkning av elektronik för ledande företag inom marknadssegmenten offshore/marin, medicinsk utrustning, försvar/aerospace, energi/telekom och industri. Företaget har verksamhet i Norge, Sverige, Danmark, Litauen, Tyskland, Polen, Tjeckiska Republiken, Indien, Kina, Malaysia och USA. Kitron har cirka 3000 anställda. Våra värderingarLocation: Jönköping, Torsvik Deadline: 2026-11-29, vi har löpande urval.Om rollenSom Processtekniker arbetar du nära vår elektronikproduktion med ansvar för att utveckla, optimera och kvalitetssäkra våra tillverkningsprocesser.Du kommer bland annat att arbeta med processer och utrustning inom PNP (Pic and place)/AOI (Automatic Optical Inspection) samt närliggande processer inom vår elektronikproduktion. I Kitrons AOI-process ingår bland annat programmering, underhåll, felsökning och analys av produktions- och yield-data.Exempel på arbetsuppgifter:    Utveckla och optimera produktionsprocesser    Programmering och optimering av utrustning    Felsökning och tekniskt stöd till produktionen    Analysera fel, utfall och produktionsdata    Driva förbättringar inom kvalitet, effektivitet och processäkerhet    Samarbeta nära produktion, tekniker och EngineeringVem söker vi?Vi söker dig som har ett stort tekniskt intresse och gillar problemlösning. Du har gärna erfarenhet från elektronikproduktion och processer såsom AOI, SMT, SPI, X-ray eller andra automatiserade kontroll- och produktionsprocesser.Du är analytisk, lösningsorienterad och gillar att arbeta nära produktionen. Erfarenhet av AOI är mycket meriterande, men lika viktigt är din vilja och förmåga att lära dig och utveckla våra processer.Relevant teknisk utbildning inom exempelvis elektronik, automation eller produktionsteknik är meriterande.Rollen kan innebära skiftgång 2-skift.Varför Kitron?Hos oss får du arbeta i en modern och teknikintensiv produktionsmiljö tillsammans med kunniga kollegor. Du får möjlighet att påverka, utveckla våra processer och själv växa tillsammans med verksamheten.Vill du vara med och utveckla framtidens elektronikproduktion? Välkommen med din ansökan!AnsökanLåter detta som något för dig? Skicka in din ansökan redan idag.Då Kitron verkar inom branscher med höga krav på säkerhet och kvalitet kommer bakgrundskontroll att genomföras på slutkandidat innan anställning.Vi har gjort vårt medieval för denna rekrytering och undanber oss därför vänligen men bestämt kontakt från rekryteringsföretag, bemanningsföretag och annonsförsäljare.Välkommen med din ansökan till Kitron AB i Jönköping!
