jobs.title: Projectorganisator Bedrijfsbureau
jobs.description:
Wil jij impact maken aan de voorkant van onze uitdagende bouwprojecten? Heb je ruime technische kennis. Heb jij affiniteit met planning en prijsvorming? Dan is dit jouw kans om als Projectorganisator Bedrijfsbureau het verschil te maken!

 

Dit wordt jouw baan

Je vertaalt als Projectorganisator Bedrijfsbureau ontwerpen in optimale en slimme bouwmethodieken. Met jouw technische inzicht, praktische aanpak en overtuigingskracht speel je een sleutelrol in onze tenders en in de voorbereiding van onze projecten. Je werkt op het bedrijfsbureau van Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed in Rotterdam en maakt onderdeel uit van een ervaren team, met veel vrijheid en ruimte voor initiatief. Jij bent vanaf het begin betrokken bij onze woningbouw- en utiliteitsprojecten. Samen met een team van ervaren collega’s werk je onder andere aan:

·       Het analyseren van constructies en bepalen van de meest optimale bouwmethodiek.

·       Het opstellen van de bouwtijdplanning (Asta Powerproject)

·       Het opstellen van de algemene bouwplaatskosten

·       Het ontwerpen van 3D-bouwplaatsinrichtingen (Revit)

·       Het afstemmen met de materieeldienst, leveranciers en onderaannemers.

·       Input leveren voor BLVC- en logistieke plannen.

·       Input leveren voor een onderbouwd plan van aanpak om tenders te winnen.

Jouw bijdrage is cruciaal voor het binnenhalen en goed voorbereiden van onze projecten. Je denkt actief mee over alternatieven en innovaties, met oog voor duurzaamheid en veranderende regelgeving.

 

Meer bij Dura Vermeer

Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis.

Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken.

Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt.

Hier zit je op je plek

Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Rotterdam is een grote werkmaatschappij binnen de Dura Vermeer Groep en opereert als een ontwikkelende bouwer in de regio Zuid-Holland. We zijn gespecialiseerd in het bouwen van woningen, zowel gestapeld als grondgebonden, en utilitaire gebouwen, met de focus op nieuwbouwprojecten.

Ons team is verdeeld in zes zelfstandige waardestromen, elk met hun eigen expertise. Binnen deze teams, die uit ongeveer 35 collega’s bestaan, werken we met alle benodigde disciplines samen. De structuur is plat en zonder overbodige hiërarchie, wat zorgt voor een prettige, efficiënte samenwerking. Zo combineren we de voordelen van een groot bedrijf met de warme, persoonlijke sfeer van kleinschaliger teams: de waardestromen.

Bij ons heerst een informele sfeer met een typisch Rotterdamse mentaliteit: hard werken, maar ook hard lachen. We helpen elkaar waar nodig en dankzij de veilige en inclusieve werkomgeving waar iedereen zichzelf kan zijn, staan we bekend als een fijne plek om te werken!


Dit breng je mee

·       Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in de werkvoorbereiding, uitvoering of als bouwtechnoloog/projectorganisator.

·       Je hebt een afgeronde bouwkundige opleiding.

·       Je hebt ervaring met Asta powerproject en Revit.

·       Je hebt technisch inzicht en werkt gestructureerd.

·       Je kan goed samenwerken, neemt initiatief en denkt een stap vooruit.

·       Jij staat voor jouw oplossingen en kan deze mondeling goed toelichten aan o.a. uitvoering.

·       Je kunt snel schakelen tussen verschillende werkzaamheden en bent stressbestendig

Deze punten geven een beeld van het profiel dat wij zoeken. Herken jij jezelf niet volledig in alle punten, maar denk je wel dat deze functie bij je past? Dan gaan we graag met je in gesprek.

Dit bieden wij jou

  • Het salaris voor deze functie ligt tussen €5.639,- €7.049,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur), exclusief 8% vakantiegeld. Afhankelijk van jouw kennis, niveau en werkervaring is een uitloop mogelijk.

  • Bovenop salaris komt een vast bedrag Budget Duurzame Inzetbaarheid voor zaken die eraan bijdragen gezond en gemotiveerd te blijven (2,3% volgens cao Bouw & Infra).

  • Met oog op een langdurige relatie bieden we je na 2 maanden proeftijd een onbepaalde tijd contract.

  • 43 verlofdagen volgens de cao Bouw & Infra. Van deze dagen worden er 13 uitbetaald in je individuele budget, je kunt ervoor kiezen om deze dagen terug te kopen;

  • Een laptop en een smartphone.

  • Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals een standaardverzekering van alle werknemersrisico's, pensioenregelingen, een extra aanvulling bij arbeidsongeschiktheid en een bijdrage voor het vakbondslidmaatschap.

  • Je hebt de keuze tussen een elektrische leaseauto, een mobiliteitsbudget of NS Business Card. 

  • Bij een contract voor onbepaalde tijd kun je een gloednieuwe (elektrische) fiets uitzoeken dankzij onze samenwerking met lease-a-bike.

  • Veel aandacht voor jouw groei dankzij onze eigen Dura Vermeer Academie met volop opleiding- en trainingsmogelijkheden binnen je vakgebied, maar ook op het gebied van vitaliteit.

  • Bedrijfsfitnessregeling met keuze uit een sportaanbod van ruim 3.500 sportlocaties door heel Nederland.

  • Een goede werk-privébalans dankzij een flexibel werken beleid en soepele regelingen voor arbeidsduur, werktijden, calamiteiten, mantelzorg of sabbatical

  • Voor verse vaders en partners: 100% doorbetaling van je salaris tijdens de 5 weken van het aanvullend geboorteverlof, in plaats van de standaard 70%.

  • Voor de generatie die een studieschuld heeft opgebouwd tijdens het nieuwe leenstelsel is er een voordelige regeling voor de aflossing van studieschuld. Je kunt jaarlijks een bedrag van je brutosalaris inleggen om je studieschuld af te lossen. Dura Vermeer verdubbelt jouw inleg.

 

Wil jij ook meer uit je werk halen?

Dan zijn wij nieuwsgierig naar jou! Solliciteren kan direct via onze website middels de solliciteerbutton onder de vacature.

Meer weten? Neem contact op met onze recruiter Liza van der Munnik via 06 34 15 71 45 of Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

  • je volgt een hbo- of wo-opleiding Werktuigbouwkunde of Civiele Techniek;

  • je hebt kennis van constructies, materiaaleigenschappen, statica of dynamica;

Soms gaan jullie samen lunchen of bezoeken jullie een project. Andere maanden staat er een inhoudelijke sessie op de planning en leer je bijvoorbeeld beter presenteren of adviseren.

En dat is nog niet alles: je kunt gebruikmaken van onze eigen Academy met ruim 3.000 verschillende leerlijnen, trainingen en e-learningmodules.

Dit krijg je bij Movares

Bij Movares werk je mee aan een uitdagende opdracht met volop kansen om jezelf te ontwikkelen. Er hangt een leuke en gezellige sfeer. Je krijgt een kijkje in de keuken van een toonaangevend advies- en ingenieursbureau, volop ruimte voor eigen initiatief en goede begeleiding. De duur en startdatum zijn in overleg nader te bepalen. Verder krijg je:

  • een aantrekkelijke vergoeding van €550 op basis van een fulltime dienstverband;

  • ruimte voor het vinden van jouw ideale werk-privé-balans;

  • leuke collega’s en een afstudeerplek in hartje Utrecht.

En er is méér. Want afstuderen bij Movares betekent ook:

  • bijdragen aan een schone wereld, omdat je stageloopt bij het eerste bedrijf in Nederland met een Zero Waste-certificaat;

  • lid worden van Young Movares, de jongerenvereniging waar je leert van én met andere jonge collega’s.

Jouw team bij Movares

Voor jou als afstudeerstagiair(e) Constructieve Perrons is er plek op onze afdeling Integraal Ontwerpen in team W-installaties.

Binnen dit team werken collega's met verschillende technische achtergronden samen aan duurzame en toekomstbestendige oplossingen voor het spoor. Je komt terecht in een open en betrokken werkomgeving waar kennis delen vanzelfsprekend is. Tijdens jouw afstudeerstage werk je nauw samen met specialisten op het gebied van constructies, geotechniek en dynamica. Ook heb je contact met ProRail en leveranciers. De sfeer is inhoudelijk sterk, maar tegelijkertijd laagdrempelig. Je krijgt veel ruimte om zelfstandig onderzoek uit te voeren, ideeën te toetsen en jouw resultaten te bespreken met ervaren collega's. Zo ervaar je direct hoe jouw onderzoek impact kan maken op de spoorinfrastructuur van morgen.

jobs.description:
Misschien wel het leukste bedrijf van Nederland is op zoek naar versterking! Dit prachtige familiebedrijf groeit als kool en daarom zijn wij hard op zoek naar marketing talent. Word jij enthousiast van grote brands? Ben je benieuwd hoe deze internationaal worden gepositioneerd en houd jij van design? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Op de Global Marketingafdeling houden we ons o.a. bezig met Brand Management, Product Management, Social Media en Influencer Marketing.

Binnen het brand management team zijn wij op zoek naar een Brand Management stagiair(e). Als Brand Management stagiair(e) draai je gewoon mee met het team. Dit betekent dat je een lekker veelzijdige baan hebt met veel verantwoordelijkheden. Je helpt ons met het ontwikkelen van diverse brand campagnes, van idee tot shoot en van lancering tot evaluatie. Daarnaast bewaak en versterk je de merk identiteit (in meer dan 85 landen!), dit doe je door veel te schakelen met andere afdelingen binnen KEUNE.

Btw, koffie halen en printen kunnen we zelf, daar ben jij niet voor. We vinden het veel belangrijker dat je je stem laat horen en ons omver blaast met je kennis van de beauty-industrie, je goede ideeën en je slimme vragen.

We staan open voor zowel meewerkstagiairs als afstudeerders. In overleg formuleren we een passende onderzoeksvraag waarmee jij kunt afstuderen, mits je minimaal 4 dagen in de week meewerkt.

YOU

  • Spreekt en schrijft flawless Nederlands en Engels;

  • Begrijpt wat het inhoudt om onderdeel van een team te zijn;

OUR OFFER

KEUNE

We zijn een familiebedrijf met een langetermijnvisie, waar wetenschap centraal staat in alles wat we doen. Ons verhaal begint in 1922, in Amsterdam. Vandaag, 104 jaar later en een koninklijk predicaat rijker, hoort KEUNE bij één van de hardst groeiende merken in professionele haarverzorgingsproducten. Vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Soest worden KEUNE-producten ontwikkeld, geproduceerd en wereldwijd gedistribueerd naar meer dan 85 landen. En we zijn niet van plan om gas terug te nemen! Ieder jaar openen we een nieuwe eigen vestiging. We produceren op een duurzame en diervriendelijke manier en zijn B Corp-gecertificeerd. Maar bij KEUNE gaat het niet alleen om het creëren van mooie producten - het gaat om ons verhaal en onze visie. KEUNE staat onder leiding van Philip Berlijn, die zich richt op het bouwen van een sterk merk en het creëren van een bedrijfscultuur die draait om samenwerken, duurzaamheid en het tonen van karakter.

jobs.description:

Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot

Berenschot is op zoek naar een masterstudent die stage wil lopen bij de adviesgroep Openbaar Bestuur. Heb jij affiniteit met bestuurlijke vraagstukken en interesse in het adviesvak? Vind jij het leuk om mee te draaien in adviesprojecten en heb je een sterk organisatorisch vermogen? Dan is deze stage iets voor jou! Werken voor Berenschot betekent werken aan maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Wij helpen verschillende organisaties in het publieke domein met allerlei uitdagingen. Ook organiseren we regelmatig bijeenkomsten, kennissessies en meetings met een maatschappelijk tintje. Je leert veel over het dynamische speelveld waarin wij werken, doordat je direct meewerkt aan uitdagende opdrachten en een actieve bijdrage levert aan de genoemde activiteiten. Je komt terecht in een ambitieus en gedreven team met veel ervaring in het publieke domein. Dit team focust zich voornamelijk op strategie, samenwerking en organisatieontwikkeling in het openbaar bestuur. Zie je jezelf na de stage in het adviesvak? Dan zijn er mogelijkheden om te solliciteren op een traineeship.

Dit ga je doen

Overheden staan voor uiteenlopende uitdagingen, van de energietransitie tot het verbeteren van de woningmarkt. Berenschot helpt ministeries, provincies, gemeenten en waterschappen om deze uitdagingen aan te gaan. Als stagiair(e) draag je bij door:

  • Mee te draaien met de Gideonsbende, waar je helpt bij de organisatie van leergangen en inspiratiesessies.

  • Actief mee te werken aan opdrachten, zodat je het speelveld en de spelers binnen het publieke domein leert kennen.

  • Samen met collega-consultants naar klanten te gaan en te leren van hun vraagstukken.

  • Onderzoek te doen en vraagstukken te analyseren, ter ondersteuning van het advieswerk.

  • Leermodules en events te organiseren, waarbij je contact onderhoudt met sprekers en locaties.

Tijdens je stage word je intensief begeleid door een adviseur, zodat je je professionele vaardigheden ontwikkelt en leert hoe concepten en theorieën toegepast worden in de praktijk. Ook het uitvoeren van een afstudeeronderzoek is mogelijk. In dat geval bespreken we graag met elkaar hoe we het afstudeeronderzoek zo goed mogelijk kunnen laten aansluiten op ons advieswerk en vice versa.

Quote

"De kracht van samenwerking in het publieke domein inspireert mij dagelijks om innovatieve en waardevolle oplossingen te bieden voor maatschappelijke uitdagingen." – Senior consultant publieke sector

Hier kom je terecht

Berenschot is een onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je invloed hebt op de projecten die je uitvoert. We streven altijd naar verrassende en vernieuwende oplossingen, wat ons uniek maakt. Met een open en informele cultuur, samenwerking tussen verschillende vakgebieden en veel vrijheid vanaf dag één krijg je de kans om te ontdekken waar je kracht ligt en waarin jij je wilt ontwikkelen.

Dit zijn je directe collega's

Je gaat werken binnen de adviesgroep Openbaar Bestuur, specifiek in het team Strategie, Samenwerking en Organisatieontwikkeling. Dit team bestaat uit twintig gedreven adviseurs met specialisaties in bestuurskunde, rechten, technologie en innovatie. We houden ontwikkelingen in de maatschappij, politiek en economie nauwlettend in de gaten en schakelen direct in bij grote opgaven. We werken in wisselende teams, zodat altijd de juiste expertise beschikbaar is. Naast hard werken, wordt er veel gelachen.

Binnen Berenschot hebben we een Gideonsbende: vrije denkers en jonge mensen die evenementen organiseren die normaal niet tot stand komen. Denk aan leergangen voor bestuurders en topambtenaren met de titel ‘Taaie thema’s en duivelse dilemma’s in het openbaar bestuur’. Daarnaast organiseren we onze eigen schaduwverkiezingen (inclusief uitslagenevenement) parallel aan die van de Tweede Kamer, provincies/Waterschappen of gemeenteraden. Verder organiseren wij allerlei andere bijeenkomsten, zoals een adviesmarathon voor het oplossen van vraagstukken van kleinere maatschappelijke organisaties.


Dit neem je mee

  • Je volgt een master (technische) bestuurskunde, management van de publieke sector, politicologie, bedrijfskunde, economie, sociologie of een vergelijkbare richting. Staat jouw studierichting hier niet bij, maar heb je wel affiniteit met het openbaar bestuur en een maatschappelijke drive? Solliciteer dan ook zeker!

  • Je hebt een sterk conceptueel en analytisch vermogen, bent nieuwsgierig en staat stevig in je schoenen.

  • Je bent creatief, goed in organiseren en werkt graag in teamverband.

  • Je bent gedurende je stage ingeschreven bij een onderwijsinstelling.

Dit bieden we jou

Bij Berenschot bieden we een unieke werkomgeving zonder aandeelhouders of partners, wat ons de vrijheid geeft om te ondernemen en ons in te zetten voor maatschappelijke thema’s. We hebben een informele cultuur, korte communicatielijnen en volop kansen voor persoonlijke en professionele groei. Daarnaast bieden we:

  • Een stagevergoeding van € 600,- bruto per maand op basis van fulltime.

  • Een laptop.

  • Persoonlijke begeleiding gericht op jouw professionele en vakinhoudelijke ontwikkeling.

  • Een inspirerende werkplek in Utrecht en hybride werkmogelijkheden.

  • Veel stagiairs zijn na hun stage aan een traineeship bij Berenschot begonnen – bij goed presteren biedt deze stage uitstekende kansen voor jouw carrière.

Stageplusprogramma

Naast je stage kun je deelnemen aan het Stageplusprogramma van Berenschot: een opleidingsprogramma van circa 3,5 maand dat trainingen biedt op het gebied van advieskennis, -vaardigheden en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Dit vraagt gemiddeld één dagdeel per twee weken. Via deze link lees je meer over het programma . Alles over ons stageplusprogramma | Berenschot

Vergeet in je motivatie niet te vermelden voor welke periode je een stage zoekt en hoeveel uur per week je beschikbaar bent. Dan kunnen we je sollicitatie zo goed mogelijk beoordelen.

Zo ziet het sollicitatieproces eruit

Na je sollicitatie ontvang je binnen een werkweek een reactie. Bij een positieve uitkomst nodigen we je uit voor een kennismaking collega-adviseurs en je toekomstige manager. Sluit dat goed aan? Dan krijg je snel een concreet aanbod en verwelkomen we je graag in ons team als nieuwe Berenschotter!

This is your chance to be part of something big - while being closer to nature and leading a balanced, purposeful life.What you'll doRight now, we are looking for a Process Engineer – Direct Reduction for our Green Iron Operations. jobs.title: Bli vår nye mekaniker i Ålesund – frihet, faglige utfordringer og et rått team!

Hos oss blir du ikke bare en som skrur, du får det reelle ansvaret for at utleieparken i Ålesund spiller på lag. Verkstedet og maskinparken blir ditt stolte ansvarsområde, hvor du får styre prosessene, planlegge kapasiteten og ta de faglige avgjørelsene som utgjør en forskjell. Du får en nøkkelrolle med stor handlingsfrihet, samtidig som du blir en del av et uformelt og faglig sterkt team som deler erfaringer og mener at god humor er like viktig som godt håndverk.

 

Hva tilbyr vi deg?

Vi vet at en avdeling kun fungerer bra når folk trives. Derfor legger vi alt til rette for en forutsigbar og god hverdag med lavt stressnivå, selv når det koker litt ekstra.

 

  • Stor tillit og faglig eierskap: Du får styre hverdagen din i stor grad selv og ta avgjørelser som påvirker driften direkte.
  • Et sterkt fagmiljø å sparre med: Du står aldri alene! Teamet i Ålesund, sammen med erfarne mekanikere i resten av regionen, samarbeider tett og deler gladelig av sin erfaring.
  • Gode betingelser: Konkurransedyktig lønn, attraktiv bonusordning og solid pensjons- og forsikringspakke.
  • Balanse og trivsel: Vi har fokus på trivsel og at du har det bra både på og utenfor jobb. Du får støtte til trening og én betalt frivillighetsdag i året.
  • Uformell kultur: En «klart vi kan»-holdning med rom for god humor og høyt under taket.

 

Hva innebærer rollen hos oss?

Som mekaniker hos Cramo i Ålesund tar du styringen over arbeidshverdagen. Du sørger for at maskinene våre er funksjonelle, godt vedlikeholdt og fremstår visuelt flotte for kundene våre.

 

Dine viktigste oppgaver vil være:

  • Helhetlig eierskap til maskinparken: Feilsøking, service, reparasjoner og klargjøring før, under og etter utleie.
  • Styre kapasitet og innkjøp: Du vurderer arbeidsmengden fortløpende. Ved topper, servicer eller årskontroller har du mandat til å koordinere med eksterne leverandører/mekanikere.
  • Prosess- og kostnadskontroll: Du styrer hele reparasjonsløpet fra feilsøking til registrering og kostnadsføring på serviceordre, slik at drift kan fakturere reelle reparasjonskostnader videre.
  • Verksteddrift: Holde orden i delebestillinger, optimalisere verksteddriften og redusere antall maskiner som står «nede».
  • Utrykninger og feltoppdrag: Noen dager jobber du på verkstedet, andre dager drar du ut til kunden og blir helten som løser utfordringene på stedet.

 

 

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi leter ikke etter en superhelt som kan alt fra dag en, men etter deg som brenner for mekaniker faget, liker å ha oversikt og har god teknisk forstand. Du stolt av jobben du gjør, enten du løser en kompleks feilkode eller sørger for at en maskin ser skinnende ny ut for neste kunde.

 

Det er ideelt om du har:

  • Fagbrev innen anleggs-, landbruks- eller industrimekanikk, elektro (Gr. L) eller et annet relevant mekanisk fag.
  • …men har du lang, praktisk erfaring og en "skru-hjerne" som løser det meste? Søk likevel! Hos oss veier reell kompetanse, faglig engasjement og rett innstilling veldig høyt.
  • Førerkort klasse B (har du BE eller truckførerbevis er det en fin bonus. Har du det ikke, så finner vi ut av det sammen).

  • Grunnleggende digitale ferdigheter og gode norskkunnskaper.

     

Du er en vi passe sammen med dersom du:

  • Motiveres av tillit og frihet under ansvar, og liker å ha kontroll på egne prosjekter og kostnader.
  • Trives med at det koker litt ekstra i ny og ne, men mestrer kunsten å holde hodet kaldt slik at det aldri oppleves som uoversiktlig stress.
  • Er en utpreget lagspiller som bryr seg om kollegene sine, sprer god stemning i kaffepausene og skaper en trygg, inkluderende arbeidsplass.

 

Klar for nye utfordringer?

Send oss en søknad eller ta kontakt for en uforpliktende prat om rollen! Vi gleder oss til å bli kjent med deg.

 

 

 

 

For mer informasjon eller spørsmål, kontakt oss på:

Mail: Richard.taylor@randstad.noMobil: 982 95 163

For å søke:Registrer din CV online på www.randstad.no og søk på denne stillingen.

  • Søknadsfrist - Senest 16.11.26. (Ansettelse kan bli gjort før frist)

Alle søkere vil få svar og blir kontaktet.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Cramo er et av Norges ledende utleieselskaper innen maskiner, utstyr og modulbygg for bygg, anlegg, industri og offentlig sektor. Vi har over 30 avdelinger, mer enn 300 ansatte og er sertifisert innen kvalitet, miljø og arbeidsmiljø (ISO 9001, 14001 og 45001).

Siden 2020 har Cramo vært en del av Boels Rental, en av Europas største og mest fremtidsrettede 

aktører innen utleiebransjen. Dette gir oss et solid apparat i ryggen og gode forutsetninger for videre utvikling.

I vår avdeling jobber vi målrettet for å levere de beste løsningene i markedet, med høy aktivitet, tett samarbeid med både små og store kunder, og et fremoverlent arbeidsmiljø preget av kontinuerlig utvikling og varierte arbeidsoppgaver.

jobs.title: Viborg Stift søger en kirkegårdskonsulent
jobs.description:
Viborg Stift søger en kirkegårdskonsulent med tiltrædelse pr. 1. januar 2027. Stilling er tidsbegrænset i 4 år og udløber den 31. december 2030.

Stillingen er en bibeskæftigelse.

Landets kirkegårde er grønne rum, hvor kulturarv, natur og livshistorier mødes. Vi søger en kirkegårdskonsulent, der forstår dette samspil og vil bidrage aktivt til kirkegårdenes udvikling.

Profil

Vi forventer, at du er uddannet landskabsarkitekt fra Det Biovidenskabelige Fakultet for Fødevarer, Veterinærmedicin og Naturressourcer, Kunstakademiets Arkitektskole, Århus Arkitektskole eller have en tilsvarende godkendt uddannelse.

Opgaver

Opgaverne indebærer råd og vejledning til stift, provsti eller menighedsråd om folkekirkens kirkegårde og nære omgivelser, om bl.a.:

• anlæggelse og udvidelse af kirkegårde

• indretning af kirkegårde herunder driftsstyring, udviklings- og bevaringsplanlægning

• udvidelse eller udvendige ombygninger af bygninger på kirkegårde

• opførelse, udvidelse og udvendig ombygning eller salg af kirkegårdsnære bygninger til brug for kirken og kirkegården eller præsteembedet

• arbejdsmiljø for kirkegårdens ansatte

• kategorisering af kirkegårde

Som kirkegårdskonsulent skal du efter anmodning afgive erklæring i sager, der vedrører ovenstående.

Du skal også yde råd og vejledning til menighedsråd og kirkegårdsbestyrelser, som beder om det.

Kirkegårdskonsulenten deltager efter behov også i stiftets konsulentrunder, hvor vi bl.a. besøger kirkegårde i stiftet, hvor et menighedsråd har ønsker eller planer om et projekt. Ved konsulentrunderne drøftes projektet med menighedsrådet, og kirkegårdskonsulenten sætter sin faglighed i spil sammen med stiftets øvrige konsulenter. Der afholdes ca. 4 konsulentrunder pr. år.

Det praktiske

Som kirkegårdskonsulent virker du som rådgiver for de kirkelige myndigheder efter reglerne i:

  • Kirkeministeriets bekendtgørelse nr. 955 af 6. oktober 2009 om folkekirkens konsulenter

  • Kirkeministeriets cirkulære nr. 9779 af 6. oktober 2009 om fællesinstruks for folkekirkens konsulenter

  • Vejledning nr. 9789 af 6. oktober 2009 om folkekirkens konsulenter

Bemærk at bekendtgørelse og cirkulærer kan ændre sig både før og under ansættelsesperioden.

Det er vigtigt at være opmærksom på, at du som kirkegårdskonsulent ikke må påtage dig projekteringsopgaver for menighedsråd indenfor det stift du er ansat, medmindre stiftet undtagelsesvis godkender det.

Honorar

Honoraret udgør pr. 1. januar 2026:

• Rådgivningssager i henhold til § 8 i cirkulære nr. 9779 af 6. oktober 2009 om fællesinstruks for folkekirkens konsulenter: 1.236 kr. pr. time.

• Erklæringssager i henhold til § 7, stk. 1, i cirkulære nr. 9779 af 6. oktober 2009 om fællesinstruks for folkekirkens konsulenter: 1.854 kr. pr. erklæring.

Honoraret tillægges feriegodtgørelse på 12,5%, mens der ikke skal tillægges moms.

Satserne reguleres årligt pr. 1. januar.

Ansøgning

Ansøgning med bilag sendes til Viborg Stift på: kmvib@km.dk.

Ansøgningsfrist: mandag den 30. november 2026, kl. 12.00.

Der afholdes samtaler den 7. eller 9. december 2026.

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du ringe til kontorchef Dorthe Pinnerup på tlf.nr. 23991197 eller souschef Katrine Søbo Andreasen på tlf.nr. 40572881.

jobs.title: Executive Director, People & Organisation
jobs.description:
Would you like to shape the people, culture and organisational foundations of one of the world’s leading humanitarian organisations?  

This is an opportunity to bring your global leadership experience to a mission with profound human impact. As Executive Director for People & Organisation (P&O) at the Danish Refugee Council (DRC), you will inspire employees, empower leaders and turn strategy into meaningful change – ensuring that DRC has the people, capabilities, structures and safeguards required to deliver effective humanitarian responses wherever they are needed most.  

You will join DRC at an important time and have a real opportunity to influence its global direction and organisation. The global humanitarian system is going through fundamental change, and you will help shape and adapt organisational structure, operating models and staff capacity to the challenges and opportunities of the future. Your portfolio is global and spans organisation and culture, HR and leadership development, surge capacity, safety, legal affairs and Code of Conduct. As a member of the Executive Management Team, you will help shape strategy, and you will lead approximately 200 colleagues across P&O functions in headquarters and countries. About the job 

Reporting directly to the Secretary General, you will set the direction for DRC’s global People & Organisation strategy and ensure that it becomes an enabler for DRC’s ambitions. In close partnership with the Executive Management Team and senior leaders, you will create the conditions for talented people to grow and thrive – while strengthening an inclusive, and high-performing culture. 

This role calls for a leader who enjoys moving between strategic ambition and practical delivery. You will ensure that global policies, systems, data, employment conditions and governance provide relevant and timely support to operations. At the same time, you will carry executive accountability for safeguarding, ethical conduct, legal compliance, safety and DRC’s humanitarian surge capacity – areas fundamental to DRC’s mission. 

You will lead and develop an experienced senior team; Global HR, HR Denmark, HR Operations & Analytics, Surge Capacity, Safety, Code of Conduct, Legal, management support, and change, leadership and culture. Based at DRC’s headquarters in Copenhagen, you will work across a global organisation and build trusted relationships with colleagues and partners from many cultures and contexts. 

The impact you will make: 

  • Shape DRC’s strategy, culture and global P&O agenda. 

  • Lead organisational change, leadership development and employee engagement. 

  • Attract, develop and retain the people DRC needs to deliver its mission. 

  • Ensure effective global P&O policies, systems, services and people insights. 

  • Oversee safeguarding, Code of Conduct, safety, legal compliance, duty of care. 

  • Strengthen humanitarian surge capacity. 

About you 

You are a credible executive who is motivated by purpose and energised by complexity. You bring the strategic perspective to see the whole organisation, the judgement to make thoughtful choices and the drive to translate ambition into clear priorities and measurable results. Colleagues experience you as an inclusive and trusted leader with integrity and empathy providing the clarity to make decisions and create momentum.  

What you will bring: 

  • 10+ years of senior experience in global organisations and people leadership. 

  • A strong record of shaping people strategy and leading transformation across complex, international operations. 

  • Experience of organisational development, including the renewal and design of operating models. 

  • Broad understanding of governance, compliance, safeguarding, safety and legal matters.

  • Strong stakeholder management, analytical and communication skills. 

  • An inclusive, decisive and high-integrity leadership style. 

  • A relevant master’s degree and fluent English; additional competency in French, Spanish, Arabic and Danish are an advantage. 

All employees in DRC should master DRC's core competencies: Communicating, Taking the lead, Collaborating, Striving for excellence and Demonstrating integrity. 

We offer 

Contract length: Permanent 

Work location:  Lyngbyvej 100, 2100 Copenhagen Ø, just by Ryparken S-train station. DRC has recently moved to a newly renovated multi-tenant house (VOX) with a modern look and shared green canteen.  

Salary and conditions will be in accordance with the agreement between DRC and Lederaftalen between Dansk Arbejdsgiverforening and Lederne (agreement for managers), which can be found here: www.lederne.dk. This is a national position for which local terms and conditions apply.  

We welcome all nationalities to apply for the role. If you do not have the existing right to work in Denmark, DRC will support with applying and paying for a work permit. 

Application process 

If you are motivated by the opportunity to strengthen a global humanitarian organisation through its people, culture and organisational capabilities, we would welcome your application. Korn Ferry is assisting the Danish Refugee Council with the recruitment of the Executive Director, People & Organisation. Please submit your motivated application and CV through the designated recruitment channel. All applicants must upload a cover letter and an updated CV (no longer than four pages) in English. Applications sent by email will not be considered. 

Closing date for applications: Wednesday 11th November 2026   

Further information  

For questions regarding the vacancy please contact: Rabea Rehman, Associate | Executive Search at Korn Ferry, E: DRC_PO@KornFerry.com  

For more information about the Danish Refugee Council, please visit our website drc.ngo. 

Danish Refugee Council is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive and positive work environment based on mutual respect for all employees. All applicants are considered for employment regardless of personal characteristics or attributes.

jobs.description: Koordinaattori / myyjä – Top Toimijat OyHaemme koordinaattori-myyjää – painopiste Helsinki. Tehtävä sopii myös uran alkuvaiheeseen – tärkeintä on oikea asenne ja halu oppia, ja perehdytämme sinut kunnolla. Tarjoamme asiakkaille joustavasti joko pelkät tekijät, tekijät ja työnjohdon tai koko työn avaimet käteen -periaatteella. Huippukaudella meillä on töissä yli 100 tekijää ja käytössä oma kalusto – yli 20 pakettiautoa ja ammattityökalut ympäri vuoden.Painopisteemme on perinteisesti ollut vihertöissä ja talvikunnossapidossa, mutta olemme viime aikoina laajentaneet toimintaamme vahvasti myös muille aloille – kuten siivoukseen, ikkunanpesuun ja cateringiin. jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow position in Mathematics
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a PhD Research Fellow position in Mathematics, available at the Department of Mathematics, as part of QSTAR – Centre for quantum computing and applications.

Starting date as soon as possible and no later than 01.04.2027.

The fellowship period is three years.

A fourth year may be considered, and it will involve 25 % of other career-promoting work. Other career-promoting work may consist of teaching, supervision, and/or research assistance. This is dependent upon the qualifications of the applicant and the current needs of the department.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.

Place of work is Department of Mathematics/QSTAR at Blindern, Oslo.

Job description

The position is affiliated with QSTAR - Centre for Quantum Computing and Applications. QSTAR is a five-year research centre funded by the Research Council of Norway (project number 361617) and hosted and led by SINTEF. It brings together researchers at SINTEF, UiO, NTNU, OsloMet and Simula Research Laboratory, with international partners at the University of Copenhagen and RISE in Sweden.

The centre connects four research work packages: fault tolerance and error correction; compilation and Hamiltonian engineering; foundations of quantum algorithms; and quantum algorithms for applications. Together, they address how quantum information can be protected, how algorithms can be implemented, and where quantum computation may offer advantages, particularly in chemistry and optimisation.

PhD candidates become part of a research community spanning mathematics, physics, chemistry and optimisation. The centre’s programme includes seminars, PhD schools, annual retreats and conferences, alongside opportunities for international exchange and collaboration across partner institutions.

Learn more about the centre’s research, people and activities on the QSTAR website

The position is advertised within work package 1 “Fault-tolerance and error correction”. More specifically, the successful candidate will work on theoretical questions in one of the following two projects.

The first project studies questions in the fields of quantum groups and tensor categories, with a particular focus on possible applications to fault-tolerant quantum computation through the paradigm of topological quantum computation. We also aim to develop and extend connections between these fields and quantum information science in a broad sense, beyond fault-tolerance.

The second project is concerned with employing methods of group theory, representation theory and operator algebras to construct new families of quantum codes with improved performance and novel features. Another core task in the second project will be to study various families of quantum channels from the perspective of quantifying noise.

The PhD Fellow will join the Operator Algebra group in Section 6 at the Department of Mathematics, where the work will be conducted in close collaboration with other members of the QSTAR project.

The PhD Fellow will:

  • Look for application of the theory of tensor category and quantum groups to problems related to topological quantum computation.
  • Look for connections between quantum information theory and noncommutative geometry through studying quantum channels as noise models.
  • Work in close collaboration with researchers in operator algebras and quantum information theory.
  • Join a research group with broad expertise in mathematics, quantum chemistry, and theoretical physics.
What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in Mathematics or Physics. Foreign completed degree (M.Sc.-level) corresponding to a minimum of four years in the Norwegian educational system
  • Relevant experience in operator algebras, representation theory, or quantum information theory
  • For applicants with an MSc in Physics, a solid mathematical component in their education is required.
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English.

Candidates without a master’s degree have until 31.03.2027 to complete the final exam.

Desired qualifications:

  • Documented, sound knowledge of one or more of the following topics: C*-algebras, noncommutative geometry, representation theory and its applications to quantum groups, quantum field theory, quantum information theory
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in a Scandinavian language

Language requirement:

  • Good oral and written communication skills in English
  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/ EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements:https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8

Grade requirements:The norm is as follows:

  • The average grade point for courses included in the Bachelor’s degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The average grade point for courses included in the Master’s degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The Master’s thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

For more information see:

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. 

What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team
  • Ability to work precise in a structured manner and swiftly adapts to new tasks
  • Good communication and collaboration skills
  • Positive attitude and the ability to handle hectic periods

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.

We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • A pleasant and stimulating work environment
  • Good welfare schemes
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities
  • Career development programmes
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
  • Oslo’s family-friendly surroundings with their rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities
  • Salary in position as PhD Research Fellow, position code 1017 in salary range NOK from 550 800 - 595 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund 
We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. We hope you will apply for the position with us.

How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter (statement of motivation, summarizing scientific work and research interest) of maximum length 2 A4 pages.
  • CV (summarizing education, positions and academic work - scientific publications, administrative experience and other qualifying activity)
  • Copies of the original Bachelor and Master’s degree diploma and transcripts of records
  • Letters of recommendation: these are not to be submitted with the application, but may be requested later during the evaluation process
  • Documentation of English Language requirements. The appointed candidate cannot start in the position until approved documentation of English language proficiency has been submitted.
  • List of publications and academic work that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".Foreign applicants should attach an official explanation of their University's grading system.

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.

General information

The best qualified candidates will be invited for interviews.Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we can't, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to post doctoral and research posts at UiO (Norwegian) and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.  

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees that is intended to secure the rights to all research results etc.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society. 

The Department of Mathematics is part of the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences at the University of Oslo. The Department is engaged in teaching and research covering a wide spectrum of subjects within mathematics, mechanics and statistics. The research is on theory, methods and applications. The areas represented include: fluid mechanics, biomechanics, statistics and data science, computational mathematics, combinatorics, partial differential equations, stochastics and risk, algebra, geometry, topology, operator algebras, complex analysis and logic. We have almost 50 persons in permanent academic positions and a large number of post docs and Ph.D. students. We also have an administrative and technical staff. The department represents a leading research environment in mathematical areas in Norway, and has a highly international profile.

jobs.title: Product Team Engineer - Hydraulic
jobs.description: Company description:Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Withcutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and constructionequipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.Job description:Your mission Are you interested in and willing to learn and gain a broad technical knowledge about the product family / application and work in an “Product and customer” environment? Where you will interact with - Marketing  - Production, - Aftermarket. Occasionally also with customers/customer centers to gather feedback to gain a better understanding of customer requirements, ensuring these needs are incorporated into future solutions? Do you see that you would like to grow and, in the future, also take on a new role as product owner in R&D or marketing? Then you might be the one we are looking for! As “Product Team Engineer” you will collaborate with a cross-functional team, comprised of diverse engineering expertise, and your main tasks will be to lead and implement solutions that will Reduce customers' total cost of ownership (TCO) by solving issues reported by customers and production on existing machine models and implement solutions that improve operator experience and overall machine performance. Product Team Engineer will also give input regarding product strategy and roadmap and lead troubleshooting investigations in quality and Product Safety cases and continually work to improve product availability and quality through improvement suggestion to the Technical Product Responsible.Profile description:Your profile To be successful in this role you need to have a university degree in Engineering from a relevant area or similar highly qualified documented engineering experience. As a member of the R&D team, we expect you to be committed to contribute to growing the entire organization towards our vision and strategy, where collaboration, innovation and technology transitions are important examples. You are customer centric, target focused, and a collaborative team player and we hope that you are curious and dare to think new. We are searching for several positions with a few years’ experience in Hydraulic system design. You have some knowledge of the products application and are familiar with the tools that you use in your engineering role today, like Teamcenter, 3D cad, AutoCad etc. You are comfortable in both English and Swedish both speaking and in writing. Location and travel This position is located in Örebro, Sweden. Occasional travel is required.

jobs.title: Medhjælper i bageriet - Priorparken
jobs.description:
Hos Lagkagehuset er vi lige så stolte af vores hverdagsglæde som af vores bagværk. Derfor leder vi efter en Medhjælper til bageriet, der kan hjælpe os med at holde produktionen godt kørende og skabe friskbagt brød, kager og bagværk til vores gæster hver dag. Her bruger du din lyst til at lære, dit gode drive og din glæde ved at arbejde sammen med andre, så vi sammen kan være et bedre bageri for alle.

Din hverdag bliver fyldt med…Kort sagt handler rollen om at understøtte produktionen og lære arbejdet i bageriet godt at kende.

Den lidt længere version er, at du bliver en del af et team, hvor du får oplæring i de forskellige opgaver i produktionen. Det kan være alt fra dejhåndtering, bagning og pakning til brug af maskiner og opsætning af frost. Hverdagen byder på mange forskellige opgaver, og vi roterer, så vi kan hjælpe hinanden. Du bliver en del af vores centralbageri, hvor bageri, pakkeri og logistik arbejder tæt sammen, og hvor vi hver dag skaber friskbagt kvalitet til vores gæster.

Vi tror derfor på, at du vil trives hos os, hvis du…

  • har lyst til at arbejde med bageri og trives med fysisk arbejde

  • har lyst til at lære nyt og udvikle dig i rollen

  • er en holdspiller og bidrager til den gode stemning

  • gerne har erfaring fra fødevareproduktion, men det er ikke et krav

  • kan tale, læse og forstå dansk eller engelsk

Hvad vi tilbyder digVi tilbyder en arbejdsplads med fokus på udvikling, samarbejde og fællesskab. Derudover får du rabat i alle vores butikker og adgang til Visma Logbuy, som tilsammen giver lidt ekstra forkælelse i hverdagen.

Din rolle hos osDin arbejdsuge er på 37 timer, hvor du arbejder med fast natarbejdstid mellem kl. 18.00 og 04.00 (arbejdstiden kan skifte) og fri hver anden weekend.

Vil du være en del af Lagkagefamilien? Søg jobbet her.

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og kan lukke opslaget, når det rette match er fundet, så send gerne din ansøgning snart. Efter ansøgningsfristen hører du fra os senest inden for 14 dage. Ansøgninger modtages kun via vores ansøgningsportal.

jobs.title: PhD Candidates in advanced arc and friction stir welding processes for recycled aluminium
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

The position is a 3-year doctoral research fellowship starting in 2027. The PhD candidate will be embedded in the welding and joining research activities of SFI FAST and will work closely with NTNU, SINTEF, and leading international industrial partners in the aluminium value chain.

The PhD position focuses on understanding the influence of impurities coming from recycled Aluminium on the weldability of different alloys. These impurities can alter the weldability, microstructure, and performance of Aluminium welds compared to the reference alloy. Solidification and liquation cracking, pore formation, heat-affected zone softening, and degradation of corrosion resistance are some examples of possible challenges. However, the knowledge is limited about any of these possible changes. Therefore, the candidate needs to provide a thorough investigation of the welding process using conventional techniques and develop new methodologies. In addition, the welding procedure adoption to enhance the performance of the alloys based on their metallurgical characteristics shall be developed. Therefore, the candidate should have a great understanding of the welding process-microstructure-performance. 

 Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department. You will be supervised by Professor Vahid Hosseini.

About the project

SFI FAST (Future Aluminium Structures) is a national Centre for Research-based Innovation (SFI) funded by the Research Council of Norway and the aluminum industry. The Centre is led by NTNU in close collaboration with SINTEF and a broad consortium of 15 leading industrial partners across the aluminium value chain. FAST runs from 2026 to 2034 and represents one of Norway’s most ambitious long-term research initiatives within aluminium materials, manufacturing technologies, and circular economy.

The primary objective of FAST is to establish the scientific and technological knowledge base required to enable the large-scale use of post-consumer scrap (PCS) aluminium in high-value, structural, and safety-critical products. FAST adopts a through-scale and through-process research methodology, integrating materials science, manufacturing processes, product and structural design, and lifecycle performance.

A key outcome of FAST is the development of the FAST Virtual Lab, a digital framework combining experimental data, physics-based models, and data-driven methods to support design, manufacturing, and decision-making across aluminium value chains.

Education and competence building are central pillars of FAST. The Centre will educate more than 18 PhD and postdoctoral researchers and over 100 MSc students, strengthening Norway’s international position in aluminium research and innovation. The two positions posted here will be among the first ones to start in the Centre.

Please see the centre’s website: Future Aluminium Structures (FAST) - NTNU

Duties of the position
  • Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
  • Take part in the mandatory PhD research education programme
  • Develop arc welding (GTAW and GMAW) and Friction stir welding for alloys with different impurity levels to minimize welding defects and improve mechanical and corrosion performance
  • Develop knowledge in the influence of impurities on the weld’s physics, defects, microstructure, and performance
  • Thermodynamic modelling of solidification and precipitation behaviour of recycled aluminium
  • Development of weldability tests to quantify welding performance of Aluminium Alloys 
  • Advanced characterization of welded samples using Laser Confocal Microscopy, In-situ mechanical testing, SEM, FIB, and EBSD.
  • Conduct and publish high-level research in peer-reviewed journals and international conferences
  • Work closely with industrial and academic partners and participate in relevant SFI FAST activities, including mentoring and supervising MSc students

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.

Required selection criteria
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme, see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information.
  • You must have a relevant Master's degree in Mechanical engineering, Materials Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering or equivalent. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis
  • Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position
  • You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works.
  • You must have an academically relevant background within fusion and solid-state welding, welding metallurgy, and material characterization
  • Documented strong background in:
    • Experimental welding research
    • Material characterization and testing
  • Excellent written presentation skills and oral English language skills

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.

Preferred selection criteria
  • Basic knowledge of robotic welding
  • Knowledge of weld monitoring systems with focus on arc characteristics and thermal cycle analysis
  • Knowledge of thermomechanical modelling of welding process
  • Scandinavian language skills
Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Highly motivated
  • Able to work independently
  • Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them
  • Present and discuss your research with other professionals
  • Get involved and contribute constructively with feedback
  • Work constructively under pressure or in the face of adversity 
  • Show curiosity and strong motivation for the subject
  • Analyse data, assess different perspectives and draw well-founded conclusions 
  • Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed
  • Keen interest in learning and working in teams

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.

We offer
  • Exciting and stimulating tasks in a strong international academic environment
  • SFI FAST facilities, industrial network, and a joint PhD environment 
  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.

Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality.

Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,- per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Engineering within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

The position is conditional on external funding.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.

About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees
  • CV 
  • Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • Project outline containing proposals for an overall description of research questions, theoretical perspectives, methodological design for the project, and progress plan (maximum 1500 words/4 pages) 
  • Short letter of motivation (400 words/1 page). The motivation letter must be aligned with the subject of this call and why the candidate finds themselves suitable for this position.
  • Possibly publications or other relevant research work (the candidate’s contribution to each work must be clarified (performed tasks and percentage of contribution)) 
  • Possibly certificates
  • Names and contact information of three relevant referees, their relation to the applicant, and their recommendation letters for your application for this position (Note: the referees will also be directly contacted for shortlisted candidates for the position) 
  • documentation of the required criteria

If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.

Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).

General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Professor Vahid Hosseini, e-mail: vahid.hosseini@ntnu.no

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR Senior Consultant Hedda Winnberg, e-mail: hedda.winnberg@ntnu.no

Application deadline: 10.11.2026

-----------------

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage. 

The city of Trondheim is a modern European city with a rich cultural scene. Trondheim is the tech capital of Norway with a population of 200,000. The Norwegian welfare state, including healthcare, schools, kindergartens and overall equality, is probably the best of its kind in the world. Professional subsidized day-care for children is easily available. Furthermore, Trondheim offers great opportunities for education (including international schools) and possibilities to enjoy nature, culture and family life and has low crime rates and clean air quality. 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

NTNU - knowledge for a better world

The Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) creates knowledge for a better world and solutions that can change everyday life.

Department of Mechanical and Industrial Engineering

We educate graduates who can create new products, operate and maintain products, and manage projects. The Department has a variety of bachelor’s and master’s degree programmes. We conduct wide-ranging research in fields such as technology, energy, product quality and development, and productivity. The Department of Mechanical and Industrial Engineering is one of eight departments in the Faculty of Engineering.

jobs.title: Development Engineer – BONESUPPORT
jobs.description: Development Engineer – BONESUPPORTCome and join BONESUPPORT as Development Engineer! This is an opportunity to take an active role in the design and development of innovative medical devices, from early concepts to finalized products and manufacturing.BONESUPPORT is an innovative and growing medical device company based in Lund, Sweden. The company develops and commercializes injectable bio-ceramic bone graft substitutes for the treatment of bone disorders.To further strengthen our Development & Engineering department, we are now looking for a Development Engineer with a strong technical background and hands-on experience in mechanical design, product development and verification.Your roleAs Development Engineer, you will be involved in the development of new medical devices as well as improvements to existing products.You will work throughout the product development process, from concept development and mechanical design to verification, validation and transfer to manufacturing.The role has a strong technical focus, combining hands-on mechanical engineering and CAD design with testing, material selection and manufacturing considerations. You will be responsible for developing robust technical solutions that meet functional requirements and can be efficiently manufactured.You will work closely with colleagues within R&D, Operations, Quality Assurance and Regulatory Affairs, as well as external suppliers and manufacturing partners.Your main responsibilities will include:    Design and develop medical device components and assemblies using 3D CAD tools.    Execute design activities through all product development phases.    Create and maintain engineering drawings, technical specifications and design documentation.    Perform mechanical design activities, including material selection, tolerance analysis and component optimization.    Develop technical solutions with consideration for Design for Manufacturing (DFM), Design for Assembly (DFA) and Design for Reliability.    Collaborate with suppliers and manufacturing partners on tooling, injection molding and manufacturing optimization.    Develop, plan and perform verification and validation testing.    Establish test methods and prepare test protocols and reports.    Analyze test results, identify potential improvements and provide recommendations for design modifications.    Participate in design reviews, risk management activities and cross-functional development projects.    Support design transfer activities and contribute to design control documentation in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements.QualificationsWe are looking for a technically skilled engineer with practical experience in mechanical design and product development  within the medical device industry.To succeed in this role, we believe you have:    A technical academic background at Bachelor's level or higher, preferably in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.    Relevant experience in mechanical design and product development within the medical device industry.    Hands-on experience with 3D CAD software, such as SolidWorks, Inventor or similar.    Experience in creating engineering drawings, technical specifications and detailed design documentation.    Good understanding of materials, manufacturing processes and mechanical design principles.    Experience in planning, performing and documenting design verification activities, including test methods, protocols and reports for mechanical and functional testing.    Knowledge of Design for Manufacturing (DFM), Design for Assembly (DFA) and tolerance analysis.    Ability to analyze technical problems, evaluate test results and develop practical engineering solutions.    Good technical writing and documentation skills.Preferred qualificationsIt is an advantage if you also have experience or knowledge in:    Injection molding, tooling and component manufacturing.    Design Control and requirements management.    Risk management according to ISO 14971.    Usability engineering according to IEC 62366.    Medical device safety standards.    Implantable medical devices.    Statistical methods and test method development.    Design transfer and collaboration with external manufacturing partners.Personal qualitiesWe believe you are analytical, structured and solution-oriented, with a strong interest in technical problem-solving and product development.You enjoy working hands-on with engineering challenges and have the ability to translate technical requirements into practical and reliable design solutions.You take ownership of your tasks, work independently and proactively drive activities forward. At the same time, you value collaboration and enjoy working with colleagues from different technical and functional backgrounds.You are comfortable working in an environment where technical challenges require both attention to detail and an understanding of the complete product development process.Why BONESUPPORT?At BONESUPPORT, you will have the opportunity to contribute to the development of innovative medical devices that make a difference for patients.You will join a growing company where product development, engineering and manufacturing expertise come together. The position offers an opportunity to take an active role in technical development projects and contribute to the continued development of BONESUPPORT's products.Location: Lund, SwedenApplicationSKÅNESTOR is managing the recruitment process on behalf of BONESUPPORT.Please apply directly through this advertisement. For questions, please contact SKÅNESTOR at maria.gren@skanestor.se.

jobs.title: Lemvig Kommune søger en Dagplejer i Ramme/Lomborg området
jobs.description:
Brænder du for at arbejde professionelt med børn og ønsker en selvstændig hverdag, hvor du planlægger dagen ud fra børnenes behov? Så er Lemvig Kommunes dagpleje måske det helt rigtige sted for dig!

Om stillingen

Som dagplejer arbejder du hjemme i trygge rammer, hvor kram og smil er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Du får muligheden for at gøre en forskel i de vigtigste år af børnenes liv. Her kan du skabe et inspirerende miljø, hvor læring og trivsel er i fokus.

Dine opgaver

  • Skabe tryghed og gode relationer til børn og forældre.
  • Planlægge din dag ud fra børnegruppens behov.
  • Arbejde pædagogisk med fokus på børnenes trivsel, læring og udvikling.
  • Deltage i legestue og arrangementer til glæde for børnene.
  • Samarbejde med tværfaglige partnere som talepædagoger og sundhedsplejen.

Vi tilbyder

  • Mulighed for faglig og personlig udvikling.
  • Udstyr til børnene til din rådighed.
  • Tæt samarbejde med dagplejepædagoger, dagplejeledere og sekretariat.
  • Indflydelse på din egen hverdag.
  • Kollegial sparring og mentorordning.
  • Legestuegruppe med kolleger fra lokalområdet.

Vi forventer, at du

  • Har god intuition og kan skabe tryghed og gode relationer gennem omsorg og nærvær.
  • Brænder for pædagogisk arbejde med børn.
  • Indgå i et godt samarbejde med forældre, kolleger og dagplejepædagoger for at skabe den bedste hverdag for børnene.
  • Vil stille dit hjem til rådighed som et inspirerende læringsmiljø.
  • Deltager aktivt i dagplejens arrangementer og møder.

Du vil få støtte til at omsætte dagplejens læreplan, så du kan skabe de bedste rammer for børnenes udvikling. I det kommende år fokuserer vi på børneperspektiv, dannelse og fællesskaber.

Løn og ansættelse

Tiltrædelse: 1. januar 2027 

Dine løn- og ansættelsesvilkår følger gældende overenskomst. Startlønnen for en fuldtidsansat udgør 28.406 kr. pr. måned + pension. Bliv en del af et team i vækst Vi oplever fortsat fremgang og søger endnu en dygtig mekaniker med erfaring inden for transportkøling til vores dygtige og erfarne team i Vejle. Hos os får du en hverdag med frihed under ansvar, et stærkt fællesskab og mulighed for at specialisere dig i markedets førende anlæg. Dine primære opgaver:

Du får ansvaret for at løse opgaverne selvstændigt – men altid med kolleger, der står klar, når du har brug for hjælp. Hvem er du? Vi forestiller os, at du er uddannet køletekniker og har erfaring med:
  • Transportkøling eller lignende tekniske systemer.
  • Dieselmotorer, transport- eller industrikøleanlæg.
Det er en fordel, hvis du har kørekort til lastbil (C/E) og hænger (BE). Som person er du løsningsorienteret, nysgerrig og klar til at tage fat. Hos KH OneStop A/S får du mere end bare et job:

Vi tilbyder et kollegialt arbejdsmiljø, hvor vi hjælper hinanden. Du får en varieret hverdag, hvor ikke to dage er ens. Om KH OneStop A/S Hos os bliver du en del af en virksomhed med over 40 års erfaring som Danmarks førende leverandør til transportbranchen.
