jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Role Overview

Field marketing at Linear is just getting started. Its job is to put us in front of the right people in the right room: executive dinners, conferences, partner events, and programs built with our Customer team around named accounts.

We're hiring our first Field Marketing Manager to take that motion from strategy to execution. You'll own the executive dinner calendar across cities, decide which third-party events and partner programs are worth our time, and build the invitations and follow-up that help our sellers turn a good evening into a real conversation. This is a hands-on role. You'll tap your venue and vendor network, build the run of show for each program, and be on site to run it.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in the United States, with San Francisco or New York preferred. You can work from anywhere within the US. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel. This role involves frequent travel for events, including evenings.

What you’ll do

 - Own the executive dinner calendar across cities: pick the city, the venue, the date, and the theme for each dinner

 - Build each guest list with our Customer team, equip sellers with invitation sequences, and track RSVPs so every seat goes to someone worth having there

 - Manage venues and vendors, negotiate menus and minimums, and keep per-dinner spend, contracts, and travel logistics within budget

 - Brief our hosts and executives on who's attending and what we want to learn, be on site to run the night, and hand follow-ups to Sales afterward

 - Evaluate conferences and sponsorship offers by audience quality, account coverage, and expected return, then plan how we show up: booth or no booth, side dinners, customer meetings, and speaking slots

 - Co-host dinners, workshops, and meetups with partners, and agree up front on guest lists, costs, and who follows up

 - Sit with Sales each quarter to pick target accounts, build lightweight formats an AE can request for a key account, and report on attendance, meetings held, pipeline influenced, and feedback from attendees and account owners

What we’re looking for

 - 3+ years in field marketing, event marketing, or B2B events, ideally at a software company. Experience in developer tools, SaaS, or another technical product is a plus

 - A track record of running dinners, roundtables, or other small-format events end to end, plus experience planning around conferences: sponsorships, side events, and customer meetings

 - Experience working next to Sales. You know how to build a target account list, get an AE to care about an event, and tell them afterward what happened

 - Strong project management. You can run several cities and events at once without dropping details

 - Comfort with budgets, vendor contracts, and a spreadsheet. Hands-on time with HubSpot and event attribution is a plus

 - Clear writing and an easy way with senior guests, hosts, and partners. Experience marketing to engineering and product leaders is a bonus

 - Experience building an event series from the ground up, including a playbook someone else could run

 - Willingness to travel often, including evenings

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

jobs.title: Growth Engineer, Startups & SMBs
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We’re looking for a hands-on Growth engineer to help grow Notion’s Startups and SMB programs. You’ll work closely with our Ecosystem Growth Lead to help more businesses grow with Notion.

You can spot opportunities in the data and own the executing on the plan that follows. You’re comfortable getting into the tools yourself, moving quickly without sacrificing accuracy, and staying accountable for results.

 

This role is based in New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Work with a small team that operates like a growth lab. Startups and SMBs are the proving ground for ideas that can change how Notion grows.

 - Build and launch new growth programs, from creator-led acquisition to AI-powered systems for testing new audiences and campaigns. Bring your own ideas and take responsibility for getting them off the ground.

 - Move quickly from a rough hypothesis to a live experiment. Write code for new in-product experiences and build alongside Storytelling, Product, and Engineering to get your work into customers’ hands.

 - Use SQL and customer research to find overlooked opportunities. Measure what changes customer behavior and revenue, and use the results to choose where to go next.

 - Turn the strongest experiments into programs other teams can run. Build the systems and playbooks for them to expand across Notion, then take on the next growth challenge.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 2+ years and a record of shipping growth or operations projects. You can explain what you personally built and what changed as a result.

 - Typescript, Full-stack, and Systems-thinking

 - Strong SQL and analytical judgment. You can work through messy data and distinguish a promising signal from a misleading result.

 - Hands-on experience building campaigns or automated workflows in tools such as Customer.io http://Customer.io, Salesforce, or comparable platforms.

 - The ability to take an ambiguous goal and execute on growth initiatives. You unblock yourself where possible and communicate clearly when you need another team’s help.

 - Experience with self-serve SaaS or startup and SMB customers is a plus. If you’ve done similar work but with a different title, we’d love to hear from you!

ABOUT THE ROLE:

Truly unique opportunity to shape and scale self-optimizing paid marketing systems for Growth. This role exists to turn our performance marketing experimentation program from a prototype into the operating system. The opportunity calls for deep paid-growth expertise and a strong grasp of how channel mechanics, audiences, creative, measurement, experimentation, and automation fit together. You’ll set the strategy and operating model, and guide the agentic infrastructure that brings it to life. You’ll partner with BizOps, Strat Fin, Growth, Ecosystems, and Marketing across Meta, LinkedIn, Google, and ChatGPT, interpreting always-on geo, cohort, creative, and spend signals in context.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - By day 90:
   
   - Map how geo, audience, creative, spend, measurement, experimentation, and platform constraints interact; establish an operating model that turns those signals into hypotheses, tests, and clear kill/scale decisions, with agents supporting execution.
   
   - Build a deep understanding of onboarding and activation, and how paid acquisition connects to downstream user quality; partner with Growth PM and Ecosystems PM on meaningful improvements.
   
   - Establish how AI and agents can strengthen the end-to-end decision system—from analysis and hypothesis generation to creative and audience development, experiment QA, and reusable workflows—improving decision quality, not only execution speed.

 - By the end of year one:
   
   - Graduate the program from managing the experimental budget to managing the majority of paid spend, while maintaining efficiency and Notion’s quality bar for ad creative.
   
   - Establish stronger measurement and a clear, connected view of which experiments move which metrics, why they work, and how results vary by user cohort; use that understanding to shape more personalized experiences.
   
   - Turn the system into a repeatable model for Demand Generation, raising the standard for experimentation, measurement, and agentic marketing infrastructure across the organization.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Strong systems fluency across APIs, automation pipelines, and agentic systems. You can see how platform integrations, data, measurement, workflows, and constraints fit together; shape sound architecture and tradeoffs; and partner credibly with technical teams to make the system reliable.

 - Deep paid-growth subject matter expertise across platforms such as Meta, LinkedIn, and Google. You understand how channel mechanics, budgets, audiences, creative, and performance interact, and can connect those dynamics to real marketing outcomes.

 - Expert measurement and performance-analysis judgment: you can interpret geo, cohort, creative, and spend signals in context, identify meaningful patterns, understand what is driving them, and make clear kill/scale decisions.

 - Strong product and systems judgment across technical and marketing domains, with the ability to connect the parts into a coherent strategy and translate an ambiguous frontier into a system with a high quality bar.

 - High-agency cross-functional ownership: you can work across BizOps, Strat Fin, Growth, Ecosystems, and Marketing to align decisions and deliver the full loop from strategy through operating model and infrastructure to outcomes.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 400+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, our annual revenue is in the hundreds of millions USD and millions use our browser on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the DuckDuckGo subscription. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place.


Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!


Your Team and Role

  • Implementing AI-assisted answers and integrating them into our Search product while maintaining our privacy-first approach

  • Delivering improvements to Duck.ai to help us make it a competitive AI chat alternative for both free and paying users

  • Implementing sophisticated data processing pipelines that maintain search relevancy


As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll collaborate remotely with your peers and take responsibility for solving product issues impacting our all-in-one privacy solution, whether large or small. In time, you'll formally mentor other engineers, supporting their career growth and the growth of the Backend Team at DuckDuckGo.


About You

  • 7+ years of professional experience, primarily focused on backend systems that power consumer-facing products

  • Product acumen to reason about technical tradeoffs in terms of user impact

  • Familiarity with AI agent tooling: evaluation frameworks, RAG pipelines and prompt engineering

  • A fundamental understanding of complex data structures and algorithms â you can develop and apply new solutions and confidently navigate and improve existing code.

  • Data-driven analytical skills for decision-making, stakeholder alignment, and experiment-oriented delivery

  • Solid project management abilities

  • Excellent written and verbal communication to validate and articulate decisions

  • Previous experience leading and mentoring experienced engineers, supporting their career goals, and unlocking their potential.


Compensation

This role is paid on a regional pay scale, in local currency, and stock options:

Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. This program does not extend to team members located in other countries, such as Canada or the UK.


Our Team Member Support Guide explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including paid parental leave, office setup, and co-working allowances.

Hiring works best when it's a two-way street. Learn how we help you get to know DuckDuckGo, envision your future role here, and find out more about how we hire.


Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

jobs.title: Operations Manager for KS-Service ApS in Birkerød
jobs.description:
Do you want to take responsibility for the daily operations of a growing transport company? KS-Service ApS is looking for a dedicated Operations Manager who can plan, coordinate and develop our daily transport and delivery operations, and who can contribute to the continued growth of the company.

KS-Service ApS is a road freight and transport company based in Birkerød, north of Copenhagen.

About the position

As Operations Manager, you will be responsible for the company's daily operations and work closely with the management on planning, staffing and customer relations.

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Managing and coordinating the daily transport and delivery operations

  • Planning routes, schedules and the allocation of drivers and vehicles

  • Managing the drivers, including work schedules, follow-up and onboarding of new employees

  • Ensuring compliance with rules on driving and rest periods, vehicle safety and working environment

  • Following up on vehicle maintenance, inspections and fuel consumption

  • Handling contact with customers and partners and following up on delivery quality

  • Monitoring costs, efficiency and operational targets

  • Identifying opportunities for improvements and supporting the continued growth of KS-Service ApS

About you

We expect that you:

  • Have a relevant education within business, logistics or management

  • Have experience with operations, logistics or transport planning

  • Are a clear and motivating leader who can coordinate a team of drivers

  • Have a good understanding of costs, planning and operational targets

  • Work in a structured manner and remain calm during busy periods

  • Are service-minded and focused on customer satisfaction

  • Can communicate in English; Danish is an advantage

We offer

  • A key position with significant responsibility for the daily operations

  • The opportunity to influence the development of the company

  • A varied working day in a busy and dynamic transport company

The position starts on April 1, 2027, and will terminate at the end of the appointment period unless otherwise agreed.

Job DescriptionThe position involves research in global health with a particular focus on strengthening primary healthcare systems for vulnerable and underserved populations in low- and middle-income countries. The successful candidate will contribute to the international research project STRENGTHENing Gender-Responsive Health Systems for Addressing Non-Communicable Diseases in Climate-Affected Fishing Communities in Western Kenya (STRENGTHEN) and other upcoming global health projects. The STRENGTHEN project aims to improve the prevention and management of NCDs in climate-affected fishing communities in Western Kenya by making the health systems even more gender-responsive. The project will generate evidence on how community health promoters (CHPs) provide NCD care in FEDCs affected by climate change. It will address five key health systems building blocks: health information systems, health workforce, health service, medical technology, and policy and governance. The work will involve conducting implementation and health services research, and collaborating with researchers, healthcare professionals, policymakers, and community stakeholders across different country settings. The position involves travel to Kenya for short periods.

We offer a challenging position in a stimulating research environment with excellent opportunities for collaboration within SDU and with international research partners.

Expectations of qualificationsThe successful applicant should have:

  • A PhD degree (or equivalent) in Global Health, Public Health, Epidemiology, Health Services Research, Implementation Science, or a related discipline

  • A strong background in health systems research, primary healthcare, chronic disease prevention and management, or health equity research in low- and middle-income countries

  • A strong academic record

  • Good collaboration and communication skills

  • Interest in co-supervising BSc, MSc and PhD students

Following qualifications are preferred:

  • Experience with mixed-methods research, including qualitative and quantitative data collection and analysis

  • Experience with implementation science, intervention development, and evaluation of community-based health programmes

  • Experience with global health research conducted in low- and middle-income countries and/or humanitarian settings

  • Experience with stakeholder engagement and collaboration with healthcare providers, communities, and policymakers

  • Experience with writing research applications

  • Experience in teaching and education

Further informationFor further information please contact Prof. Jens Søndergaard, jsondergaard@health.sdu.dk, or Associate Prof. Trine Thilsing, tthilsing@health.sdu.dk 

Application deadline and interviewsThe application deadline is November15th 2026 at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST)  

Terms of employment Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 2-year period, and the preferred start date is from 1. April 2027.

During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme, if this has not already been completed.   

Appointment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at PhD level. 

Further information on the appointment procedure can be found in the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities. 

The appointment is in accordance with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations .

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation.  

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”. 

Application Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below.  

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.  

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.  

Your application must include the following as PDF files: 

Please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total). 

  • a motivation letter.  

  • a detailed CV.  

  • degree certificates (including a Ph.D.-diploma). 

  • a complete and numbered list of publications.  

  • 3 to 5 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file.  

    • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file. 

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy.  

  • a research plan an explanation of other qualifications relevant to the position. 

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered. 

If you experience technical problems, you must contact hcm-support@sdu.dk.

Assessment and selection process Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. 

About UsThe Research Unit of General Practice is a collaboration between the Research Unit of General Practice in Odense-Esbjerg, which is organizationally affiliated with the Foundation for General Practice Research (FEA), and the Research Unit of General Practice at the Department of Public Health, University of Southern Denmark (SDU).

The primary objective of the Research Unit is to contribute to the improvement and development of health and healthcare for patients, with a particular focus on services provided in and around general practice. 

A cornerstone of our educational activities is the training of Master's and PhD students. In addition, we contribute to teaching across a range of health sciences bachelor's and master's degree programmes at the Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark, as well as within the Research Training Programme of the specialist training programme in general practice.

jobs.title: HEADCHEF TILL MICHELIN GUIDE-REKOMMENDERAD RESTAURANG I REYKJAVÍK

Här finns havet, bergen, varma källor och några av Nordens mest intressanta råvaror alldeles i närheten.För rätt person är detta mer än ett nytt arbete. jobs.title: Automotive Technician
jobs.description:
2 positions · Troubleshooting · Test setups · New components · R&D

Do you enjoy figuring out why something does not work? RENTEQ Automotive is looking for two technicians who want to troubleshoot electric vehicles and machines, set up test setups and take part when we develop and test new components. You do not need many years of experience. What matters most is that you are hands on, curious and eager to learn.

About RENTEQ

RENTEQ Automotive is a Danish company at the forefront of electrifying existing diesel machines and vehicles. We develop and produce conversion kits for authorised dealers and end customers, and we work with everything from vans to heavy off highway machines such as dumpers and excavators. We are a growing startup with short decision paths, and our workshop and offices under one roof in Dragør.

The job

You will join our technical team in R&D and work closely with engineers, software developers and mechanics. You will be where things are tested and tried out in practice. One day you are troubleshooting a van, the next you are helping build a test setup for a new component. The work is mainly based in Dragør, but tasks at other locations may occasionally come up.

Your tasks will include:

•       Troubleshoot electrical systems and wiring harnesses on vehicles and machines

•       Set up and maintain test setups, both on the bench and in the vehicles

•       Help test new components and get them installed and integrated

•       Use diagnostic tools and CAN logs to find faults

•       Support engineers and software developers with the hands on work during testing

•       Document faults, solutions and test results so the rest of the team can use them.

Is this you?

You may be newly qualified or have a few years of experience from a workshop or similar. We care more about your troubleshooting skills and willingness to learn than about how long you have been in the trade.

•       Trained as a car mechanic, mechatronics technician, truck mechanic, construction machinery mechanic, electrician or similar

•       Experience with electrical troubleshooting on vehicles or machines

•       Comfortable using a multimeter and diagnostic equipment

•       Hands on, systematic and good at keeping things organised

•       Curious and quick to learn new things

•       Good English skills, Danish is an advantage

It is a plus if you know some of the following, but it is not a requirement:

•       CAN bus and tools such as PCAN, SavvyCAN or similar

•       Electric or hybrid vehicles, or high voltage systems

•       A driving licence for larger vehicles.

What we offer

•       A varied job on many different vehicles and machines

•       The chance to learn a lot about electric vehicles, CAN and high voltage

•       Close collaboration with engineers and software developers, where asking questions and helping each other comes naturally

•       Access to test equipment and modern diagnostic tools

•       An informal team in a growing startup

•       Good facilities, shared lunch and easy access by car or public transport.

Salary

Salary is set individually based on gender neutral criteria: education, work experience and other qualifications. We are happy to share the salary range for your profile before the first interview.

Practical information

•       Number of positions: 2

•       Employment: Permanent, full time

•       Department: R&D

•       Location: Mainly on site in Dragør, with some flexibility by agreement

•       Start date: As soon as possible.

How to apply

Send your CV and a few lines about yourself and your troubleshooting experience to louie@ren-teq.com. We review applications on an ongoing basis.

If you have questions about the position, feel free to contact Louie Lucas Bisgaard Nyeland at louie@ren-teq.com or +45 27812385.

 

RENTEQ Automotive · Dragør, Denmark · www.ren-teq.com

jobs.title: A position as postdoc (100% time) is vacant at the Research Unit of Child and Adolescent Psychiatry, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. The position is limited to three years.
jobs.description:
A position as postdoc (100% time) is vacant at the Research Unit of Child and Adolescent Psychiatry, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. The position is limited to three years. The starting date is 01 February 2027 or later by agreement and depending on the candidate’s preferences.

We are seeking a researcher with documented experience in epidemiological research who can independently plan studies, conduct analyses and write scientific papers. We are looking for a future colleague with a clear academic interest in women’s mental health and the motivation to develop their research in this field. Experience in psychiatric epidemiology is a distinct advantage.

The project

The position is funded by a grant from the Wellcome Trust through PROMIS, an international research project on women’s mental health during perimenopause. The project is in its initial phase and will draw on cohort data linked to national registers, in collaboration with researchers in the UK, the USA and Sweden.

The project investigates risk factors for the onset or recurrence of depression, anxiety, bipolar disorder and psychotic disorders during perimenopause. The work includes epidemiological studies of risk, the development and validation of prediction models, and studies of hormone therapy and mental health outcomes using target trial emulation.

Research tasks

The postdoc will work closely with Principal Investigator Professor Trine Munk-Olsen and the project’s data analyst and participate actively in the international research collaboration. The candidate will have considerable scope to shape research questions, the structure of individual studies, study designs and methodological choices within the framework of the project.

The main tasks are to:

  • Plan and conduct epidemiological studies using register and cohort data, including preparing study protocols and analysis plans.

  • Independently perform statistical analyses, interpret results and write scientific papers.

  • Identify risk factors for mental disorders during perimenopause and contribute to the development and validation of prediction models.

  • Contribute to studies using target trial emulation to investigate hormone therapy and mental health outcomes.

  • Together with other project team members, contribute to applications for access to external datasets and to the maintenance, quality assurance, harmonisation and documentation of the datasets used.

  • Participate in subprojects and undertake tasks within the international collaboration, including coordination, organising project meetings and following up on joint agreements.

The position will involve limited travel. It is primarily research-oriented. Teaching and supervision duties may be included, depending also on the candidate’s interests and preferences.

Expectations of qualifications

The applicant who is hired must have a Ph.D. degree in epidemiology, health sciences, biostatistics or data science with a strong focus on health. Candidates who have not yet completed their Ph.D. may apply if they expect to obtain the degree by the starting date. However, we envisage that, in addition to their Ph.D., the candidate will have at least 1–2 years of research-related experience, for example as a postdoc, research assistant or statistician.

The applicant must have the following qualifications:

  • A clear academic interest in research on women’s mental health, including the relationships between reproductive life stages and mental disorders.

  • First authorship of several scientific papers, including documented experience in epidemiological research based on register or cohort data.

  • Documented experience with advanced epidemiological and statistical methods.

  • Documented experience and competence in statistical programming, for example in R or Stata.

  • A documented ability to independently plan studies, prepare study protocols, conduct analyses and write scientific papers.

  • Good collaboration skills and the ability to take responsibility for tasks and contribute constructively to joint research projects.

  • The ability to work systematically with data quality, documentation and the maintenance of research data.

  • Fluency in written and spoken English.

The following would be an advantage but are not requirements:

  • Experience in psychiatric epidemiology.

  • Experience in the development or validation of prediction models.

  • Practical experience with target trial emulation.

  • Experience in international research collaborations.

  • Written and spoken Danish, as Danish is the working language of the research unit.

Research environment

The position is based in the Research Unit of Child and Adolescent Psychiatry, a growing, dynamic and collaborative research environment at the Department of Clinical Research, University of Southern Denmark. Our research group brings together expertise in psychiatry, psychology, epidemiology and public health. We offer a friendly, inclusive and interdisciplinary working environment where early-career researchers are supported in developing their academic and professional skills. The unit leads several major research projects focusing on perinatal mental health, child and adolescent psychiatry, and early intervention and prevention.

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision –We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future – it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research – with people at the centre; strong research environments – as drivers of development; and the research journey – from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

Further information 

For further information please contact Professor Trine Munk-Olsen, e-mail: tmun@sdu.dk, phone: +45 24 46 62 97.

Application deadline

November 18, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET).

Interviews

Interviews are expected to take place in early December 2026.

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Postdoc is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed postdoc allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated.

The work location will be at Hospitalsringen 90, 5260 Odense S.  

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • a motivation letter

  • a detailed CV

  • degree certificates (inclusive of Ph.D.-diploma)

  • a complete and numbered list of publications

  • 3 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file.

    • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file.

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • a detailed description of research experience

  • an explanation of other qualifications relevant to the position

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.  

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

jobs.title: Science Hub Denmark Student Assistant
jobs.employer: COPENHAGEN CAPACITY, FONDEN TIL MARKEDSFØRING OG ERHVERVSFREMME
jobs.description:
The Science Hub Denmark initiative is expanding. Join us and help us tell the world why Denmark is a fantastic place to pursue a career in research!

We are looking for a promising Student Assistant with a passion for science to join our growing team that aims to brand Denmark internationally as an attractive career destination for elite researchers within Biosolutions, Biomedicine, Neuroscience, Sustainable Energy Tech, Quantum and AI.

We are still looking for a new setup for the team and are therefore open to profiles within all our focus areas.

Your tasks and responsibilities

  • Assist the Science Hub team in running the project and developing and executing the various activities and events. Both online and in-person. This could imply some international travel.

  • Conduct market research.

  • Candidate and university outreach.

  • Provide administrative support to the team.

  • Work with our CRM system, HubSpot.

Your profileYou are currently studying a master’s degree and are excited about the opportunity to share with the world why Denmark is a great place to live and work. You are a motivated, creative and a structured team player. It would be good if you have some of the skills and competencies listed below but don’t worry if you don’t have them all. If you have the right mindset, everything is possible!

  • A passion for science and an interest and firsthand knowledge of one of our research areas at Danish universities.

  • Proficient in English both verbally and in writing.

  • Outgoing with good communication and public speaking skills

  • Good organisational and time management skills.

  • Ability to work effectively within a team and independently.

Our offices are in the city center of Copenhagen, Denmark. You’ll work here part-time: 15-20 hours per week. We’ll agree on a work schedule that fits with your studies.Copenhagen Capacity Copenhagen Capacity is Greater Copenhagen’s organization for investment promotion and regionaleconomic development. We work to make the region even more attractive to foreign investment andmarket it internationally to attract companies, investors, and highly educated workers.

The goal is to create jobs, growth, and development in Greater Copenhagen. In addition to that, we are a close-knit, passionate organization with a multinational work environment where English is our shared office language. We value collaboration and connection, whether over lunch in the company canteen with colleagues across departments or at social events.

Science Hub Denmark Science Hub Denmark is an initiative dedicated to enhancing the international visibility of Danish research and career opportunities in Denmark. With funding from Villum Fonden, Novo Nordisk Fonden, and Lundbeck Fonden, the initiative will continue for three more years with the aim of significantly increasing the interest in Danish research worldwide, while also exploring innovative strategies for promoting career opportunities in Denmark. 

Emphasizing research excellence, societal impact, and quality of life, the initiative will utilize digital channels to engage researchers abroad and facilitate recruitment for research positions at Danish universities. The project focuses on key areas: Biosolutions, Biomedicine, Neuroscience, Sustainable Energy Tech, Quantum and AI; research strongholds where Denmark excels internationally. 

How to apply If you think you’re the right profile for this position and our team, please apply before the 8th of November 2026 by sending your CV and cover letter job@copcap.com with "Student Assistant – Science Hub" in the subject line.  Interviews are expected to be held in the week of 9-13 November.

If you have any questions regarding the role, please reach out to Head of Science Hub Denmark – Alexander Watts, by email: alw@copcap.com

jobs.title: Experienced High Voltage Specialist wanted for Bravida El-Infrastruktur Øst
jobs.description:
Do you have at least three years of high voltage experience? At Bravida, you will install circuit breakers, disconnectors and switchboards and help build substations. Here, you will put your experience to use on critical electrical infrastructure projects that help secure Denmark’s power supply and support the green transition.

On behalf of Bravida El-Infrastruktur Øst, Career | a JKS Company is recruiting experienced High Voltage Specialists for projects across Zealand and Lolland-Falster.

Bravida El-Infrastruktur Øst has secured the framework agreement with Energinet, becoming a regular supplier of high voltage installation work across Zealand and Lolland-Falster. With this agreement and a strong order book, Bravida is expanding the department. You will join the team responsible for building, expanding, refurbishing and maintaining the infrastructure that the power grid of the future relies on.

Installation and construction of high voltage installationsYou will work at substations and other high voltage installations, putting your experience into practice. You will take responsibility for your own tasks and work alongside your team to deliver safe, high-quality work.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Installing and replacing circuit breakers, disconnectors and other substation components

  • Carrying out cable work and working on earthing systems

  • Working on switchboards, electrical installations and dismantling tasks

  • Contributing to the construction, refurbishment and maintenance of high voltage installations

  • Carrying out quality assurance and maintaining documentation

Over time, you will also share your knowledge by helping apprentices and new colleagues get to grips with their tasks.

You bring solid high voltage experience and take responsibilityYou are a qualified electrician or have an equivalent electrical qualification, with at least three years of hands-on experience in high voltage work. You are familiar with the tasks described and comfortable working independently. You take initiative, recognise what needs doing and understand that safety is integral to every task.

We are looking for someone who:

  • Works independently and takes a structured approach

  • Takes responsibility for the safety and quality of their work

  • Is proactive, well-presented and works well with others

  • Is physically fit and comfortable with hands-on work outdoors and at height

  • Holds a category B driving licence and can provide a criminal record certificate

You must be able to communicate clearly in English and have a valid work permit for Denmark.

A company vehicle to take home and no on-call dutiesAt Bravida, you will join a team of skilled, dedicated technicians who take pride in their work.

You will work daytime hours with no on-call duties, normally five days a week. Start times depend on the project, and the working week can be discussed. The role is paid hourly, with pay based on qualifications, plus pension contributions and a flexible benefits allowance under the Danish “fritvalgsordning” scheme.

You will have a company vehicle equipped with the tools and equipment you need, which you can take home. Your exact location is therefore less important, provided you are willing to work at different sites across Zealand and Lolland-Falster.

We look forward to hearing from youIf this sounds like the right role for you, please send us your CV. We review applications and invite suitable candidates to interviews on an ongoing basis, and will close the vacancy once the right candidates have been found.

If you have any questions about the role that are not covered in this advertisement, please contact Recruitment Specialist Kristine Askjær on +45 3085 1302.

Please note that, for GDPR reasons, applications submitted directly by email will not be processed or receive a response.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Developer Platform https://www.notion.com/product/dev engineer, you will directly contribute to the foundational pieces that make Notion extensible and connected. You will build tools, APIs, and platform experiences that help customers connect Notion to the world — bringing their apps, data, and workflows into one workspace. Your work will make it easier for developers, admins, and builders to create reliable integrations and automations on top of Notion.


You will be a key player in building the robust technical foundation that allows Notion to achieve the connected workspace vision. Your work will include both internal platform contributions that accelerate other Notion engineering teams and end-user-facing functionality that enables toolmaking ubiquity. You will be presented with challenging technical problems, as Notion’s product needs are complex. You’ll play a key role in identifying and executing against technical investments that ensure the long-term quality, reliability, and performance of Notion’s platform as we scale.


This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - You’ll work with a team of engineers and cross-functional partners across product, design, data science, and user research to define a product strategy and drive execution through conception, research, implementation, and maintenance.

 - You’ll evolve Developer Platform capabilities across APIs, MCP tools, and integration infrastructure that help customers automate workflows, customize Notion, and connect Notion to the tools and data they use every day.

 - You’ll contribute to the overall performance, reliability, and robustness of the Notion product, ensuring it scales elegantly across many dimensions.

 - You’ll partner with engineering leaders to identify and execute against high-leverage technical investments that ensure the long-term flexibility and sustainability of our core systems.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 7+ years of experience shipping production software, with a strong track record of owning features end-to-end

 - Fluency with TypeScript across both backend and frontend

 - Strong product instincts: you can take a vague problem, propose a solid technical approach, and know when to cut scope

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience building developer tools like APIs and SDKs

 - Experience driving teams toward shared goals and balancing business priorities with individuals’ strengths, areas of interest, and career development goals

 - Familiarity with AI/agent tooling, evals, or LLM-driven product experiences

ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is shaping the future of Go-To-Market, and as a Solutions Consultant (SC), you’ll bring that future to life by building alongside customers and turning their biggest challenges into measurable outcomes. As a customer-facing, quota-carrying SC, you’ll bring together technical fluency and commercial ownership to grow your book of business. You’ll build pipeline with BDRs, engage key stakeholders, lead discovery, co-build workflow solutions live with customers, and guide opportunities through close. You’ll connect each solution to a clear business case and stay engaged through adoption, expansion, and renewal so customers realize the value of what they buy.

You’ll partner with BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists while maintaining clear ownership of customer relationships, opportunity momentum, and next steps.  - Create pipeline across your book of business. Build target-account plans with BDRs and initiate outreach to priority stakeholders to generate qualified opportunities, alongside BDR-sourced pipeline.

 - Own opportunities from first conversation through close. Lead discovery, qualify business needs and urgency, align stakeholders, shape the solution and business case, and drive the evaluation and commercial decision. Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path.

 - Design and validate workflow solutions that deliver measurable value. Map current- and future-state workflows, co-build solutions live in Notion, and define realistic scope, success criteria, and an implementation path. Translate customer needs and validated outcomes into a clear business case, commercial recommendation, and decision path. Treat discovery as an opportunity to build and validate.

 - Orchestrate the right partners while maintaining ownership. Engage BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists at the right moments, with clear context and asks, while owning opportunity momentum, customer communication, and next steps.

 - Drive customer value and commercial growth after signature. Partner with Outcomes Architects, guide the initial path to value with a clear adoption plan, on onboarding and ongoing multi-workflow adoption, and own expansion strategy and renewal planning. Stay accountable for translating credits sold into credits consumed, and surface risks or expansion opportunities as customer workflows mature. 

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Commercial ownership and pipeline generation. You can demonstrate how you created or advanced business, influenced customer decisions, and owned measurable outcomes. Relevant experience may come from quota-carrying sales or adjacent customer-facing roles.

 - AI fluency. You are excited about AI, build with new tools, and continually learn new ways of working.

 - Discovery, qualification, and value articulation. You can uncover customer needs, map workflows, qualify business impact and urgency, and translate what you learn into commercial outcomes, adoption plans, and clear success criteria.

 - Agency, urgency, and learning velocity. You set clear goals, take initiative, learn from customer interactions, and apply those learnings to improve outcomes. You bring new ideas and workflows to customers and make complex problems easier to solve.

 - Complex customer engagement. You can lead multi-stakeholder interactions and navigate procurement, legal, and security review cycles.

 


NICE TO HAVES:

 - Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience, with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new-logo acquisition and expansion motions.
   
   - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals.

 - Prior experience selling to commercial accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software.

 - Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or Customer Success team as part of an integrated customer motion.

 - Fluency in Dutch

jobs.title: Verkamaður í fiskvinnslu - Fish production worker
jobs.description: KG Fiskverkun á Rifi óskar eftir að ráða starfsmann til almennra starfa við saltfiskverkun.Almenn störf við flökun, söltun og pökkun.Fullt starf.Vinnutími frá kl. 07.55 -16.00 (30 mín í matartíma).Stundum unnin yfirvinna og þá til kl. 18.00.Laun skv. kjarasamningum auk bónus bæði fastur og einnig vegna mætingar.Tímabundin vinna til 30.júní n.k. Möguleiki á að framlengja starfið í a.m.k. 1 ár eða til framtíðar.Helstu verkefni:Snyrting og skurður: Skera burt blóðhorf, galla eða dregna orma úr flökum.Pökkun: Raða flökum, bitum eða öðrum afurðum í öskjur, plast eða kassa.Flokkun: Flokka fisk eftir stærð, gæðum og tegundum.Vélavinna: Starfa við flökunarvélar, Hausunarvélar eða aðrar vélar tengdar fiskvinnsluÞrif og hreinlæti: Þrífa vinnusvæði og tæki samkvæmt ströngum hreinlætiskröfum.Vinnuumhverfi og kröfur:Húsnæði: Unnið er innanhúss í köldu og röku umhverfi (oftast um 4–12°C til að vernda vöruna).Vinnuföt: Starfsfólk fær sérstakan hlífðarfatnað (stígvél, svuntur, hanska, hárnet).Líkamlegt erfiði: Starfið krefst þess að standa lengi í einu og gera endurteknar hreyfingar.Kröfur: Ekki er krafist sérstakrar menntunar en góð sjón, nákvæmni og þol eru mikilvægir eiginleikar.Æskilegt að viðkomandi tali íslensku, ensku eða pólsku.Aðstoð er veitt við að útvega húsnæði á svæðinu. Vinsamlegast sendið umsókn ásamt ferilskrá á netfangið: AL@kg.isUmsóknarfrestur er til og með 1. nóvember 2026.----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------KG Fiskverkun in Rif is seeking to hire a Production worker for general duties in saltfish processing.Full-time position.Working hours from 07:55-16:00 (30-minute lunch break).Occasional overtime may be required, in which case working hours may be extended until 18:00.Salary is paid in accordance with applicable collective agreements, in addition to both a fixed bonus and an attendance-related bonus.This is a temporary position until June 30, 2027, with the possibility of an extension for at least one year or potentially a permanent position.Key Responsibilities:Trimming and Cutting: Removing blood spots, defects, or parasites from fish fillets.Packing: Arranging fillets, portions, and other products into boxes, plastic packaging, or containers.Sorting: Classifying fish according to size, quality, and species.Machine Operation: Working with filleting machines, heading machines, and other equipment used in fish processing.Cleaning and Sanitation: Maintaining workstations and equipment in accordance with strict hygiene standards.Working Environment and Requirements:Work Environment: Indoor work in a cold and humid environment (typically between 4°C and 12°C to preserve product quality).Protective Clothing: Employees are provided with protective workwear, including boots, aprons, gloves, and hairnets.Physical Demands: The position requires standing for extended periods and performing repetitive tasks.Qualifications: No formal education is required; however, good eyesight, attention to detail, reliability, and physical stamina are important qualities.Language Skills: Applicants should preferably speak Icelandic, English, or Polish.Assistance with finding housing is provided. Please send your application and CV to: AL@kg.isApplication deadline: November 1st, 2026.

jobs.title: Sales Strategy & Operations Manager, APAC
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

In this position, you'll play a crucial role in shaping our go-to-market strategy and driving data-informed decision-making within the Japan/APAC region. This position sits at the intersection of sales, strategy, and operations, offering the opportunity to significantly impact Notion's growth trajectory. You'll work closely with sales leadership and cross-functional teams to optimize processes, deliver actionable insights, and support key strategic initiatives. You will report directly to the Head of Field Strategy & Operations.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Partner with Japan leadership team to define and drive strategy (e.g. territory mapping, long-term account planning, geographic expansion) and results for the region by conducting insightful analysis on local Japan markets and customers while providing support for other APAC priorities as needed.

 - Support regional sales leaders and sales teams in achieving their goals by providing actionable insights and visibility to sales performance metrics

 - Build reporting and presentations for Japan/APAC sales leadership to update on the state of the business, both up and across the organization

 - Act as a partner to the Japan/APAC sales team, providing hands-on operational support to drive deals forward and advising with decision-making

 - Enable smooth, efficient deal execution by supporting day-to-day deal operations, including opportunity hygiene, quote preparation, and coordination of approvals and internal handoffs, helping sellers navigate processes and remove friction throughout the deal lifecycle

 - Partner with the GTM Systems team to continuously enhance our sales technology stack to provide both a best-in-class experience for our sellers and a robust sales data environment

 - Work with cross-functional teams including Legal, Finance, Product, Marketing, etc. as the primary operational counterpart on behalf of the Japan/APAC sales org

 - Maintain and embed global sales policies, processes, and procedures, driving discipline with regards to strategy execution

 - Support global planning process locally, including target setting, capacity modeling, territory carving, etc.

 - Surface on-the-ground observations and insights to global sales and RevOps leadership




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - 5+ years of strategy, operations, and analytics experience with a track record of driving growth - working in sales operations, preferably in a high-growth SaaS environment

 - Expertise to quickly drill down into the business funnel for outbound and inbound sales motions, and how that connects to revenue

 - Excellent analytical and quantitative modeling skills; ability to analyze and interpret data, provide actionable insights, and deliver measurable results

 - Expert proficiency with core sales tools (e.g. Salesforce, Gong, Outreach, etc.) and best practices for sales data management

 - Ability to apply AI-powered tools to accelerate analysis, uncover trends, and translate complex sales data into actionable business insights. Comfortable framing analytical questions, iterating on prompts, and validating AI-generated outputs with sound business judgment and rigorous data checks, while handling sensitive information responsibly

 - Strong collaborator, works well with stakeholders, gains trust, enjoys working with people

 - Demonstrates a senior presence and can convey complex information to executives clearly and concisely; can resolve tradeoffs. Effective communicator across levels and audiences

 - Hands on and proactive, with a builders mentality.

 - Maintaining high ownership mentality, demonstrated by developing projects of >6-12 months length

 - Notion power user or desire to learn -- prior Notion experience is not required, but you have the ability and desire to become a pro
   
   #LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

 

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

 

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

 

How it works

 

  1. Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.
  2. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.
  3. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.
  4. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.
  5. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.
  6. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.
  7. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

 

Requirements

 

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering
  • Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)
  • Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++
  • Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing
  • Regular use of an AI coding tool
  • Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models
  • You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words
  • At least 10 hours a week, starting now
  • A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

 

Nice to have

 

  • Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure
  • Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

 

Terms

 

  • US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you
  • Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms
  • The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us
  • Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

 

Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

jobs.description:
Remote, Brazil, Full Time, Individual Contributor, +3 years of experience

Who We Are

At Yuno, we are building the payment infrastructure that allows all companies to participate in the global market. Founded by seasoned experts from the payments and tech industries, our technology provides access to leading payment capabilities, enabling companies to engage customers confidently and maintain global operations through seamless integrations.

We empower high-performing teams at brands like InDrive, McDonald's, Rappi, and Viva Aerobus to integrate over 1,000 payment methods via a single API. By leveraging advanced AI and the latest technologies, we orchestrate smart routing and fraud prevention across 80+ countries.

 

About The Role

We are orchestrating the best high-performing team!

We are looking for a Technical Account Manager to own and elevate Yuno's technical customer relationships across Latin America. This is a leadership position for someone who combines deep technical expertise with the ability to inspire a team, build trust with customers, and drive outcomes that matter. You will be the senior technical voice for our most strategic accounts in the region â and the person who sets the standard for how great technical partnership looks at Yuno.

Day to day, you will lead a team of TAMs while staying close to the most complex customer challenges yourself. LATAM is one of the fastest-growing payment ecosystems in the world, with unique local nuances and high-stakes integrations. That environment rewards people who bring both precision and resilience â someone who can stay steady under pressure, push through hard problems, and come out the other side with better solutions and stronger customer relationships than before.

This role also sits at the heart of Yuno's cross-functional engine. You will work closely with Product, Development, Sales, and Partnerships teams, making sure customer insights translate into real improvements and that internal teams have the context they need to move fast. You will set best practices, define how the TAM function scales, and ensure every integration your team owns reflects the quality and reliability Yuno's customers expect.

If you are technically sharp, and genuinely excited about building something meaningful in one of the most dynamic payment markets in the world â this role is for you.

 

Your contribution will be

  • Serve as the senior technical point of contact for strategic accounts, owning escalations and driving resolution on complex integration challenges

  • Lead high-level discussions with customer leadership around technical strategy, product trade-offs, incident management, and risk mitigation

  • Define and implement best practices for technical onboarding, integration delivery, and ongoing account health monitoring

  • Partner with developers and senior engineers to provide strategic technical guidance and support solution design

  • Collaborate with Product and Development teams to customize platform capabilities and feed customer insights into the roadmap

  • Work cross-functionally with Sales, Partnerships, and Finance to support account retention and regional growth

  • Monitor integration progress and ramp-up milestones across the team, ensuring consistent and high-quality delivery

  • Champion the LATAM customer base internally, bringing regional intelligence into Yuno's strategic conversations

 

Skills You Need

Minimum Qualifications

  • Fluency in English and Portuguese is a plus ; Spanish is a plus

  • 5+ years of experience in technical account management or integration engineering, preferably in fintech or payments

  • Proven track record of leading or mentoring technical teams

  • Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, SOAP, JSON, XML, and API management tools such as Postman, SoapUI, or Swagger

  • Proficiency in web fundamentals: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, RESTful APIs, and modern frameworks

  • Hands-on experience in at least one server-side language: Golang, Python, Node.js, or equivalent

  • Familiarity with server and database technologies including Apache, Nginx, MySQL, Oracle, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or similar

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills

  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts, team priorities, and concurrent projects

  • Clear and compelling communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders at all seniority levels

  • Experience with ticketing systems is a plus

 

What We Offer at Yuno

  • Competitive Compensation

  • Remote Work â You can work from everywhere!

  • Home Office Bonus â A one-time allowance to help you create your ideal home office.

  • Work Equipment

  • Stock Options

  • Health Plan wherever you are.

  • Flexible Days Off

jobs.title: Software Engineer AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.


How it works

  1. Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.
  2. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.
  3. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.
  4. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.
  5. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.
  6. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.
  7. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.


Requirements

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering
  • Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)
  • Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++
  • Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing
  • Regular use of an AI coding tool
  • Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models
  • You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words
  • At least 10 hours a week, starting now
  • A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)


Nice to have

  • Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure
  • Experience building agent tasks or RL environments


Terms

  • US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you
  • Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms
  • The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us
  • Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork


Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer
